words.enDefinition: to confirm that you want to receive a ticket sent to you

examples.en: My friend asked me to accept the transfer before we left for the match.
examples.zh: 朋友让我在出发看比赛前「接受门票转交」。

examples.en: The app let me read the event details before I could accept the transfer.
examples.zh: 在我「接受门票转交」前，应用先让我查看活动详情。

collocations: ask someone to accept the transfer

words.enDefinition: seating designed for people with disabilities or other access needs

examples.en: I asked about accessible seating before booking tickets for our group.
examples.zh: 给我们这组人订票前，我问了问「无障碍座席」的情况。

examples.en: The arena showed its accessible seating on a separate section map.
examples.zh: 体育馆用一张单独的分区图标出了「无障碍座席」。

words.enDefinition: a group of songs performed using mainly acoustic instruments

examples.en: The band played an acoustic set in the library courtyard on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 周五下午，乐队在图书馆庭院演出了「原声演奏的一组节目」。

examples.en: I liked the quiet acoustic set before the full band came back onstage.
examples.zh: 完整乐队重新上台前，我很喜欢那段安静的「原声演奏节目」。

words.enDefinition: a version of a song performed mainly using acoustic instruments

examples.en: The singer played an acoustic version of the song on a small wooden stage.
examples.zh: 歌手在小木台上演了这首歌的「原声乐器演奏版」。

examples.en: I preferred the acoustic version because I could follow the words more easily.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢「原声乐器演奏版」，那一版的歌词更容易听清。

words.enDefinition: pigment suspended in an acrylic binder for painting

examples.en: I brought acrylic paint because I wanted to work on canvas that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我带了「丙烯颜料」，因为那天下午想在画布上画画。

examples.en: The studio had enough yellow acrylic paint for everyone at the table.
examples.zh: 画室的黄色「丙烯颜料」足够这一桌的人用。

words.enDefinition: a group of performers working together as a coordinated unit

examples.en: Our class formed an acting ensemble for a series of short student plays.
examples.zh: 我们班为一系列学生短剧组建了一个「表演团体」。

examples.en: The acting ensemble built the whole scene around one actor's quiet entrance.
examples.zh: 「表演团体」把整场戏围绕一位演员悄悄上场来编排。

words.enDefinition: A film or show that combines fast-paced action with comic situations.

examples.en: The action comedy made us laugh most when the characters tried to work together.
examples.zh: 这部「动作喜剧」里，角色们试着合作的那段最让我们发笑。

examples.en: We put on an action comedy because everyone wanted something energetic after a quiet afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午安安静静过完后，大家想看点热闹的，我们就放了部「动作喜剧」。

words.enDefinition: Minutes that an app or device counts as physical activity based on its own criteria.

examples.en: My tracker showed active minutes after I had walked back from the recreation center.
examples.zh: 我从文体活动中心走回来后，运动记录设备显示了「活动分钟数」。

examples.en: I noticed that active minutes and total exercise time appeared separately on the watch.
examples.zh: 我留意到，手表上的「活动分钟数」和锻炼总时间分开显示。

words.enDefinition: to place a song or other item among those waiting to play next

examples.en: I chose a song to add to the queue instead of interrupting the album.
examples.zh: 我选了一首歌「加入待播队列」，避免打断正在播放的专辑。

examples.en: The app showed which tracks I could add to the queue after selecting the playlist.
examples.zh: 我选了歌单后，应用列出了可以「加入待播队列」的曲目。

collocations: choose tracks to add to the queue
option to add to the queue
select a song to add to the queue

words.enDefinition: An exercise bench whose seat or backrest can be set at different angles.

examples.en: The adjustable bench had a separate label from the flat benches beside the mirror.
examples.zh: 「可调式训练凳」有单独的标牌，跟镜子旁的平凳分开标注。

examples.en: A photo showed the adjustable bench in two different positions near the equipment shelves.
examples.zh: 一张照片展示了器械架附近的「可调式训练凳」在两种调节状态下的样子。

collocations: an adjustable bench with a backrest
an adjustable bench on the map
a label for the adjustable bench

words.enDefinition: A showing of a film before it is generally released to the public.

examples.en: The film society invited students to an advance screening of a documentary about public gardens.
examples.zh: 电影社邀请同学们参加一部公共花园纪录片的「提前放映」。

examples.en: My roommate had seen the film at an advance screening before it opened in town.
examples.zh: 这部片还没在城里正式上映之前，室友已在「提前放映」看过了。

collocations: an invitation to an advance screening
an advance screening of a documentary

words.enDefinition: a broad style of contemporary West African popular music associated especially with Nigeria and Ghana

examples.en: A friend played Afrobeats while we helped move chairs for the student music night.
examples.zh: 我们帮学生音乐之夜搬椅子时，朋友放了「西非流行音乐」。

examples.en: The radio presenter featured Afrobeats tracks chosen by students from several different courses.
examples.zh: 电台主持人重点播放了几门不同专业课程的学生选出的「西非流行音乐」曲目。

words.enDefinition: A label indicating which age groups a film or program is considered suitable for.

examples.en: We checked the age rating when a friend asked if she could bring her younger brother.
examples.zh: 朋友问能不能带弟弟来时，我们查了「观看年龄分级」。

examples.en: The campus cinema printed the age rating below each film description in its program.
examples.zh: 校园影院把「观看年龄分级」印在节目单上每部电影的简介下方。

collocations: an age rating for a film

words.enDefinition: modelling clay that hardens when left to dry in air

examples.en: We used air-dry clay to make small dishes for holding paper clips.
examples.zh: 我们用「风干黏土」做了几个装回形针的小碟子。

examples.en: I bought a small pack of air-dry clay for the weekend project.
examples.zh: 我买了一小包「风干黏土」做周末手工。

words.enDefinition: the images and design associated with the packaging or display of an album

examples.en: My classmate designed the album artwork for a student band in her spare time.
examples.zh: 同学用业余时间给一支学生乐队做了「专辑视觉设计」。

examples.en: The album artwork was based on a photograph taken behind the old music building.
examples.zh: 「专辑视觉设计」以旧音乐楼后面拍的一张照片为基础。

words.enDefinition: the act or occasion of making an album publicly available

examples.en: The band planned a small acoustic set to mark its album release that evening.
examples.zh: 乐队计划那晚演一小组原声歌曲，纪念「专辑发行」。

examples.en: My classmate made a poster announcing the album release for his friends' music project.
examples.zh: 同学为朋友的音乐项目做了一张「专辑发行」海报。

words.enDefinition: A class notice saying people of any experience or skill level may take part.

examples.en: The flyer said “All levels welcome” below a photo of the group fitness studio.
examples.zh: 传单在团课教室照片下方写着「各水平都可参加」。

examples.en: We saw “All levels welcome” beside the time and location for the afternoon session.
examples.zh: 下午课的时间和地点旁边写着「各水平都可参加」。

collocations: a class marked all levels welcome
a listing saying all levels welcome
a notice reading all levels welcome

words.enDefinition: a pass covering every session of a multi-session event

examples.en: Our parents bought an all-session pass because we competed on different days.
examples.zh: 因为我俩在不同的日子参赛，父母买了张「全场次通票」。

examples.en: The all-session pass included both the morning events and the evening final.
examples.zh: 「全场次通票」包括上午的各项赛事和晚上的决赛。

words.enDefinition: A full-length film that tells its story mainly through animation.

examples.en: An animated feature played at the campus cinema before the director's talk on Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五导演座谈前，校园影院放了一部「动画长片」。

examples.en: I picked an animated feature because my roommate was interested in the film's visual style.
examples.zh: 我选了部「动画长片」，因为室友对它的视觉风格感兴趣。

words.enDefinition: A series that tells separate stories in individual episodes or groups of episodes.

examples.en: Each episode of the anthology series took place in a different apartment building downtown.
examples.zh: 这部「独立故事式剧集」每集的故事都发生在市中心不同的公寓楼里。

examples.en: I liked that the anthology series could change its cast completely from one season to another.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这部「独立故事式剧集」各季能够换一批全新的演员。

collocations: an anthology series with a shared theme

words.enDefinition: a self-contained solo song within an opera, usually with accompaniment

examples.en: We practised a short aria in class with a student pianist.
examples.zh: 我们在课上练了一段简短的「歌剧咏叹调」，有同学弹钢琴伴奏。

examples.en: The audience went unusually quiet during the singer's final aria.
examples.zh: 歌手唱最后一段「歌剧咏叹调」时，观众格外安静。

words.enDefinition: a person who helps the director organise rehearsals and develop the show

examples.en: Our assistant director asked us to repeat the scene at a slower pace.
examples.zh: 我们的「助理导演」请我们用慢一点的节奏再演一遍这场戏。

examples.en: The assistant director took notes while the director talked to the actors.
examples.zh: 导演和演员说话时，「助理导演」在一旁记笔记。

words.enDefinition: a reported number of people who attended a particular event

examples.en: The attendance figure appeared on screen just before the game ended.
examples.zh: 比赛结束前不久，屏幕上显示了「到场人数统计」。

examples.en: The student newspaper checked the attendance figure before publishing its article.
examples.zh: 学生报发稿前核实了「到场人数统计」。

words.enDefinition: parts of a performance where spectators are invited to take part

examples.en: The play used audience participation in a scene where students voted together.
examples.zh: 这部剧在同学们一起投票的那场戏中安排了「观众参与」。

examples.en: The programme explained that audience participation would be optional throughout the show.
examples.zh: 节目册说明，全场「观众参与」环节都可以自愿选择。

words.enDefinition: an idea offered by spectators as a starting point for performance

examples.en: The performers turned an audience suggestion into a scene about train travel.
examples.zh: 表演者把一个「观众给的点子」演成了一场关于火车旅行的戏。

examples.en: My classmate offered an audience suggestion, and the group used it immediately.
examples.zh: 同学给了一个「观众点子」，表演团马上用了。

words.enDefinition: a show with spoken descriptions of its important visual details

examples.en: My classmate asked if the student ballet had an audio-described performance.
examples.zh: 同学向剧场询问学生芭蕾有没有「带口述影像的演出」。

examples.en: The audio-described performance included descriptions of the dancers' movements between sections of music.
examples.zh: 那场「带口述影像的演出」在各段音乐之间有对舞者动作的口述说明。

words.enDefinition: Spoken narration that conveys important visual information for people who cannot see it clearly.

examples.en: The audio description told us what appeared on the sign between the lines of dialogue.
examples.zh: 两句台词之间，「口述影像」说明了标牌上出现的内容。

examples.en: Our campus cinema listed audio description alongside the other accessibility options in the program.
examples.zh: 校园影院在节目单上把「口述影像」和其他无障碍选项列在一起。

words.enDefinition: A separate recorded sound option that can be played with a video.

examples.en: I selected a different audio track because our guests wanted to hear the original voices.
examples.zh: 来做客的朋友想听原来的声音，我就换了一条「音轨」。

examples.en: The school archive listed the language of each audio track beside the restored film.
examples.zh: 学校档案馆在修复过的电影旁列出了每条「音轨」的语言。

words.enDefinition: an invitation to audition again after an initial tryout

examples.en: The audition callback arrived while I was waiting for the bus after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后等公交时，收到了「复试通知」。

examples.en: My roommate took the audition callback as a sign they liked her reading.
examples.zh: 室友收到「复试通知」，觉得他们大概喜欢她试镜时的朗读。

words.enDefinition: short sections of a script used by performers at an audition

examples.en: The audition sides for both main roles were on the theatre website.
examples.zh: 两个主要角色的「试镜用剧本选段」都在剧团网站上。

examples.en: My friend printed the audition sides before going to the rehearsal room.
examples.zh: 朋友去排练室之前，打印了「试镜用剧本选段」。

words.enDefinition: A setting that starts the following episode automatically when one episode finishes.

examples.en: I turned off “Autoplay next episode” because we had agreed to finish after one more.
examples.zh: 我们说好再看一集就结束，所以我关了「自动播放下一集」。

examples.en: My classmate found the autoplay next episode setting while looking for the subtitle controls.
examples.zh: 同学在找字幕设置时，发现了「自动播放下一集」选项。

words.enDefinition: Offered for online playback through a streaming service.

examples.en: The film was available to stream with subtitles, so our whole group could follow it.
examples.zh: 那部片「可在线播放」，还带字幕，因此我们整个小组都能看懂。

examples.en: We checked whether the short was available to stream after missing the screening on campus.
examples.zh: 错过学校的放映后，我们查了这部短片是否「可在线播放」。

collocations: check what is available to stream

words.enDefinition: a scheduled match that a team plays at the opponent's venue

examples.en: We travelled together for the away fixture at the college across the river.
examples.zh: 我们一起去河对岸的学院参加「客场比赛」。

examples.en: The team checked bus times before its away fixture on the last Saturday of term.
examples.zh: 学期最后一个周六有「客场比赛」，球队事先查了公交时刻。

words.enDefinition: the area reserved for people supporting the visiting team

examples.en: My cousin asked where the away supporters' section was before buying her ticket.
examples.zh: 表姐买票前问了「客队球迷区」在哪里。

examples.en: We could hear the away supporters' section from our seats near midfield.
examples.zh: 从靠近中场的座位上，我们能听到「客队球迷区」的声音。

collocations: sit in the away supporters' section
tickets for the away supporters' section

words.enDefinition: the less-promoted side of a single record or a track associated with that side

examples.en: My uncle played the B-side after showing me the label on the old single.
examples.zh: 叔叔给我看了旧单曲唱片的标签后，放了「单曲唱片反面曲目」。

examples.en: The band's B-side later became more popular than the song promoted at first.
examples.zh: 乐队的「单曲唱片反面曲目」后来比最开始推广的那首歌还火。

words.enDefinition: Film showings scheduled one immediately after another with little time between them.

examples.en: We missed dinner because we booked back-to-back screenings at the film festival that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚我们订了影展「紧接着的多场放映」，所以错过了晚饭。

examples.en: They scheduled back-to-back screenings of student documentaries in the small theater beside the library.
examples.zh: 他们在图书馆旁的小影院安排了学生纪录片「一场接一场放映」。

words.enDefinition: a shot played on the opposite side of the body from the racket hand

examples.en: My backhand went long when the ball came across the court too quickly.
examples.zh: 球横过球场来得太快，我的「反手击球」飞出了底线。

examples.en: I saw the player use a backhand from near the far corner of the court.
examples.zh: 我看见那名球员在球场远端角落附近打出一记「反手击球」。

words.enDefinition: singing that supports or complements the main singer's voice

examples.en: Two students sang backing vocals while their classmate sang the lead part onstage.
examples.zh: 同学在台上主唱，另外两名学生负责「伴唱」。

examples.en: I could hear the backing vocals more clearly on the new recording that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午听新录音时，我能更清楚地听见「伴唱」。

words.enDefinition: illumination coming from behind the subject of an image

examples.en: The backlighting made the leaves glow in the photograph I took.
examples.zh: 「逆光照明」让叶片在我拍的照片里显得透亮。

examples.en: I noticed the backlighting after moving to the other side of the table.
examples.zh: 挪到桌子另一边后，我才发现光线是「从背后打来的」。

words.enDefinition: an examination of bags before people may enter an event

examples.en: There was a bag check before people reached the ticket scanners.
examples.zh: 人们到门票扫码处之前，要先经过「入场验包」。

examples.en: The bag check moved quickly while we waited outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 我们在体育场外排队时，「入场验包」进行得很快。

words.enDefinition: a length of yarn wound into a round bundle

examples.en: A ball of yarn rolled under the chair during our craft session.
examples.zh: 手作活动中，一个「毛线团」滚到椅子下面了。

examples.en: I brought a second ball of yarn in case the first ran out.
examples.zh: 我又带了一个「毛线团」，以防第一个用完。

words.enDefinition: another member of the same band

examples.en: My bandmate suggested that we start with a quieter song at the open rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我的「乐队队友」建议公开排练时，我们先演一首安静一些的歌。

examples.en: An old bandmate came to the café to listen to our new set.
examples.zh: 一位过去的「乐队队友」来咖啡馆听我们新排的一组歌。

words.enDefinition: A long exercise bar with weights fixed or fitted at each end.

examples.en: The barbell was illustrated separately from the loose plates on the equipment map upstairs.
examples.zh: 楼上器械图把「杠铃」和散放的配重片分开画了出来。

examples.en: My friend asked what the word barbell meant when we saw it on the sign.
examples.zh: 看到标牌时，朋友问「杠铃」指的是什么器材。

words.enDefinition: An exercise class inspired by ballet that often uses a barre for support.

examples.en: My roommate signed up for a barre class during a free hour between lectures.
examples.zh: 室友趁两节课之间空出来的一个小时报名上了「芭蕾把杆健身课」。

examples.en: The student center described the barre class in a leaflet next to the fitness timetable.
examples.zh: 学生活动中心在健身课时间表旁放了份传单，介绍「芭蕾把杆健身课」。

collocations: sign up for a barre class

words.enDefinition: Describes a production that draws its main narrative from events that really happened.

examples.en: The film was based on a true story about students trying to save a library.
examples.zh: 这部片「根据真实故事改编」，讲一群学生设法保住一座图书馆。

examples.en: Our class discussed which details were invented for a drama based on a true story.
examples.zh: 我们班讨论了这部「根据真实故事改编」的剧情片有哪些虚构的细节。

collocations: a film based on a true story
a series based on a true story
loosely based on a true story

words.enDefinition: the boundary line at the back of a tennis court or similar playing area

examples.en: I watched the ball land close to the baseline in the late afternoon light.
examples.zh: 下午晚些时候的光线下，我看到球落在「球场底线」附近。

examples.en: The player waited just behind the baseline before returning the next serve that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，球员在「球场底线」后等着接下一个发球。

words.enDefinition: a musician who plays a bass instrument, often bass guitar

examples.en: The bass player changed the groove when the crowd began to dance.
examples.zh: 观众开始跳舞时，「贝斯手」改变了演奏的律动。

examples.en: Our new bass player used to perform in the university jazz group last year.
examples.zh: 我们的新「贝斯手」以前在大学爵士乐团演出。

words.enDefinition: the series of low notes forming the bass part of a piece

examples.en: The new bassline gave the slow song a rhythm that people could dance to.
examples.zh: 新的「低音声部旋律线」给这首慢歌加上了可以跳舞的节奏。

examples.en: We noticed the bassline most clearly after the drummer paused for a moment.
examples.zh: 鼓手暂时停下一会儿后，「低音声部旋律线」听得最清楚。

words.enDefinition: the order in which members of a baseball or softball team come up to bat

examples.en: I checked the batting order before walking to the bench beside the field.
examples.zh: 走去场边的替补席前，我看了「击球棒次」。

examples.en: The student coach posted our batting order before the softball game started in the park.
examples.zh: 公园里的垒球赛开始前，学生教练张贴了我们的「击球棒次」。

words.enDefinition: decorative work that uses beads attached or joined together

examples.en: My classmate started doing beadwork after seeing a display in the student centre.
examples.zh: 同学在学生中心看过展示后，开始做「串珠工艺」。

examples.en: The beadwork on her bracelet used different shapes in a repeated pattern.
examples.zh: 她手链上的「串珠工艺」用不同形状的珠子拼出了重复图案。

words.enDefinition: a moment when the full beat or bass enters strongly after a musical buildup

examples.en: The beat drop near the end brought the crowd back onto the dance floor.
examples.zh: 快结束时的「节拍骤入」让观众又回到了舞池。

examples.en: We could hear the beat drop from the hallway as we waited to go inside.
examples.zh: 我们在走廊等着进去，隔着墙也听见了「节拍骤入」。

words.enDefinition: A class designed to be easy for newcomers to follow.

examples.en: I looked for a beginner-friendly class because I had never taken a group fitness session.
examples.zh: 我没上过团体健身课，所以找的是「适合初学者的课」。

examples.en: The instructor described it as a beginner-friendly class when we asked about the schedule.
examples.zh: 我们问起时间表时，教练说这是门「适合初学者的课」。

words.enDefinition: a format in which the winner is determined by winning two of three games

examples.en: The table tennis club played best of three so everyone could finish before closing.
examples.zh: 乒乓球社采用「三局两胜」，这样关门前大家都能打完。

examples.en: We agreed to play best of three because we only had the court until six.
examples.zh: 球场只能用到六点，所以我们同意打「三局两胜」。

words.enDefinition: A cinema screen, often mentioned when talking about seeing a film in a theater.

examples.en: The quiet scenes felt different on the big screen from when I watched them at home.
examples.zh: 安静的场景放到「影院大银幕」上看，感受和我在家看时不一样。

examples.en: My classmate wanted to see the animated short on the big screen at least once.
examples.zh: 同学想至少在「影院大银幕」上看一次那部动画短片。

collocations: see it on the big screen
bring a story to the big screen

words.enDefinition: To watch many episodes of a series in one sitting or over a short period.

examples.en: We decided to binge-watch the series after handing in our last assignment of the term.
examples.zh: 交完这学期最后一份作业后，我们决定把这部剧「一口气连看多集」。

examples.en: I meant to watch one episode and ended up staying in to binge-watch the entire season.
examples.zh: 我原本只想看一集，最后留在家里把整季「一口气看完」了。

words.enDefinition: a handheld optical instrument for viewing distant things with both eyes

examples.en: I used binoculars to look at the birds across the pond.
examples.zh: 我用「双筒望远镜」看池塘对面的鸟。

examples.en: My classmate lent me her binoculars for the rest of the walk.
examples.zh: 接下来的散步里，同学把她的「双筒望远镜」借给了我。

words.enDefinition: A dramatized film about the life of a real person.

examples.en: The biopic focused on the musician's early years and only briefly showed her first major tour.
examples.zh: 这部「人物传记片」主要讲这位音乐人的早年，第一次大型巡演只是一笔带过。

examples.en: We compared the biopic with an interview the subject gave near the end of his career.
examples.zh: 我们把这部「人物传记片」和片中人物职业生涯末期的一次访谈作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a list for recording the bird species someone has seen

examples.en: I marked two species on my bird checklist before we headed home.
examples.zh: 回家前，我在「观鸟记录清单」上标记了两种鸟。

examples.en: The club shared a bird checklist for people who wanted to record sightings.
examples.zh: 社团给想记录所见鸟类的人分享了一份「观鸟记录清单」。

words.enDefinition: a shelter that screens people while they watch birds

examples.en: We sat quietly in the bird hide overlooking the little lake.
examples.zh: 我们安静地坐在俯瞰小湖的「隐蔽观鸟棚」里。

examples.en: The bird hide had a low window at the front for viewing.
examples.zh: 「隐蔽观鸟棚」前面有一扇较低的观察窗。

words.enDefinition: the calls or musical sounds made by birds

examples.en: We stopped talking when birdsong came from the trees behind us.
examples.zh: 身后的树上传来「鸟鸣」时，我们停下了说话。

examples.en: My phone recording caught birdsong along with the sound of the stream.
examples.zh: 我的手机录到了「鸟鸣」和溪水声。

words.enDefinition: observing birds as a hobby

examples.en: I tried birdwatching with my roommate during a quiet morning in the park.
examples.zh: 公园里一个安静的早晨，我和室友试着「观鸟」。

examples.en: The library invited a local volunteer to talk about birdwatching near campus.
examples.zh: 图书馆邀请了一名当地志愿者，聊聊学校附近的「观鸟」活动。

words.enDefinition: An ending that feels sad and satisfying or hopeful at the same time.

examples.en: The film had a bittersweet ending when the roommates said goodbye and moved to different cities.
examples.zh: 室友们道别后搬往不同城市，电影用了个「苦乐参半的结局」。

examples.en: I kept thinking about the bittersweet ending even after we had left the cinema.
examples.zh: 离开影院后，我还一直想着那个「苦乐参半的结局」。

collocations: give a film a bittersweet ending
a film with a bittersweet ending

words.enDefinition: a simple performance space with flexible arrangements for staging and seating

examples.en: The audience sat very close to the actors in the black box theatre.
examples.zh: 在「黑匣子剧场」里，观众坐得离演员很近。

examples.en: We chose the black box theatre because we wanted to change the seating layout.
examples.zh: 我们选了「黑匣子剧场」，因为想改动座位布局。

collocations: perform in a black box theatre

words.enDefinition: rows of raised benches for spectators, especially in North America

examples.en: We sat on the bleachers behind the school baseball field.
examples.zh: 我们坐在学校棒球场后面的「阶梯式长凳看台」上。

examples.en: The metal bleachers felt cold by the second half of the match.
examples.zh: 比赛进行到下半场时，金属的「阶梯式长凳看台」摸起来已经很凉。

words.enDefinition: the planned positions and movements of performers during a scene

examples.en: We changed the blocking so that both actors could be seen.
examples.zh: 我们调整了「舞台走位」，让观众能看见两位演员。

examples.en: The director added new blocking for the scene with the long table.
examples.zh: 导演为有长桌的那场戏加了新的「舞台走位」。

words.enDefinition: a music tradition developed by African Americans that commonly uses distinctive forms and expressive notes

examples.en: The campus radio show introduced blues alongside short interviews with local guitar players.
examples.zh: 校园电台节目介绍了「布鲁斯音乐」，还放了几段对本地吉他手的简短采访。

examples.en: I started listening to blues after borrowing an old record from my uncle.
examples.zh: 向叔叔借了一张老唱片后，我开始听「布鲁斯音乐」。

words.enDefinition: a café where customers can sit and play tabletop games

examples.en: We met at a board game café after our last seminar.
examples.zh: 最后一节研讨课结束后，我们在一家「桌游咖啡馆」见面。

examples.en: The board game café had a shelf for short games and another for longer ones.
examples.zh: 「桌游咖啡馆」有个架子放耗时短的游戏，另一个架子放耗时长的。

collocations: meet at a board game café

words.enDefinition: a game played with pieces or markers on a board

examples.en: We borrowed a board game from the residence desk on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五我们去宿舍前台借了一款「棋盘类桌游」。

examples.en: The board game fit on the little table next to the window.
examples.zh: 这款「棋盘类桌游」放得下窗边的小桌子。

words.enDefinition: An exercise that uses the person's own body weight as its main resistance.

examples.en: The class description mentioned a bodyweight exercise as one of the activities on the schedule.
examples.zh: 课程介绍提到，其中一项活动是「自重练习」。

examples.en: I asked what bodyweight exercise meant after seeing the phrase next to several activities.
examples.zh: 我在几项活动旁看到「自重练习」这个词，就问它是什么意思。

collocations: a description of a bodyweight exercise

words.enDefinition: a track added beyond the main sequence on a particular edition of a release

examples.en: The digital edition included a bonus track from the band's first rehearsal at college.
examples.zh: 数字版附了一首乐队在学院第一次排练时录下的「额外收录曲目」。

examples.en: I bought the new edition because I had never heard the bonus track before.
examples.zh: 我以前没听过「额外收录曲目」，所以买了新版。

words.enDefinition: To reserve a place in a particular class before attending.

examples.en: I asked where to book a spot in class before inviting my roommate to join.
examples.zh: 邀请室友参加之前，我问了到哪里「预订课程名额」。

examples.en: Could you book a spot in class for yourself before we meet at the gym?
examples.zh: 我们在健身房碰头之前，你能先给自己「预订课程名额」吗？

collocations: ask how to book a spot in class
book a spot in class online
try to book a spot in class

words.enDefinition: a group that meets to talk about books its members read

examples.en: I joined a book club that meets after our Tuesday classes.
examples.zh: 我加入了一个「读书会」，每周二下课后见面。

examples.en: The book club chose a short novel for the exam season.
examples.zh: 「读书会」为考试季选了一本篇幅不长的小说。

words.enDefinition: a suggestion for something worthwhile to read

examples.en: I asked a friend for a book recommendation before the break.
examples.zh: 放假前，我找朋友要了一条「书籍推荐」。

examples.en: The book recommendation came from someone in my photography group.
examples.zh: 这条「书籍推荐」来自摄影小组的一位成员。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for arranging or processing a ticket booking

examples.en: The booking page added a booking fee before showing the total price.
examples.zh: 订票页面显示总价前，加上了「订票手续费」。

examples.en: We checked the booking fee before deciding which match to attend together.
examples.zh: 决定一起去看哪场比赛前，我们查了「订票手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a garden that grows collections of plants for study, display or conservation

examples.en: We visited the botanical garden to make sketches between our classes.
examples.zh: 我们趁课间去「植物园」画了几张速写。

examples.en: The botanical garden had small signs with names beside the plants.
examples.zh: 「植物园」在植物旁边放了些写有名字的小牌子。

words.enDefinition: a player who delivers the ball to the batter in cricket

examples.en: The bowler walked back to her mark while our team watched from the boundary.
examples.zh: 「板球投球手」走回她的起投点，我们队在边界旁看着。

examples.en: Our new bowler met the rest of the cricket team before the afternoon match.
examples.zh: 下午比赛前，我们新的「板球投球手」和板球队其他队员见了面。

words.enDefinition: a place at a venue where tickets are sold or collected

examples.en: We went to the box office before the evening basketball game.
examples.zh: 晚上篮球赛前，我们去了「场馆售票处」。

examples.en: My friend checked whether the box office could print her ticket there.
examples.zh: 朋友问「场馆售票处」能不能现场把她的票打印出来。

collocations: collect tickets from the box office

words.enDefinition: To begin to sweat because of physical activity.

examples.en: I didn't break a sweat during the short walk around the indoor track today.
examples.zh: 我今天在室内跑道上走了没多久，连「出汗」都没有。

examples.en: My roommate said she started to break a sweat halfway through the lunchtime class.
examples.zh: 室友说午间课上到一半，她就「开始出汗」了。

words.enDefinition: a tennis point that gives the receiving player a chance to win the server's game

examples.en: Our teammate saved a break point before holding her serve in the opening set.
examples.zh: 队友首盘挽救了一个「破发点」，保住了自己的发球局。

examples.en: The return went long when he had break point late in the second set.
examples.zh: 第二盘后段他拿到「破发点」时，回球出了底线。

words.enDefinition: to acknowledge the audience or acknowledge that the story is fictional

examples.en: The student director wanted to break the fourth wall without changing the original ending.
examples.zh: 学生导演想在保留原结局的情况下「打破第四面墙」。

examples.en: We decided to break the fourth wall by having a character notice the applause.
examples.zh: 我们让一个角色意识到台下有人鼓掌，以此「打破第四面墙」。

collocations: choose to break the fourth wall
use a joke to break the fourth wall
actors who break the fourth wall

words.enDefinition: a contrasting section connecting or separating familiar parts of a song

examples.en: The bridge section changed key before the band went back to the familiar chorus.
examples.zh: 乐队回到熟悉的副歌之前，「歌曲的过渡段」转了调。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the bridge section felt calmer than the rest of the song.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「歌曲的过渡段」比其他部分听起来更平静。

words.enDefinition: A facility notice asking visitors to provide a towel for their own use.

examples.en: The room description said “Bring your own towel” beside the list of items provided.
examples.zh: 房间说明在已提供的物品清单旁写着「请自带毛巾」。

examples.en: I saw “Bring your own towel” on the studio door before our first class.
examples.zh: 第一次上课前，我在团课教室门上看到了「请自带毛巾」。

collocations: a sign saying bring your own towel
a notice reading bring your own towel
ask guests to bring their own towel

words.enDefinition: a visible mark left by moving a paintbrush across a surface

examples.en: I could still see each brushstroke when the paint was dry.
examples.zh: 颜料干了之后，我还能看见每一道「笔触」。

examples.en: The teacher used a broad brushstroke to suggest the shape of a cloud.
examples.zh: 老师用一道宽宽的「笔触」画出云朵的大致形状。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen cue showing which button to press

examples.en: I waited until the button prompt appeared beside the puzzle piece.
examples.zh: 我等到拼图块旁出现「按键提示」才操作。

examples.en: The button prompt changed when I switched from the keyboard to a gamepad.
examples.zh: 我从键盘换到手柄后，「按键提示」变了。

words.enDefinition: a successful shot released just before the buzzer ends a period of play

examples.en: The buzzer beater tied the score just as our friends were about to leave.
examples.zh: 朋友们刚准备走，一个「压哨命中」把比分扳平了。

examples.en: The campus channel replayed the buzzer beater at the end of its evening highlights.
examples.zh: 校园频道在晚间集锦的结尾重放了那个「压哨命中」。

words.enDefinition: A gym machine that transfers resistance through a cable and pulley system.

examples.en: The tour paused beside a cable machine while students asked about the labels on it.
examples.zh: 参观时我们在一台「绳索训练器械」旁停下来，同学们问了上面的标签。

examples.en: There were several empty stations around the cable machine before the afternoon class began.
examples.zh: 下午课开始前，「绳索训练器械」周围还有几个空的训练位。

collocations: a handle on the cable machine
a label beside the cable machine

words.enDefinition: to request a temporary break during play under the rules of the game

examples.en: Our coach decided to call a timeout after the team lost its lead.
examples.zh: 球队失去领先后，教练决定「叫暂停」。

examples.en: The captain asked the coach to call a timeout late in the fourth quarter.
examples.zh: 第四节接近尾声时，队长请教练「叫暂停」。

words.enDefinition: to ask for the next words after forgetting part of a script

examples.en: We could call for a line if we got stuck during the first rehearsal.
examples.zh: 第一次排练卡住时，我们可以「忘词时请人提示」。

examples.en: I heard my scene partner call for a line and waited before moving across the stage.
examples.zh: 我听见搭档「忘词请人提示」，就等了一下再走到舞台另一边。

collocations: need to call for a line
remember to call for a line
hear someone call for a line

words.enDefinition: the time when performers or crew are expected to arrive

examples.en: Our call time was before lunch, so we brought snacks with us.
examples.zh: 「规定到场时间」在午饭前，所以我们带了些零食。

examples.en: I asked the stage manager whether the call time had been changed.
examples.zh: 我问舞台监督，「规定到场时间」有没有改。

words.enDefinition: how quickly the game view responds to camera control inputs

examples.en: I lowered the camera sensitivity so I could look around more gradually.
examples.zh: 我调低了「视角灵敏度」，这样转动视角时可以慢一点。

examples.en: My friend checked the camera sensitivity after borrowing my controller for the round.
examples.zh: 朋友这轮借用我的手柄后，查看了「视角灵敏度」。

words.enDefinition: A university facility for recreational exercise, sports, or other activities.

examples.en: We stopped at the campus recreation center before our evening class to look around.
examples.zh: 我们在上晚课前顺路去了「校园文体活动中心」，在里面转了转。

examples.en: My roommate works at the campus recreation center between her morning and afternoon lectures.
examples.zh: 室友在上午课和下午课之间到「校园文体活动中心」打工。

collocations: a class at the campus recreation center

words.expression: can I join the next round
words.lemma: can i join the next round
words.enDefinition: a question asking to start playing in the following round
acceptedEnVariants: can I join the next round

examples.en: “Can I join the next round?” I asked after seeing the board.
examples.zh: 看了看棋盘后，我问「下一轮我能加入吗？」

examples.en: My roommate arrived late and asked, “Can I join the next round?”
examples.zh: 室友来晚了，问「下一轮我能加入吗？」

collocations: ask “Can I join the next round?”
“Can I join the next round after dinner?”
“Do you think I can join the next round?”

words.enDefinition: a photograph showing someone acting naturally rather than posing

examples.en: She kept the candid photo of us laughing after the workshop.
examples.zh: 她留下了活动结束后我们大笑的那张「自然抓拍照」。

examples.en: My friend asked if I liked the candid photo she had taken.
examples.zh: 朋友问我喜不喜欢她拍的那张「自然抓拍照」。

collocations: share a candid photo with permission

words.enDefinition: a show that displays spoken words and relevant sounds as text

examples.en: We chose the captioned performance so we could read the dialogue as well.
examples.zh: 我们选了「带字幕的演出」，这样也能读到台词。

examples.en: The theatre marked the captioned performance with a small symbol in the programme.
examples.zh: 剧场在节目册里用一个小符号标出了「带字幕的演出」。

words.enDefinition: a protective cover that fits over an individual card

examples.en: My roommate slid the worn card into a clear card sleeve.
examples.zh: 室友把那张磨旧的牌放进一个透明「牌套」。

examples.en: I brought an extra card sleeve for the bent reference card.
examples.zh: 我多带了一个「牌套」，留给那张弯了的速查卡。

collocations: put a card in a card sleeve

words.enDefinition: The part of a gym with equipment for cardiovascular exercise.

examples.en: We found the cardio area upstairs after passing the desk beside the main entrance.
examples.zh: 经过正门旁的服务台后，我们在楼上找到了「有氧器械区」。

examples.en: The gym moved its cardio area to the side of the room with more windows.
examples.zh: 健身房把「有氧器械区」挪到了房间窗户更多的那一侧。

collocations: a map of the cardio area

words.enDefinition: Gym machines intended for exercises such as indoor cycling, walking, or rowing.

examples.en: The building map showed most of the cardio equipment along the wall by the windows.
examples.zh: 楼宇地图显示，大部分「有氧运动器械」沿着窗边的一面墙摆放。

examples.en: We passed the cardio equipment on our way to ask about the group classes.
examples.zh: 我们去问团课的路上经过了「有氧运动器械」。

words.enDefinition: An exercise session that mainly raises breathing and heart rate through sustained movement.

examples.en: My watch logged a cardio workout after I got back from the indoor track.
examples.zh: 我从室内跑道回来后，手表记录了「一次有氧锻炼」。

examples.en: I wrote down how the cardio workout felt while I waited for my friend.
examples.zh: 我一边等朋友，一边记下这次「有氧锻炼」的感受。

words.enDefinition: paper that is noticeably thicker and stiffer than ordinary paper

examples.en: I used cardstock so the handmade card would stand upright on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我用了「厚卡纸」，这样手工卡片能立在架子上。

examples.en: There was enough blue cardstock for everyone to make two bookmarks.
examples.zh: 蓝色「厚卡纸」够每个人做两张书签。

words.enDefinition: a list showing who has been chosen to perform each role

examples.en: We refreshed the page until the cast list appeared after our auditions.
examples.zh: 试镜结束后，我们不断刷新页面，直到「演员名单」公布。

examples.en: The cast list included students from the music department and the drama club.
examples.zh: 「演员名单」里既有音乐系的学生，也有戏剧社的成员。

words.enDefinition: to secure the final row of a knitted piece

examples.en: I asked my friend how to cast off at the end.
examples.zh: 织到最后时，我问朋友怎么「棒针收针」。

examples.en: The guide said to cast off after the last repeat of the pattern.
examples.zh: 指南说，织完最后一组重复花样后要「棒针收针」。

words.enDefinition: to make the first set of loops on knitting needles

examples.en: I watched my roommate cast on before she began her first row.
examples.zh: 室友织第一行之前，我看她「棒针起针」。

examples.en: The tutor showed us how many stitches to cast on for the scarf.
examples.zh: 老师给我们演示了织这条围巾时「棒针起针」要起几针。

words.enDefinition: a recording of songs from a stage musical performed by a particular cast

examples.en: I borrowed a cast recording after we discussed the musical in our seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课讨论那部音乐剧之后，我借来了一张「音乐剧演员版录音」。

examples.en: The cast recording featured a singer who later gave a talk at our university.
examples.zh: 「音乐剧演员版录音」中有一位歌手，后来到我们学校做过讲座。

words.enDefinition: an announcement asking performers to audition for roles in a production

examples.en: I saw a casting call for the student musical outside the rehearsal room.
examples.zh: 我在排练室外看到那部学生音乐剧的「演员招募通告」。

examples.en: The casting call asked for people who had never acted onstage before.
examples.zh: 「演员招募通告」面向以前没上台演过戏的人。

words.enDefinition: a play option without formal competitive ranking

examples.en: We picked casual mode because two of my flatmates were still learning.
examples.zh: 有两个室友还在学怎么玩，我们选了「休闲模式」。

examples.en: The host explained that casual mode didn't affect our regular competitive rankings.
examples.zh: 房主解释，在「休闲模式」里玩不影响我们平时的竞技排名。

words.enDefinition: To watch the episodes you have missed so that you are up to date.

examples.en: I used the long weekend to catch up on a series my roommates were already discussing.
examples.zh: 我趁小长假把那部剧「补看」完，室友们已经在讨论它了。

examples.en: My friend wanted to catch up on a series before joining our lunchtime discussion about it.
examples.zh: 朋友想先「补看落下的剧集」，再参加我们午饭时的讨论。

collocations: try to catch up on a series
take the weekend to catch up on a series
find time to catch up on a series

words.enDefinition: a melody that is easy to remember and likely to stay in your mind

examples.en: The film used a catchy tune that we hummed all the way home.
examples.zh: 电影用了一段「好记上口的曲调」，我们一路哼着回家。

examples.en: My friend wrote a catchy tune for the university's short video last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，朋友为学校的短视频写了一段「好记上口的曲调」。

words.enDefinition: the circle drawn at the midpoint of a sports playing area

examples.en: The players gathered inside the centre circle before the first kick of the game.
examples.zh: 比赛第一脚球开出前，队员们聚在「球场中圈」里。

examples.en: We could see the centre circle from our place halfway up the stands.
examples.zh: 我们坐在看台中段的位置，能看到「球场中圈」。

words.enDefinition: music composed for a small group of players, usually with one player to each part

examples.en: We listened to chamber music played by three students in the campus recital room.
examples.zh: 我们在学校的小演奏厅听了三位学生演出的「室内乐」。

examples.en: The music club chose chamber music for the quieter space near the library.
examples.zh: 音乐社为图书馆附近较安静的场所选了「室内乐」。

words.enDefinition: The course of a character's development or change across a story.

examples.en: Her character arc made sense once we saw how she handled the final setback.
examples.zh: 看到她怎么应对最后一次挫折，我们就理解了她的「角色变化轨迹」。

examples.en: Our film club discussed the character arc of the quietest person in the story.
examples.zh: 我们电影社讨论了故事里最沉默的那个人的「角色变化轨迹」。

words.enDefinition: setting the traits or appearance of a new playable character

examples.en: I spent most of the break on character creation with my roommate.
examples.zh: 我和室友把休息时间的大半都用来「创建角色」了。

examples.en: The game offered more hairstyles during character creation than I expected.
examples.zh: 「角色创建」时，游戏提供的发型比我预想的多。

collocations: customise a look during character creation

words.enDefinition: the way a character's personality or motivations are revealed over time

examples.en: I thought the character development was strongest in the quieter second act.
examples.zh: 我觉得比较安静的第二幕「角色塑造」做得最好。

examples.en: We talked about character development after watching two versions of the same play.
examples.zh: 看完同一部剧的两个版本后，我们讨论了「角色塑造」。

words.enDefinition: the screen or stage where each player picks a character

examples.en: We were still on the character selection screen when my friend found the other controller.
examples.zh: 朋友找到另一个手柄时，我们还在「角色选择界面」。

examples.en: The music on the character selection screen stopped when everyone confirmed their choice.
examples.zh: 每个人确认选择后，「角色选择界面」的音乐停了。

collocations: return to the character selection screen
wait on the character selection screen

words.enDefinition: a pencil with a charcoal core that makes dark marks

examples.en: I tried a charcoal pencil for the darker areas of the portrait.
examples.zh: 我试着用「炭笔」画了肖像的暗部。

examples.en: My classmate used a charcoal pencil to draw the trees against the bright sky.
examples.zh: 同学用「炭笔」画出了明亮天空下的树木。

words.enDefinition: To tell the person leading the class that you have arrived to attend.

examples.en: The desk staff told us where to check in with the instructor when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到时，服务台工作人员告诉我们到哪里「向教练签到」。

examples.en: I had time to fill my bottle before I needed to check in with the instructor.
examples.zh: 我在需要「向教练签到」之前，还有时间把水瓶装满。

collocations: ask where to check in with the instructor
check in with the instructor at the door
wait to check in with the instructor

words.enDefinition: a point in a level from which play can be resumed

examples.en: The game took us back to the checkpoint near the blue bridge.
examples.zh: 游戏把我们带回了蓝桥附近的「关卡检查点」。

examples.en: I was glad we reached a checkpoint before we had to pause.
examples.zh: 不得不暂停之前，我们到了一个「关卡检查点」，这让我松了口气。

collocations: go back to the last checkpoint

words.enDefinition: to encourage participants while watching from a spectator area

examples.en: My classmates stayed to cheer from the stands until the final race ended.
examples.zh: 同学们留下来「在看台上欢呼助威」，直到最后一场比赛结束。

examples.en: I couldn't play, but I was happy to cheer from the stands that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午我不能上场，但很乐意「在看台上欢呼助威」。

collocations: come and cheer from the stands
stay to cheer from the stands
want to cheer from the stands

words.enDefinition: someone who creates and organises movement for a dance or performance

examples.en: The choreographer gave the two dancers different steps for the final section.
examples.zh: 「编舞」给两位舞者在最后一段安排了不同的舞步。

examples.en: Our choreographer asked us to practise the movement without music first.
examples.zh: 我们的「编舞」让我们先不放音乐练一练动作。

words.enDefinition: the recurring main section that usually follows a verse

examples.en: Our friends could sing the chorus of the song before learning the verses.
examples.zh: 朋友们还没学会各段主歌，就已经能唱「歌曲副歌」了。

examples.en: I recognised the chorus of the song after hearing just a few notes.
examples.zh: 只听到几个音，我就认出了「歌曲副歌」。

collocations: sing the chorus of the song
repeat the chorus of the song
learn the chorus of the song

words.enDefinition: A class where participants rotate among different exercise stations or activities.

examples.en: The circuit class was listed in the smaller studio next to the indoor track.
examples.zh: 时间表写着，「循环训练课」在室内跑道旁的小教室上。

examples.en: My classmate asked the instructor what equipment would be available for the circuit class.
examples.zh: 同学问教练，「循环训练课」会有哪些器材可用。

collocations: a circuit class with several stations

words.enDefinition: to request and secure a ticket from an allocation for students

examples.en: I planned to claim a student ticket as soon as my lab session ended.
examples.zh: 我打算实验课一结束就「领取学生门票」。

examples.en: The email explained how to claim a student ticket for the next home game.
examples.zh: 邮件说明了下一场主场比赛如何「领取学生门票」。

collocations: claim a student ticket in advance
eligible to claim a student ticket

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that a class has reached its maximum number of participants.

examples.en: The booking page showed “Class at capacity” beside the session my roommate had recommended.
examples.zh: 报名页面在室友推荐的那节课旁显示「课程人数已满」。

examples.en: We saw “Class at capacity” and looked for another session on the studio timetable.
examples.zh: 我们看到「课程人数已满」，就去团课时间表找其他场次。

words.enDefinition: The way a class is arranged and the kinds of activities it includes.

examples.en: We read about the class format before deciding which session to try that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们先了解了「课程组织形式」，再决定当天下午试哪一节。

examples.en: The instructor explained the class format while everyone was still getting settled in the room.
examples.zh: 大家还在教室里安顿时，教练介绍了「课程组织形式」。

collocations: a change to the class format

words.enDefinition: a result in which a team or goalkeeper completes a game without conceding a goal

examples.en: Our goalkeeper kept a clean sheet in her first game for the team.
examples.zh: 我们的守门员第一次为球队参赛就「一球未失」。

examples.en: The club's third clean sheet of the month came in a difficult away match.
examples.zh: 俱乐部当月第三次「一球未失」是在一场艰难的客场比赛中。

words.enDefinition: a version of a song with explicit language or content removed or replaced

examples.en: The teacher selected the clean version when she played the track in class.
examples.zh: 老师在课上放那首歌时，选了「删除不雅词语的版本」。

examples.en: I found the clean version in the playlist supplied by the campus radio team.
examples.zh: 我在校园电台团队提供的歌单里找到了「删除不雅词语的版本」。

words.enDefinition: venue rules requiring some or all bags to be transparent

examples.en: The stadium's website explained its clear bag policy before the student game.
examples.zh: 球赛前，体育场网站说明了它的「入场透明包规定」。

examples.en: My friend had a question about the clear bag policy at that venue.
examples.zh: 朋友对那个场馆的「入场透明包规定」有个问题。

words.enDefinition: a view that lets spectators see the activity without obstructions

examples.en: The seat behind the railing still had a clear sightline to the court.
examples.zh: 栏杆后的座位看球场仍然有「无遮挡视线」。

examples.en: I wanted a clear sightline because it was my first live game.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次到现场看球，我想选个「无遮挡视线」的座位。

collocations: find a seat with a clear sightline

words.enDefinition: An ending that leaves an important event unresolved so viewers want to know what happens next.

examples.en: The episode ended on a cliffhanger just as the main character was about to read the letter.
examples.zh: 主角刚要读信，这一集就用了个「悬念式结尾」。

examples.en: We complained about the cliffhanger because the next episode would not arrive until the following week.
examples.zh: 下一集得等到下周才出，我们就抱怨这个「悬念式结尾」。

words.enDefinition: an image tightly framed around a subject or detail

examples.en: I took a close-up shot of the pattern on the leaf.
examples.zh: 我给叶片上的纹路拍了一张「特写照片」。

examples.en: The close-up shot showed details I hadn't noticed on the door handle.
examples.zh: 「特写照片」拍出了门把手上我没注意到的细节。

collocations: a close-up shot of a detail

words.enDefinition: Shoes intended for exercise that cover the toes.

examples.en: Our recreation center's poster listed closed-toe athletic shoes for entry to the main gym area.
examples.zh: 校园文体中心的海报写着，进主健身区要穿「包脚趾的运动鞋」。

examples.en: I asked whether my usual closed-toe athletic shoes were allowed in the new studio.
examples.zh: 我问平时穿的「包脚趾的运动鞋」能不能穿进新开的团课教室。

collocations: a rule about closed-toe athletic shoes

words.enDefinition: The names of the people and organizations involved in a production shown at the end.

examples.en: We stayed for the closing credits because my classmate's sister had worked on the film.
examples.zh: 同学的姐姐参与过这部片，我们就留下来看了「片尾演职员表」。

examples.en: The song over the closing credits sounded familiar, but I could not remember its title.
examples.zh: 「片尾演职员表」出现时放的歌听着耳熟，不过我想不起歌名。

collocations: a song over the closing credits

words.enDefinition: the final song or piece played during a musical performance

examples.en: The whole band returned to the stage for the closing number after the singer's solo.
examples.zh: 歌手独唱结束后，全乐队回到台上表演「收尾曲目」。

examples.en: We recorded part of the closing number with the performers' permission from the side.
examples.zh: 征得表演者同意后，我们从侧面录了一段「收尾曲目」。

words.enDefinition: the final public performance in a series of shows

examples.en: I booked for the closing performance because my sister was visiting then.
examples.zh: 我订了「收官演出」的票，因为妹妹那时会来。

examples.en: The director thanked the student volunteers after the closing performance that evening.
examples.zh: 当晚「收官演出」结束后，导演向学生志愿者致谢。

collocations: final bow at the closing performance

words.zhGloss: 带额外服务的高级座位
words.enDefinition: premium seats that may include access to special facilities or services
acceptedZhAnswers: 带额外服务的高级座位

examples.en: His parents had club seats near a lounge for ticket holders.
examples.zh: 他父母坐的是「带额外服务的高级座位」，附近有供持票人使用的休息室。

examples.en: The map showed where the club seats were in the new arena.
examples.zh: 地图上标出了新体育馆里「带额外服务的高级座位」的位置。

words.enDefinition: a game in which players work toward a shared goal

examples.en: Our group picked a co-op game that was easy for newcomers to learn.
examples.zh: 我们小组选了一个新手也容易学会的「合作游戏」。

examples.en: I enjoyed the co-op game because we talked through each puzzle together.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这个「合作游戏」，因为每道谜题我们都一起商量。

words.enDefinition: a reading from a script without time to practise first

examples.en: I did a cold read from a scene they handed me at the door.
examples.zh: 他们在门口递给我一场戏的剧本，我当场做了一次「无准备试读」。

examples.en: For my cold read, they gave me part of an unfamiliar student play.
examples.zh: 「无准备试读」时，他们给了我一段从没读过的学生剧本。

words.enDefinition: an option making on-screen objects easier to distinguish with colour vision differences

examples.en: I tried colour-blind mode because the tiles used similar shades of green.
examples.zh: 几种方块用了很接近的绿色，我就试了「色觉辅助模式」。

examples.en: The game added shapes to the markers when I selected colour-blind mode.
examples.zh: 我选了「色觉辅助模式」后，游戏给标记加上了不同形状。

words.enDefinition: the range of colours selected for a particular image or project

examples.en: I wanted a simple colour palette for the painting by my desk.
examples.zh: 我想给书桌旁要挂的那幅画用一套简单的「配色方案」。

examples.en: My roommate chose a colour palette based on an old postcard.
examples.zh: 室友参考一张旧明信片选了「配色方案」。

words.enDefinition: a pencil with a coloured core used for drawing

examples.en: I used a coloured pencil to add blue marks along the border.
examples.zh: 我用一支「彩色铅笔」在边缘加了些蓝色线条。

examples.en: I chose a coloured pencil that would show clearly against the grey paper.
examples.zh: 我挑了一支在灰纸上显色清楚的「彩色铅笔」。

words.enDefinition: using pace and pauses to make a performance funnier

examples.en: Her comedic timing made a simple story about the bus surprisingly funny.
examples.zh: 她的「喜剧节奏把握」得很好，把一个简单的公交故事讲得意外好笑。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how comedic timing could change the effect of the last line.
examples.zh: 老师讲了「喜剧节奏把握」如何改变最后一句台词的效果。

words.enDefinition: a prepared series of jokes or routines performed as one piece

examples.en: My roommate practised a five-minute comedy set before the student show.
examples.zh: 学生公演前，室友练了一段五分钟的「喜剧表演」。

examples.en: We heard a comedy set about getting lost on a huge campus.
examples.zh: 我们听了一段在大校园里迷路的「喜剧表演」。

words.enDefinition: A speed of movement that feels manageable to the person doing the activity.

examples.en: I noted a comfortable pace in my activity log after our walk on the track.
examples.zh: 在跑道走完后，我在活动日志里记下了这次「舒服的速度」。

examples.en: We found a comfortable pace on the track and carried on chatting about class.
examples.zh: 我们在跑道上找到了「舒服的速度」，接着聊起上课的事。

words.enDefinition: A film about a young person growing into a more mature self.

examples.en: The coming-of-age film followed a student figuring out what to do after leaving home.
examples.zh: 这部「成长题材电影」讲的是一名学生离开家后如何摸索接下来的路。

examples.en: My roommate called it a coming-of-age film about finding your place in a new city.
examples.zh: 室友说这是一部「成长题材电影」，讲的是如何在新城市找到自己的位置。

collocations: a coming-of-age film set in a small town

words.enDefinition: theatre made by and for people living in a local community

examples.en: I met some local actors through community theatre during my first summer here.
examples.zh: 来这里的第一个夏天，我通过「社区戏剧」认识了一些本地演员。

examples.en: Our campus group collaborated with community theatre volunteers on a short performance.
examples.zh: 我们学校的社团和「社区戏剧」的志愿者合作演了一出短剧。

words.enDefinition: a seat for someone accompanying a person using accessible seating

examples.en: I asked whether my companion seat was next to the wheelchair space.
examples.zh: 我问自己的「陪同人员座位」是不是挨着轮椅观赛位。

examples.en: A companion seat was marked beside each accessible spot on the map.
examples.zh: 地图在每个无障碍位置旁都标出了「陪同人员座位」。

words.enDefinition: the rules that determine how contestants progress and how a winner is chosen

examples.en: The organizers changed the competition format so each team would play at least twice.
examples.zh: 主办方调整了「赛制」，让每支队伍至少打两场。

examples.en: The competition format was posted beside the registration desk before the teams arrived.
examples.zh: 各队到场前，「赛制」就张贴在了登记处旁边。

words.enDefinition: an album collecting previously separate recordings by one artist or several artists

examples.en: The campus radio played a track from a compilation album of local performers.
examples.zh: 校园电台播放了一张本地表演者「合辑」里的曲目。

examples.en: I found the song on a compilation album while browsing the used record shop.
examples.zh: 我逛二手唱片店时，在一张「合辑」上找到了这首歌。

words.enDefinition: a ticket provided at no charge by an event organiser

examples.en: I received a complimentary ticket after volunteering at an earlier match.
examples.zh: 我在之前一场比赛当过志愿者，后来收到一张「赠票」。

examples.en: The organisers issued a complimentary ticket to each student performer that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，主办方给每位学生表演者发了一张「赠票」。

words.enDefinition: an album whose songs are linked by a theme, story, or idea

examples.en: My flatmate played the concept album from start to finish on the long train ride.
examples.zh: 长途火车上，室友把那张「概念专辑」从头到尾放了一遍。

examples.en: In class we discussed how the last track developed the idea behind the concept album.
examples.zh: 课上我们讨论了最后一首曲子怎样深化「概念专辑」的主题。

words.enDefinition: a building or large room designed for musical performances

examples.en: We walked to the concert hall after meeting our classmates at the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站和同学碰头后，步行去了「音乐厅」。

examples.en: The concert hall was much quieter than the festival stage across the street.
examples.zh: 「音乐厅」比街对面节庆活动的舞台安静得多。

words.enDefinition: a small outlet selling snacks and drinks to people at events

examples.en: We stopped at a concession stand for water before finding our seats.
examples.zh: 找座位之前，我们先去「场馆餐饮售卖摊」买了水。

examples.en: The concession stand by our section closed just after the final whistle.
examples.zh: 终场哨响后没多久，我们观众区旁的「场馆餐饮售卖摊」就关了。

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing star patterns and their positions in the sky

examples.en: I borrowed a constellation chart for our evening of stargazing in the park.
examples.zh: 我们晚上要去公园观星，我就借了一张「星座图」。

examples.en: My classmate checked the constellation chart after pointing to two bright stars.
examples.zh: 同学指了两颗亮星，然后对照了一下「星座图」。

words.enDefinition: growing plants in pots or other containers above ground

examples.en: I tried container gardening because our student flat had no yard.
examples.zh: 我们学生公寓没有院子，所以我试了「容器园艺」。

examples.en: The workshop on container gardening used herbs from the residence balcony.
examples.zh: 「容器园艺」工作坊用了宿舍阳台种的香草。

words.enDefinition: a style of dance that explores varied, expressive movement

examples.en: I watched a contemporary dance performance arranged by the university's arts department.
examples.zh: 我看了学校艺术系安排的一场「当代舞」演出。

examples.en: The class used contemporary dance to explore movement in small spaces.
examples.zh: 课上，同学们用「当代舞」探索如何在小空间里活动身体。

words.enDefinition: A notice describing potentially upsetting or sensitive material in a film or program.

examples.en: The organizer read a content warning before playing the documentary in the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 纪录片在阶梯教室开播前，组织者念了一则「内容提醒」。

examples.en: I read the content warning before deciding whether to join my flatmates for the screening.
examples.zh: 和室友一起去看放映之前，我先读了「内容提醒」再决定要不要去。

words.enDefinition: A player or service label for items someone has started and can pick back up.

examples.en: The film appeared in the “Continue Watching” row when we came back from our evening class.
examples.zh: 我们上完晚课回来时，这部片出现在「继续观看栏」。

examples.en: I opened “Continue Watching” to find the episode we had started the night before.
examples.zh: 我打开「继续观看栏」，找前一天晚上开始看的那一集。

words.enDefinition: An accidental inconsistency between shots or scenes meant to show continuous action.

examples.en: I spotted a continuity error when the empty mug looked full again in the next shot.
examples.zh: 下一镜里空杯子又满了，我发现了一个「镜头衔接穿帮」。

examples.en: Our tutor replayed the scene so we could see the continuity error with the open window.
examples.zh: 导师重放那场戏，让我们看到窗户开着的那个「镜头衔接穿帮」。

words.enDefinition: the arrangement of buttons and their assigned functions on a controller

examples.en: I checked the controller layout before handing the controller to my roommate.
examples.zh: 让室友接着玩之前，我看了「手柄按键布局」。

examples.en: The controller layout diagram showed the pause button near the middle of the controller.
examples.zh: 「手柄按键布局」图上显示，暂停键靠近手柄中间。

words.enDefinition: a restart usually taken from a corner after the whole ball crosses the goal line without a goal, having last touched a defender

examples.en: The crowd got louder when our team won a corner kick near the end.
examples.zh: 比赛快结束时，我们队获得「角球」，观众声更大了。

examples.en: My roommate took the corner kick that led to the only goal of the match.
examples.zh: 正是室友发的「角球」，带来了整场唯一的进球。

words.enDefinition: the group of ballet dancers performing together in an ensemble

examples.en: The corps de ballet returned to the stage after the two principal dancers.
examples.zh: 两位首席舞者之后，「芭蕾群舞团」重新回到舞台上。

examples.en: I could see the whole corps de ballet form a line across the stage.
examples.zh: 我看到整个「芭蕾群舞团」在台上排成一横排。

collocations: dance in the corps de ballet

words.enDefinition: someone who designs the clothing worn in a production

examples.en: The costume designer brought three different sketches to our first rehearsal.
examples.zh: 「戏服设计师」带着三张不同的草图来参加第一次排练。

examples.en: Our costume designer asked how easily I could move in the coat.
examples.zh: 我们的「戏服设计师」问我穿上那件外套活动起来是否方便。

words.enDefinition: a session to check that a performer's outfit fits properly

examples.en: My costume fitting was right after class, so I brought my dance shoes.
examples.zh: 「戏服试穿」就在课后，我带来了舞鞋。

examples.en: The costume designer took notes during my costume fitting on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二我「试穿戏服」时，服装设计师在一旁记了笔记。

words.enDefinition: cooperative play by people sharing one device in the same room

examples.en: We had time for couch co-op before the common room closed.
examples.zh: 公共休息室关门前，我们还有时间玩会儿「同机合作」。

examples.en: I looked for couch co-op so my friend could use the spare controller.
examples.zh: 我找了找有没有「同机合作」，这样朋友就能用备用手柄。

words.enDefinition: seats right beside the playing area of a sports court

examples.en: The courtside seats gave us a clear look at the players warming up.
examples.zh: 坐在「场边近座」，我们能清楚看到球员热身。

examples.en: My aunt had courtside seats when her university hosted the basketball tournament.
examples.zh: 姨妈的大学办篮球锦标赛时，她坐的是「场边近座」。

words.enDefinition: a band whose performances center on songs previously performed by other artists

examples.en: A cover band played familiar songs at the outdoor student reception that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚的学生户外招待会上，「翻唱乐队」演唱了大家熟悉的歌。

examples.en: I joined a cover band with three classmates after our first year at university.
examples.zh: 读完大一后，我和三位同学加入了一支「翻唱乐队」。

words.enDefinition: a new performance of a piece already recorded or performed by another artist

examples.en: The student band played a cover version of a song we all knew.
examples.zh: 学生乐队演奏了一首大家都知道的歌的「翻唱或翻奏版本」。

examples.en: I heard the cover version before I found the original recording in the library.
examples.zh: 我先听了「翻唱版本」，后来才在图书馆找到原录音。

words.enDefinition: seating under a roof that protects spectators from the weather

examples.en: We chose covered seating after seeing clouds above the stadium that morning.
examples.zh: 早上看到体育场上方积云，我们就选了「有顶棚的座席」。

examples.en: The covered seating filled quickly when it started raining after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后开始下雨，「有顶棚的座席」很快就坐满了。

words.enDefinition: a set of materials and instructions for a small craft project

examples.en: My friend brought a craft kit to the residence common room.
examples.zh: 朋友带了一个「手工材料包」到宿舍公共休息室。

examples.en: I checked the craft kit before taking it to our weekend meetup.
examples.zh: 去周末聚会前，我检查了这个「手工材料包」。

words.enDefinition: an evening event where people work on crafts together

examples.en: A few of us booked the lounge for a craft night.
examples.zh: 我们几个人预约了休息室，打算办一场「晚间手作活动」。

examples.en: I finished my paper bookmark at craft night after the other students left.
examples.zh: 其他同学离开后，我在「晚间手作活动」上把纸书签做完了。

words.enDefinition: a period when it feels difficult to come up with creative ideas

examples.en: My classmate took a walk when she hit a creative block.
examples.zh: 同学「创作卡壳」时出去走了走。

examples.en: Changing the subject of my sketch helped me move past a creative block.
examples.zh: 换个速写对象，帮我走出了「创作卡壳」的状态。

words.enDefinition: A fictional drama centered on a crime, its investigation, or people affected by it.

examples.en: The crime drama spent most of its time on the people affected by the investigation.
examples.zh: 这部「犯罪题材剧」把主要篇幅放在受调查影响的人身上。

examples.en: My roommate likes a crime drama with a believable detective and a convincing setting.
examples.zh: 室友喜欢侦探人物真实、场景也可信的「犯罪题材剧」。

words.enDefinition: a small hooked tool used to work yarn into loops

examples.en: My friend lent me a crochet hook for the evening workshop.
examples.zh: 朋友把一支「钩针」借给我上晚上的工作坊。

examples.en: I went back for the crochet hook I had left on the bench.
examples.zh: 我回去取自己落在长凳上的「钩针」。

words.enDefinition: to trim the edges of an image to change the framing

examples.en: I chose to crop a photo before adding it to my journal.
examples.zh: 把照片放进手账前，我选择先「裁剪照片」。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to crop a photo on her tablet.
examples.zh: 室友给我演示了怎样在她的平板上「裁剪照片」。

collocations: crop a photo to fit a frame

words.enDefinition: intersecting lines used to suggest shadow, shape or texture

examples.en: I used cross-hatching for the shaded space under the chair.
examples.zh: 画椅子下方的阴影时，我用了「交叉排线」。

examples.en: The cross-hatching looked clearer once I switched to a finer pen.
examples.zh: 换成笔尖更细的笔后，「交叉排线」看起来清楚多了。

words.enDefinition: playing together online from different kinds of gaming platforms

examples.en: Cross-play let me join my roommate even though she used a different console.
examples.zh: 室友用的是另一种主机，「跨平台联机」让我也能加入。

examples.en: I checked whether cross-play worked between my laptop and his console.
examples.zh: 我查了自己的笔记本电脑和他的主机之间能不能「跨平台联机」。

words.enDefinition: decorative needlework made by crossing stitches into small X shapes

examples.en: I tried cross-stitch after seeing my classmate's bookmark at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时看到同学做的书签后，我也试了「十字绣」。

examples.en: The cross-stitch on her bag showed three tiny leaves in different colours.
examples.zh: 她包上的「十字绣」绣了三片不同颜色的小叶子。

words.enDefinition: the horizontal bar connecting the top of the two goalposts

examples.en: The ball struck the crossbar and dropped just in front of the goal line.
examples.zh: 球打到「球门横梁」后，落在球门线正前方。

examples.en: A volunteer checked the crossbar while the teams warmed up on the other side.
examples.zh: 两队在另一侧热身时，一名志愿者检查了「球门横梁」。

words.enDefinition: a change in which one track fades out while the next fades in

examples.en: The crossfade made the change between the two dance tracks sound much less abrupt.
examples.zh: 「交叉淡入淡出」让两首舞曲之间的切换听起来没那么突兀。

examples.en: I turned off the crossfade to hear the proper ending of the piano piece.
examples.zh: 我关掉了「交叉淡入淡出」，好听清钢琴曲真正的结尾。

words.enDefinition: the part of a live act involving interaction with audience members

examples.en: She did a little crowd work after a visitor laughed at the wrong moment.
examples.zh: 有位观众笑得不是时候，她就「现场与观众即兴互动」了几句。

examples.en: The comedian used crowd work to learn where people were studying.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员借着「现场与观众即兴互动」了解大家都在哪儿上学。

collocations: crowd work with the front row

words.enDefinition: a technical rehearsal moving between cues while skipping intervening sections

examples.en: We did a cue-to-cue instead of performing all the scenes that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，我们做了「逐个提示点合成排练」，没有把每场戏都演一遍。

examples.en: The cue-to-cue let the crew check two quick changes in lighting.
examples.zh: 「逐个提示点合成排练」让工作人员检查了两次快速的灯光变换。

words.enDefinition: the moment after a performance when the cast acknowledges applause

examples.en: The dancers returned to the stage for a curtain call at the end.
examples.zh: 演出结束时，舞者回到台上「谢幕」。

examples.en: The entire cast wore their final costumes during the curtain call that night.
examples.zh: 那晚「演员谢幕」时，整个剧组都还穿着最后一场的戏服。

collocations: come out for a curtain call

words.enDefinition: to divide a stack of cards and swap the positions of the sections

examples.en: My flatmate offered to cut the deck after I finished shuffling.
examples.zh: 我洗完牌后，室友主动说来「切牌」。

examples.en: We took turns being the person who could cut the deck.
examples.zh: 我们轮流当那个负责「切牌」的人。

collocations: ask someone to cut the deck

words.enDefinition: a performer who keeps the choreography consistent throughout a production

examples.en: The dance captain helped the new dancers learn the existing number.
examples.zh: 「舞蹈排练领队」帮新来的舞者熟悉已经编好的歌舞段落。

examples.en: Our dance captain made notes after watching us rehearse the final section.
examples.zh: 看完我们排练最后一段后，「舞蹈排练领队」记下了要点。

collocations: rehearsal led by a dance captain

words.enDefinition: a dance performance made for two people to perform together

examples.en: I watched a dance duet that two students had choreographed together.
examples.zh: 我看了一段「双人舞」，是两位同学一起编的。

examples.en: Their dance duet used slow turns and long pauses without any music.
examples.zh: 他们的「双人舞」用了缓慢的转身和很长的停顿，没有配乐。

words.enDefinition: An exercise format using dance movements, usually performed to music.

examples.en: My classmate suggested trying dance fitness after hearing the music from the studio downstairs.
examples.zh: 听到楼下教室传来的音乐后，同学提议试试「舞蹈健身」。

examples.en: The dance fitness session attracted students from several programs who had never met before.
examples.zh: 这次「舞蹈健身」课来了几个专业的同学，他们之前互不认识。

words.enDefinition: a designated area where people can dance at a venue

examples.en: My friends went onto the dance floor after the drummer started the next song.
examples.zh: 鼓手开始演奏下一首歌后，我的朋友们走进了「舞池」。

examples.en: I stayed near the dance floor so my flatmate could find me between sets.
examples.zh: 我留在「舞池」旁边，好让室友在两轮演出的间隙找到我。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement of dancers in relation to one another onstage

examples.en: The dance formation changed as soon as the second piece of music began.
examples.zh: 第二段音乐一响起来，「舞蹈队形」就变了。

examples.en: We practised the dance formation in a bigger room that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我们在更大的房间里练了「舞蹈队形」。

words.enDefinition: a short sequence of related movements forming a complete unit

examples.en: We learned the same dance phrase and performed it in different directions.
examples.zh: 我们学了同一个「舞蹈动作组合」，再朝不同方向表演。

examples.en: She used one short dance phrase near the beginning of her piece.
examples.zh: 她在作品开头附近用了一个简短的「舞蹈动作组合」。

words.enDefinition: a planned performance where dancers show prepared pieces to an audience

examples.en: My housemate performed in the dance recital near the end of term.
examples.zh: 临近期末，室友参加了「舞蹈汇报演出」。

examples.en: We met our classmates after the dance recital at the small theatre.
examples.zh: 小剧场的「舞蹈汇报演出」结束后，我们见到了同学。

words.enDefinition: Comedy that finds humor in serious, unpleasant, or disturbing situations.

examples.en: The dark comedy made the scholarship interview funny without making it seem any less stressful.
examples.zh: 这部「黑色喜剧」把奖学金面试拍得好笑，面试的紧张感也还在。

examples.en: I wasn't expecting the dark comedy to make me laugh at such an awkward scene.
examples.zh: 没想到这部「黑色喜剧」会让我在那种尴尬的场面笑出来。

collocations: a dark comedy about office life
describe a film as a dark comedy

words.enDefinition: to distribute cards to the people playing

examples.en: I offered to deal out the cards while my friends fetched chairs.
examples.zh: 朋友们去搬椅子时，我主动说来「给玩家发牌」。

examples.en: The instructions said to deal out the cards after counting the players.
examples.zh: 说明写着，数清玩家人数后再「给玩家发牌」。

collocations: offer to deal out the cards
ask someone to deal out the cards

words.enDefinition: the first album released by a musician or group

examples.en: My tutor asked us to listen to the debut album before our discussion.
examples.zh: 导师请我们在讨论前先听那张「首张专辑」。

examples.en: The debut album included a song written during the band's final year at school.
examples.zh: 「首张专辑」收录了一首乐队在上学最后一学年写的歌。

words.enDefinition: the final set played to determine the winner after earlier sets are tied

examples.en: We changed courts before beginning the deciding set on the sunny side of campus.
examples.zh: 在校园向阳的一侧开打「决胜盘」前，我们换了球场。

examples.en: The deciding set began later because both players took a short break first.
examples.zh: 两名球员先进行短暂休息，因此「决胜盘」晚些开始。

words.enDefinition: a game where players build their decks by adding cards during play

examples.en: My classmate introduced a deck-building game that started with very few cards.
examples.zh: 同学介绍了一款「牌组构筑游戏」，开局只有很少的牌。

examples.en: Our deck-building game ended before the common room had to close.
examples.zh: 公共休息室关门前，我们这一局「牌组构筑游戏」结束了。

words.enDefinition: a set of cards used together for playing a game

examples.en: My roommate brought a deck of cards to the group picnic.
examples.zh: 室友带了「一副牌」来参加集体野餐。

examples.en: We checked the deck of cards after finding one under the table.
examples.zh: 在桌子底下找到一张牌后，我们核对了「一副牌」里的牌。

words.enDefinition: a game where players use clues to work out hidden information

examples.en: We played a deduction game using pictures and a few simple clues.
examples.zh: 我们用图片和几条简单线索玩了个「推理游戏」。

examples.en: The deduction game was easy to explain once everyone saw an example.
examples.zh: 大家看过一个例子后，「推理游戏」很容易讲明白。

words.enDefinition: an expanded edition of a release that usually contains additional material

examples.en: The deluxe edition came with demos that the band recorded during its final year.
examples.zh: 「豪华版专辑」附有乐队最后一年录制的几首样带。

examples.en: I compared the deluxe edition with the older one before buying the record.
examples.zh: 我买唱片前，先比较了「豪华版专辑」和旧版。

words.enDefinition: an early recording made to demonstrate how a song or arrangement might sound

examples.en: My friend played me a demo recording she had made in her bedroom.
examples.zh: 朋友给我放了她在卧室录的一段「歌曲示范录音」。

examples.en: The band changed the chorus after listening to the demo recording from Monday.
examples.zh: 乐队听了周一的「歌曲示范录音」后，改了副歌。

words.enDefinition: the range of distance that appears reasonably sharp in an image

examples.en: I noticed the depth of field when the background started looking soft.
examples.zh: 背景开始变得柔和模糊时，我注意到了「景深」。

examples.en: Our tutor used the tabletop photos to explain depth of field clearly.
examples.zh: 老师用桌面照片把「景深」解释得很清楚。

words.enDefinition: a tennis score at which both sides have won at least three points and are level

examples.en: The umpire called deuce after the return landed just inside the line at the back.
examples.zh: 回球落在底线内一点，主裁报出「网球局内平分」。

examples.en: Our doubles game went back to deuce three times before either team won it.
examples.zh: 那局双打三次回到「网球局内平分」，才有一队拿下该局。

words.enDefinition: a shallow container that keeps rolled dice from scattering

examples.en: I set the dice tray in the middle of the board.
examples.zh: 我把「掷骰盘」放到棋盘正中间。

examples.en: The felt dice tray made it quieter when we played after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们玩的时候，毛毡「掷骰盘」让掷骰子的声音小了些。

collocations: place a dice tray on the table

words.enDefinition: a choice controlling how challenging the game is

examples.en: I changed the difficulty setting before showing the game to my flatmate.
examples.zh: 给室友演示游戏之前，我调整了「难度设置」。

examples.en: The difficulty setting affected how much time we had for each puzzle.
examples.zh: 「难度设置」影响每道谜题留给我们的时间。

words.enDefinition: a technique where a performer speaks directly to the audience

examples.en: The actor used direct address to ask us what we would do.
examples.zh: 演员「直接向观众讲话」，问我们会怎么做。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how direct address changed the mood of the sketch.
examples.zh: 老师解释了「直接向观众讲话」如何改变这个短剧的气氛。

words.enDefinition: a set of controller buttons for moving in different directions

examples.en: I used the directional pad to move one tile to the left.
examples.zh: 我用「方向键区」往左移了一格。

examples.en: The menu was easier to navigate with the directional pad than the stick.
examples.zh: 在那个菜单里，用「方向键区」操作比用摇杆顺手。

words.enDefinition: A version of a film edited according to the director's own preferred choices.

examples.en: I watched the director's cut to see how the slower opening changed the story.
examples.zh: 我看了「导演剪辑版」，想知道节奏较慢的开头让故事有什么不同。

examples.en: The campus cinema showed the director's cut as part of a program on editing.
examples.zh: 校园影院把「导演剪辑版」放进了一个有关剪辑的专题放映。

collocations: a scene from the director's cut

words.enDefinition: to remove a card from your hand or play area

examples.en: I chose to discard a card to make room for another.
examples.zh: 我选择「弃掉一张牌」，腾出位置再拿一张。

examples.en: The game asked me to discard a card before ending my turn.
examples.zh: 回合结束前，游戏要求我「弃掉一张牌」。

collocations: discard a card at the end of a turn

words.enDefinition: the stack set aside for cards that have been discarded

examples.en: I kept the discard pile separate from the cards we could still draw.
examples.zh: 我把「弃牌堆」和还能抽的那些牌分开放。

examples.en: The top card of the discard pile showed a yellow circle.
examples.zh: 「弃牌堆」最上面的牌上画着一个黄色圆圈。

collocations: put a card on the discard pile
the top of the discard pile

words.enDefinition: Disposable wet cloths supplied for cleaning shared surfaces and equipment.

examples.en: The staff member replaced a container of disinfecting wipes near the end of our session.
examples.zh: 我们快练完的时候，工作人员换了一桶「消毒湿巾」。

examples.en: I noticed the disinfecting wipes beside the door after our group class had ended.
examples.zh: 团课结束后，我留意到门边有「消毒湿巾」。

words.enDefinition: the status earned by winning a division within a sports league

examples.en: Our team secured the division title with a win in the last regular season game.
examples.zh: 我们队在常规赛最后一场获胜，拿到了「分区冠军头衔」。

examples.en: Several teams were still in contention for the division title when term ended.
examples.zh: 学期结束时，还有几支队伍在争夺「分区冠军头衔」。

words.enDefinition: A film or program that explores real people, events, or subjects.

examples.en: We watched a documentary about the volunteers who run a small library after school.
examples.zh: 我们看了一部「纪录片」，讲的是放学后帮忙经营小图书馆的志愿者。

examples.en: The documentary made me curious about what happens after our old textbooks get donated.
examples.zh: 这部「纪录片」让我好奇，旧教材捐出去以后会怎样。

words.enDefinition: A set of documentary episodes about related people, events, or subjects.

examples.en: We started a docuseries about city parks after our tutor mentioned it in class.
examples.zh: 导师上课提过一部城市公园题材的「纪录片剧集」，我们就开始看了。

examples.en: Each episode of the docuseries followed a different team working in the same museum.
examples.zh: 这部「纪录片剧集」每集跟拍在同一家博物馆工作的不同团队。

words.enDefinition: an album issued as two discs or presented as two album-length parts

examples.en: The used record shop sold a double album in a thick cardboard sleeve.
examples.zh: 二手唱片店出售一张装在厚纸板封套里的「双碟专辑」。

examples.en: The second disc of the double album was mostly recorded during a concert.
examples.zh: 这张「双碟专辑」的第二张碟主要是在一场演唱会上录制的。

words.enDefinition: two unsuccessful serving attempts in a tennis point, which loses that point

examples.en: The double fault gave our opponents a point at the end of the game.
examples.zh: 局末的「双误」让对方得了一分。

examples.en: I took longer before my next serve because I had just made a double fault.
examples.zh: 我刚打了一个「双误」，下次发球前多等了一会儿。

collocations: lose a point on a double fault

words.enDefinition: A program in which two films are shown one after the other.

examples.en: We picked a double feature because both films were shorter than we had expected.
examples.zh: 两部片都比预想的短，我们就选了「两部电影连映」。

examples.en: There was a short break between the movies in the campus cinema's double feature.
examples.zh: 校园影院的「两部电影连映」在两片之间安排了一小段休息时间。

collocations: a double feature at the cinema

words.enDefinition: tape with adhesive on both surfaces for joining two things

examples.en: I attached the little photograph with double-sided tape so it lay flat.
examples.zh: 我用「双面胶带」贴上那张小照片，让它平整地贴住。

examples.en: We shared a roll of double-sided tape while making the table cards.
examples.zh: 我们做桌牌时共用了一卷「双面胶带」。

words.enDefinition: two games scheduled for the same day, typically involving the same teams

examples.en: The field was reserved all afternoon for a doubleheader between two student softball teams.
examples.zh: 两支学生垒球队要打「同日连赛两场」的比赛，场地整个下午都预留了。

examples.en: I stayed for the second game of the doubleheader after my friend went home.
examples.zh: 朋友回家后，我留下看完了「同日连赛两场」的后一场。

words.enDefinition: To save a video on a device so it can be watched without internet access.

examples.en: I chose to download for offline viewing before taking the train home for the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末坐火车回家前，我选了「下载后离线观看」。

examples.en: The app displayed “Download for offline viewing” beneath some of the films on my list.
examples.zh: 应用在我清单里部分电影的下方显示了「下载后离线观看」。

collocations: an option to download for offline viewing
choose to download for offline viewing

words.enDefinition: at or towards the front of the stage, near the audience

examples.en: I stepped downstage so the audience could actually see my face.
examples.zh: 我往「舞台前部」迈了几步，好让观众看清我的脸。

examples.en: The dancer waited downstage while the final piece of music started.
examples.zh: 最后一段音乐开始时，那位舞者等在「舞台前部」。

words.enDefinition: someone who supports a production through research and analysis of the script

examples.en: Our dramaturg researched how students spoke during the period of the play.
examples.zh: 我们的「戏剧构作顾问」研究了该剧时代的学生是怎么说话的。

examples.en: The dramaturg wrote a short note explaining the setting for the audience.
examples.zh: 「戏剧构作顾问」写了一段简短说明，给观众介绍剧中的场景背景。

words.enDefinition: a result in which neither side wins because their scores are equal

examples.en: The game ended in a draw after both teams missed chances near the end.
examples.zh: 两队快结束时都错过了机会，比赛以「平局」收场。

examples.en: We only needed a draw to qualify for the next round of the league.
examples.zh: 我们只要打成「平局」，就能进入联赛的下一轮。

words.enDefinition: to take one card from the stack provided for drawing

examples.en: I had to draw a card before moving my piece that turn.
examples.zh: 轮到我时，我得先「抽一张牌」，再移动棋子。

examples.en: The rulebook said to draw a card after placing the last tile.
examples.zh: 规则手册说，放好最后一块方块后要「抽一张牌」。

collocations: draw a card from the pile
let a player draw a card
be asked to draw a card

words.enDefinition: to draw without a ruler, stencil or tracing guide

examples.en: I tried to draw freehand instead of using the outlines in the workbook.
examples.zh: 我试着「徒手画」，没用练习册里现成的轮廓线。

examples.en: My friend can draw freehand when she plans the pattern for a card.
examples.zh: 朋友设计卡片图案时，可以「徒手画」。
