words.enDefinition: the stack of cards players take new cards from

examples.en: We placed the draw pile within reach of both sides of the table.
examples.zh: 我们把「抽牌堆」放在桌子两边都够得着的地方。

examples.en: The draw pile had only two cards left when we stopped.
examples.zh: 我们停下来时，「抽牌堆」只剩两张牌。

collocations: take a card from the draw pile

words.enDefinition: drawing something by looking at it directly as you work

examples.en: We practised drawing from observation with ordinary objects from the study room.
examples.zh: 我们用自习室的普通物件，练习「观察实物绘画」。

examples.en: Drawing from observation helped me notice where the handle met the cup.
examples.zh: 「观察实物绘画」让我注意到杯柄和杯身连接的位置。

collocations: a session on drawing from observation

words.enDefinition: a room where performers change clothes and prepare their appearance

examples.en: Three student dancers shared a dressing room behind the small stage that night.
examples.zh: 那晚，三位学生舞者共用小舞台后的一间「演出更衣室」。

examples.en: I left my shoes in the dressing room after the final performance.
examples.zh: 最后一场演出结束后，我把鞋落在了「演出更衣室」。

words.enDefinition: to let a loop slip off a knitting needle so that the stitch is lost

examples.en: I tend to drop a stitch when I look away from the knitting.
examples.zh: 视线从织物上移开时，我容易「漏掉一针」。

examples.en: I was worried I might drop a stitch while talking to my roommate.
examples.zh: 我担心和室友说话时会「漏掉一针」。

collocations: try not to drop a stitch
notice when you drop a stitch

words.enDefinition: a fitness class you can attend by the session without committing to a course, subject to availability

examples.en: I tried a drop-in fitness class because my work schedule changes from week to week.
examples.zh: 我每周的排班会变，所以试了一次「可单次参加的健身课」。

examples.en: The timetable advertised a drop-in fitness class for anyone who could come that afternoon.
examples.zh: 时间表发布了一节「可单次参加的健身课」，那天下午有空的人都可以来。

collocations: a drop-in fitness class on weekends

words.enDefinition: a soft shot that lands just beyond the net, away from an opponent

examples.en: She played a drop shot when her opponent was still near the baseline.
examples.zh: 对手还在底线附近时，她打了一个「放短球」。

examples.en: I reached the drop shot just as the ball was dropping toward the court.
examples.zh: 球快落地时，我刚好赶上了那个「放短球」。

words.enDefinition: a short variation on the main drum pattern between sections of music

examples.en: I heard a drum fill just before the singer came back in that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚歌手重新唱起来之前，我听到一个「鼓点过门」。

examples.en: The drummer practised the drum fill that linked the slower verse to the chorus.
examples.zh: 鼓手练习了把较慢的主歌和副歌连起来的「鼓点过门」。

words.enDefinition: A version with the original dialogue replaced by newly recorded speech, often in another language.

examples.en: My roommate chose the dubbed version so her little brother could follow the story.
examples.zh: 室友选了「配音版」，好让弟弟能跟上故事。

examples.en: We compared the dubbed version with the original because the jokes sounded different in translation.
examples.zh: 译过来的笑话听起来不一样，我们就把「配音版」和原版作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A short, hand-held weight with a handle between its weighted ends.

examples.en: There was a single dumbbell on the shelf even though the label pictured a matching pair.
examples.zh: 虽然标签上画的是一对，架子上只有一只「哑铃」。

examples.en: The instructor pointed out the number printed at each end of the dumbbell during orientation.
examples.zh: 入门介绍时，教练指给我们看「哑铃」两端印着的数字。

words.enDefinition: a song or tune that keeps repeating in your mind without effort

examples.en: The short theme from the video became an earworm while I was studying.
examples.zh: 视频的简短主题曲成了我学习时「在脑子里循环的曲子」。

examples.en: The chorus became an earworm after the gig, and I hummed it for days.
examples.zh: 演出后，那段副歌成了我「在脑子里循环的曲子」，我哼了好几天。

words.enDefinition: strong excitement shared by everyone at an event

examples.en: Students created an electric atmosphere before the first home game even began.
examples.zh: 第一场主场比赛还没开始，学生们就让「现场气氛热烈起来」。

examples.en: We felt the electric atmosphere as soon as we entered the arena.
examples.zh: 我们一进体育馆，就感到「现场气氛热烈」。

words.enDefinition: rhythmic music made primarily with electronic equipment for dancing

examples.en: I heard electronic dance music coming from the student hall as we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到的时候，听见学生礼堂传出「电子舞曲」。

examples.en: The radio team scheduled electronic dance music for the last hour of its programme.
examples.zh: 电台团队把「电子舞曲」安排在了节目最后一小时。

words.enDefinition: A stationary machine with pedals that move along an oval path during exercise.

examples.en: The guide pointed out an elliptical trainer between the bikes and the rowing machines.
examples.zh: 向导指给我们看健身车和划船机之间的一台「椭圆机」。

examples.en: I recognized the elliptical trainer from the photograph on the gym's website before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我根据健身房网站上的照片认出了「椭圆机」。

words.enDefinition: soft thread made of several strands for decorative stitching

examples.en: I picked two shades of embroidery floss for the small flower design.
examples.zh: 我给小花图案挑了两种颜色的「刺绣线」。

examples.en: My roommate stored her embroidery floss in a box beside the window.
examples.zh: 室友把「刺绣线」收在窗边的盒子里。

words.enDefinition: a round frame that holds cloth stretched during embroidery

examples.en: I borrowed an embroidery hoop for the small cloth I had brought.
examples.zh: 我带来一小块布，借了一个「绣绷」用。

examples.en: The embroidery hoop kept the fabric flat while I added a few stitches.
examples.zh: 我缝了几针，「绣绷」让布料始终是平的。

collocations: put fabric in an embroidery hoop

words.enDefinition: an extra performance after the planned end of a show, often requested by applause

examples.en: The band came back for an encore after everyone clapped for several minutes.
examples.zh: 大家鼓掌几分钟后，乐队回来「返场加演」。

examples.en: We stayed for the encore even though the last bus was leaving soon.
examples.zh: 虽然末班车很快就要开了，我们还是留着看完了「返场加演」。

words.enDefinition: the seat at either end of a row of seats

examples.en: I chose an end seat so it would be easier to leave.
examples.zh: 我选了「一排最边上的座位」，这样离开时更方便。

examples.en: The only available end seat was in the second row of our section.
examples.zh: 唯一剩下的「一排最边上的座位」在那个区的第二排。

words.enDefinition: the area beyond either goal line where a team can score a touchdown

examples.en: Our seats were behind the end zone opposite the main college entrance that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我们的座位在学院主入口对面的「美式橄榄球端区」后面。

examples.en: The crowd stood when the runner approached the end zone late in the game.
examples.zh: 比赛后段，持球跑的球员接近「美式橄榄球端区」时，观众站了起来。

collocations: catch the ball in the end zone

words.enDefinition: A group of actors who share the major roles in a story.

examples.en: The series used an ensemble cast, so each episode could follow a different roommate.
examples.zh: 这部剧采用「群像阵容」，所以每集都可以跟着不同的室友展开。

examples.en: My classmate liked the ensemble cast because even minor stories were given time to develop.
examples.zh: 同学喜欢这部戏的「群像阵容」，因为连小故事都有足够的展开篇幅。

words.enDefinition: a marked passage through which people enter a venue

examples.en: The staff opened a second entry lane when the crowd grew.
examples.zh: 人越来越多时，工作人员开了第二条「入场通道」。

examples.en: I joined the wrong entry lane and asked a volunteer for directions.
examples.zh: 我排错了「入场通道」，就找志愿者问路。

words.enDefinition: an extended-play music release generally shorter than a full-length album

examples.en: The student band recorded an EP with four songs during the winter break.
examples.zh: 学生乐队寒假录制了一张有四首歌的「迷你专辑」。

examples.en: I bought the EP at the gig after hearing the last song performed live.
examples.zh: 在演出现场听过最后一首歌后，我买了那张「迷你专辑」。

words.enDefinition: A brief summary of events from earlier episodes, often shown before a new episode.

examples.en: The episode recap reminded us why the main character had decided to leave town.
examples.zh: 「前情回顾」让我们想起主角为什么决定离开小镇。

examples.en: My roommate asked for a quick episode recap when she realized she had missed last week's show.
examples.zh: 室友发现没看上周那集，就请我简单做个「前情回顾」。

words.enDefinition: a goal that makes the scores of two teams equal

examples.en: Our equaliser came just before the referee ended the first half of the match.
examples.zh: 上半场结束前，我们打进了「扳平比分的进球」。

examples.en: I nearly missed the equaliser because I was putting my coat back on.
examples.zh: 我当时正穿外套，差点错过「扳平比分的进球」。

words.enDefinition: Whether particular equipment is free and available to use at a given time.

examples.en: The front desk display showed equipment availability while we waited to start our session.
examples.zh: 等着开始运动时，前台的屏幕显示了「器械空闲情况」。

examples.en: I checked equipment availability because the bikes were all occupied on my previous visit.
examples.zh: 因为上次来时健身车全被占用了，我先查了「器械空闲情况」。

words.enDefinition: The control panel with information or settings for a piece of exercise equipment.

examples.en: The equipment console still showed the time from the previous session when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到时，「健身器械操作面板」上还显示着前一场的时间。

examples.en: My roommate recognized the equipment console from a picture in the introductory leaflet for students.
examples.zh: 室友从学生入门传单的图片里认出了「健身器械操作面板」。

collocations: a label on the equipment console
an equipment console with a screen

words.enDefinition: A label indicating that someone is using a piece of equipment at the moment.

examples.en: The little display read “Equipment in use” while my classmate finished at the machine.
examples.zh: 同学还没用完那台机器，小屏幕上显示「器械使用中」。

examples.en: I saw “Equipment in use” next to the bike I had been waiting for.
examples.zh: 我看到自己一直在等的那台健身车旁显示「器械使用中」。

collocations: a sign reading equipment in use
a status marked equipment in use

words.enDefinition: The maximum amount of time visitors may use a particular machine when a limit applies.

examples.en: The sign explained when the equipment time limit applied to the bikes near the window.
examples.zh: 告示解释了窗边健身车的「单次使用器械的时限」在什么情况下适用。

examples.en: We asked about the equipment time limit because several people were waiting for a treadmill.
examples.zh: 有几个人正在等跑步机，所以我们问了问「单次使用器械的时限」。

collocations: a notice about the equipment time limit

words.enDefinition: the approximate time a game takes to complete

examples.en: The estimated play time on the box was shorter than our lunch break.
examples.zh: 盒上写的「预计游戏时长」比我们的午休时间短。

examples.en: I checked the estimated play time before taking the game to the lounge.
examples.zh: 把游戏带去公共休息室之前，我查了「预计游戏时长」。

collocations: an estimated play time of an hour

words.enDefinition: the sale of tickets on the day an event takes place

examples.en: The arena offered event-day ticket sales for the final match on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六的决赛，体育馆提供「活动当天售票」。

examples.en: A notice said event-day ticket sales were only available at the main entrance.
examples.zh: 告示写着，「活动当天售票」只在主入口办理。

collocations: event-day ticket sales at the venue

words.enDefinition: a pass allowing someone to attend a specific organised event

examples.en: My event ticket showed the match date but not the entrance.
examples.zh: 我的「活动门票」上有比赛日期，却没写入口。

examples.en: I bought an event ticket online for the university basketball game.
examples.zh: 我在网上买了张大学篮球赛的「活动门票」。

words.enDefinition: A portable padded mat used on the floor during exercise classes or workouts.

examples.en: The studio had an exercise mat set out beside each of the blue markers.
examples.zh: 团课教室在每个蓝色标记旁都摆了一张「运动垫」。

examples.en: I rolled up my exercise mat while the instructor talked about next week's class.
examples.zh: 教练在介绍下周的课时，我把自己的「运动垫」卷了起来。

words.enDefinition: An adjustment that changes how a particular exercise is performed in a class.

examples.en: The instructor mentioned an exercise modification when someone asked about the options for that activity.
examples.zh: 有人问那项活动有哪些选项时，教练提到了一个「动作替代方案」。

examples.en: My roommate wrote “exercise modification” in her notes so she could remember the phrase later.
examples.zh: 室友把「动作替代方案」记在笔记里，免得之后忘了这个说法。

words.enDefinition: A group of repetitions of one movement counted together before a break or another activity.

examples.en: The sample log recorded each exercise set on its own line next to a space for notes.
examples.zh: 示例日志把每「一组练习」单独列一行，旁边留了写备注的位置。

examples.en: My roommate wrote a short note after each exercise set in her new fitness journal.
examples.zh: 室友在新的健身日志里，每做完「一组练习」就记一句简短的笔记。

collocations: a pause after an exercise set

words.enDefinition: To move or exercise in a session accompanied by music.

examples.en: My classmates chose to exercise to music in a group session after their lecture.
examples.zh: 同学们下课后选了门团课，「跟着音乐做运动」。

examples.en: I asked whether people exercise to music in the new class listed on the timetable.
examples.zh: 我问时间表上新加的那门课是不是「跟着音乐做运动」。

collocations: choose a class where people exercise to music

words.enDefinition: A version of a film that includes more material than the original release version.

examples.en: The extended cut included a longer scene in which the students moved into their flat.
examples.zh: 「加长剪辑版」里，学生们搬进公寓的那场戏更长。

examples.en: We chose the extended cut because our tutor had mentioned a scene missing from the original.
examples.zh: 导师提过原版少了一场戏，所以我们选了「加长剪辑版」。

collocations: an extended cut of a film

words.enDefinition: a longer mix of a song, often with more repeated beats or instrumental sections

examples.en: The DJ used an extended mix while people were beginning to fill the dance floor.
examples.zh: 大家陆续走进舞池时，DJ 放的是「加长混音版」。

examples.en: We noticed that the extended mix began with a much longer drum pattern than usual.
examples.zh: 我们注意到，「加长混音版」一开头的鼓点比普通版长得多。

words.enDefinition: additional innings played when a baseball or softball game is still tied

examples.en: The game went into extra innings while people were checking the last bus schedule.
examples.zh: 大家正查末班车时，比赛进入了「棒球延长局」。

examples.en: We stayed for extra innings because my friend was playing in the outfield.
examples.zh: 朋友在外野上场，我们留着看完了「棒球延长局」。

words.enDefinition: additional periods played after regular time to settle some tied football matches

examples.en: The final was still tied when regular play ended, so the teams played extra time.
examples.zh: 决赛常规时间结束时两队仍打平，于是踢了「足球加时赛」。

examples.en: Our captain scored during extra time, and we held the lead until the end.
examples.zh: 队长在「足球加时赛」时破门，我们把领先保持到了最后。

words.enDefinition: small pieces of cloth left after a larger project

examples.en: We saved fabric scraps from our old shirts for the next project.
examples.zh: 我们从旧衬衫上留了些「碎布料」，给下个手工作品用。

examples.en: My friend used fabric scraps to decorate the front of a notebook.
examples.zh: 朋友用「碎布料」装饰了笔记本的封面。

words.enDefinition: a playing card showing a jack, queen or king

examples.en: My friend asked whether a face card counted toward the bonus.
examples.zh: 朋友问「人头牌」能不能计入额外得分。

examples.en: The face card was the only one with a picture in my hand.
examples.zh: 我手上只有这张「人头牌」印着人物。

collocations: a hand with a face card

words.enDefinition: to gradually darken the stage until no light can be seen

examples.en: The lights were meant to fade to black during the last note.
examples.zh: 本来灯光该在最后一个音符响起时「渐暗至全黑」。

examples.en: I watched the stage fade to black before the performers came out again.
examples.zh: 我看着舞台「渐暗至全黑」，随后表演者再次上场。

collocations: wait for the lights to fade to black
fade to black at the end

words.enDefinition: part of a venue intended for families attending an event

examples.en: We chose the family section when my friend's younger brother came along.
examples.zh: 朋友的弟弟也来时，我们选了「家庭观众区」。

examples.en: The family section was clearly marked on the map outside the arena.
examples.zh: 体育馆外的地图清楚标出了「家庭观众区」。

words.enDefinition: a camera feed that shows spectators on a venue screen

examples.en: My brother waved when the fan cam showed him on the screen.
examples.zh: 「看台观众镜头」把我哥哥的画面放到大屏上时，他挥了挥手。

examples.en: We laughed when our classmates appeared on the fan cam together.
examples.zh: 同学们一起出现在「看台观众镜头」里时，我们笑了起来。

words.enDefinition: words or short lines jointly repeated by fans at an event

examples.en: I learned the words of a fan chant at my first game.
examples.zh: 第一次看比赛，我学会了一个「球迷助威口号」怎么喊。

examples.en: A fan chant spread through the section after the players came out.
examples.zh: 球员出场后，一个「球迷助威口号」传遍了整个看台区。

words.enDefinition: an area set up for sports fans to gather and socialise

examples.en: We met in the fan zone before walking over to the stadium.
examples.zh: 我们先在「球迷活动区」碰面，再走到体育场。

examples.en: The fan zone had a large screen and some tables for students.
examples.zh: 「球迷活动区」有块大屏幕，还给学生摆了些桌子。

words.enDefinition: A film in which magic, imaginary creatures, or impossible worlds are central to the story.

examples.en: The fantasy film took place in a city where buildings moved during the night.
examples.zh: 这部「奇幻电影」的故事发生在一座城市里，城里的建筑会在夜间移动。

examples.en: My classmate wanted to know how the fantasy film had created its unusual creatures.
examples.zh: 同学想知道这部「奇幻电影」里那些不寻常的生物是怎么设计出来的。

collocations: a fantasy film set in another world

words.enDefinition: a quick basketball attack before the defenders are in position

examples.en: We scored on a fast break after stopping the other team's attack near the basket.
examples.zh: 我们在篮下阻止对方进攻后，打成了一次「篮球快攻」。

examples.en: The fast break brought everyone to their feet in the small campus gym.
examples.zh: 这次「篮球快攻」让小小的校园体育馆里人人都站了起来。

words.enDefinition: A full-length film that can be shown as the main presentation.

examples.en: The campus festival showed a feature film after three shorts made by local students.
examples.zh: 校园影展放了三部本地学生制作的短片，接着放了一部「长篇电影」。

examples.en: My classmate had never watched a feature film in a theater before coming to university.
examples.zh: 来上大学之前，同学从没在影院看过「长篇电影」。

words.enDefinition: a performer given a named guest credit on a recording

examples.en: I recognised the featured artist from a playlist that my flatmate had shared.
examples.zh: 我从室友共享过的一个歌单里认出了这位「特邀合作艺人」。

examples.en: The credits listed a featured artist on the song with the second verse in Spanish.
examples.zh: 那首歌的第二段主歌是西班牙语，曲目署名里列了一位「特邀合作艺人」。

words.enDefinition: Describes an activity that seemed to require substantial effort or attention.

examples.en: I wrote that the class felt challenging because I was unfamiliar with the different stations.
examples.zh: 我写下这门课「感觉有挑战」，因为我还不熟悉各个训练位。

examples.en: My roommate said the session felt challenging when we compared our notes outside the studio.
examples.zh: 我们在团课教室外对笔记时，室友说这节课「感觉有挑战」。

words.enDefinition: the performers announced for a particular festival

examples.en: The festival lineup included a group that my flatmate had seen the previous summer.
examples.zh: 「节庆演出阵容」里有一个团队，室友去年夏天看过他们的演出。

examples.en: I checked the festival lineup before asking classmates if they wanted to go on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我先看了「节庆演出阵容」，才问同学们周六想不想去。

words.enDefinition: a score in American football from kicking the ball over the crossbar between the uprights

examples.en: The team tried a field goal just before halftime, but the kick went wide.
examples.zh: 半场结束前，球队尝试「美式橄榄球射门得分」，但球踢偏了。

examples.en: The kicker's field goal cut the lead before both teams went in at halftime.
examples.zh: 两队中场休息前，踢球手的「美式橄榄球射门得分」缩小了分差。

words.enDefinition: a book for identifying animals, plants or other things outdoors

examples.en: I checked a field guide after spotting an unfamiliar leaf by the path.
examples.zh: 我在小路旁看到不熟悉的叶子后，翻了翻「野外辨识手册」。

examples.en: My friend's field guide had drawings of several common garden birds.
examples.zh: 朋友的「野外辨识手册」里画了几种花园里常见的鸟。

collocations: a field guide to local birds

words.enDefinition: a credential permitting entry to the playing area at a venue

examples.en: The student photographer had a field pass for the university game.
examples.zh: 拍校队比赛的学生有一张「赛场通行证」。

examples.en: Our volunteer supervisor checked the field pass before letting Mark through.
examples.zh: 志愿者负责人核查了「赛场通行证」，才让马克通过。

words.enDefinition: A film made from an earlier work such as a book, play, or comic.

examples.en: The film adaptation left out a character whom everyone in our book club remembered.
examples.zh: 这部「电影改编作品」删掉了读书会每个人都记得的一个角色。

examples.en: I watched the film adaptation the weekend I finally finished reading the novel.
examples.zh: 我终于读完小说的那个周末，就看了它的「电影改编作品」。

collocations: a film adaptation of a novel
compare a book and its film adaptation

words.enDefinition: a camera that records images on photographic film

examples.en: My friend borrowed a film camera for the weekend photo walk.
examples.zh: 朋友借了一台「胶片相机」，周末出去拍照用。

examples.en: I brought a film camera but saved my last frame for sunset.
examples.zh: 我带了「胶片相机」，但把最后一格胶片留给日落。

words.enDefinition: An organized event presenting a selection of films, often over several days.

examples.en: The film festival showed student shorts in the afternoon and features in the evening.
examples.zh: 「电影节」下午放学生短片，晚上放长片。

examples.en: My roommate volunteered at a film festival and brought back a copy of the program.
examples.zh: 室友去「电影节」做志愿者，带回来一份节目单。

collocations: show a film at a film festival

words.enDefinition: A written or spoken evaluation of a film.

examples.en: I read a film review to see whether the ending was worth waiting for.
examples.zh: 我看了一篇「影评」，想知道结局值不值得等。

examples.en: Our student newspaper published a film review written by someone in my seminar group.
examples.zh: 校报发了一篇「影评」，是我们研讨小组的一位同学写的。

words.enDefinition: An organized showing of a film to an audience.

examples.en: A film screening in the library brought several students from our evening class together.
examples.zh: 图书馆办了场「电影放映」，我们晚课班上的几位同学都去了。

examples.en: We checked how long the film screening would last before making plans for dinner.
examples.zh: 定晚饭安排之前，我们查了一下这场「电影放映」会持续多久。

words.enDefinition: the recorded result in points or goals at the end of a game

examples.en: I sent the final score to the friends who couldn't make the match.
examples.zh: 我把「终场比分」发给了没来观赛的朋友。

examples.en: The referee checked the final score against the score sheet on the table.
examples.zh: 裁判把「终场比分」和桌上的计分表作了核对。

words.enDefinition: a button label for opening available ticket options for an event

examples.en: I selected "Find tickets", then checked which dates had any seats left.
examples.zh: 我点了「查找门票」，再看哪些日期还有座位。

examples.en: The link said "Find tickets", but the ticket sale hadn't started yet.
examples.zh: 链接上写着「查找门票」，不过门票还没开卖。

words.enDefinition: a pen with a narrow tip for fine lines

examples.en: I traced the window frames with a fineliner after finishing the pencil sketch.
examples.zh: 画完铅笔草图后，我用「细线笔」描了窗框。

examples.en: The fineliner I borrowed made lighter lines than the one in my bag.
examples.zh: 借来的「细线笔」画出的线比我包里那支浅。

words.enDefinition: the first play opportunity in a new series of downs in American football

examples.en: The crowd applauded when the college team earned a first down in the second quarter.
examples.zh: 第二节，学院球队拿到新的「美式橄榄球首档」，观众鼓掌了。

examples.en: I looked at the board after the announcer said we had a first down.
examples.zh: 播报员说我们拿到了「美式橄榄球首档」，我就看向记分牌。

words.enDefinition: the first of the two serving attempts normally allowed at a tennis point

examples.en: My first serve went into the net during the opening game on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二开场局中，我的「第一发球」下网了。

examples.en: She hit a strong first serve that the other player could barely reach.
examples.zh: 她的「第一发球」很有力，对方几乎够不到。

words.enDefinition: To find enough time for a session of exercise in a busy schedule.

examples.en: I managed to fit in a workout between my lab and an evening lecture.
examples.zh: 我在实验课和晚间讲座之间「抽空锻炼了一次」。

examples.en: My roommate hoped to fit in a workout before the recreation center closed that afternoon.
examples.zh: 室友希望在那天下午文体活动中心关门前「抽空锻炼一次」。

collocations: try to fit in a workout
fit in a workout between classes
find time to fit in a workout

words.enDefinition: A staff member who oversees a gym area and answers basic questions about the space.

examples.en: I asked the fitness attendant where the next equipment tour would start that morning.
examples.zh: 我问「健身区值班员」，当天上午下一场器械参观从哪儿开始。

examples.en: The fitness attendant set out a notice while we waited for our classmates to arrive.
examples.zh: 我们等同学过来时，「健身区值班员」摆了一块告示牌。

words.enDefinition: A list of people waiting for a place if a fitness class is full.

examples.en: I joined the fitness class waitlist after noticing that every reserved place had been taken.
examples.zh: 发现可预订的名额都满了，我加入了「健身课候补名单」。

examples.en: My roommate checked the fitness class waitlist while waiting for the instructor outside the studio.
examples.zh: 室友在团课教室外等教练时，查了「健身课候补名单」。

collocations: move someone off the fitness class waitlist

words.enDefinition: The main exercise area of a gym where equipment is laid out for use.

examples.en: A staff member showed us the fitness floor after we checked in downstairs together.
examples.zh: 我们在楼下一起签到后，工作人员带我们看了「健身器械区」。

examples.en: The fitness floor was quieter at lunchtime than it had been after our lectures.
examples.zh: 「健身器械区」在午饭时间比我们下课后去的时候安静。

collocations: a map of the fitness floor

words.enDefinition: A person who leads exercise sessions and explains what participants are doing.

examples.en: The fitness instructor introduced herself while we were waiting outside the studio that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午我们在团课教室外等候，「健身课教练」作了自我介绍。

examples.en: I asked the fitness instructor whether the session was in the same room next week.
examples.zh: 我问「健身课教练」，下周的课是否还在同一间教室。

collocations: ask the fitness instructor a question

words.enDefinition: A device that records physical activity data such as steps, time, or movement.

examples.en: I checked my fitness tracker when I got back to the residence hall after walking.
examples.zh: 散步回到宿舍楼后，我看了看自己的「运动追踪设备」。

examples.en: My classmate's fitness tracker showed a different distance from the figure on the gym display.
examples.zh: 同学的「运动追踪设备」显示的距离跟健身房屏幕上的数字不一样。

words.enDefinition: a schedule of matches planned for a team or competition

examples.en: I checked the fixture list to see which weekends would be free for travel.
examples.zh: 我看了「比赛日程表」，想知道哪几个周末能出去玩。

examples.en: The club updated its fixture list after two games had to be moved.
examples.zh: 两场比赛得改期后，俱乐部更新了「比赛日程表」。

words.enDefinition: A scene that jumps ahead to something later in the story's timeline.

examples.en: The episode began with a flash-forward to the main character's last day at school.
examples.zh: 这一集开头用「闪前」，先演了主角在学校的最后一天。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the flash-forward changed how we understood the events at the start.
examples.zh: 导师问，这段「闪前」有没有改变我们对开头那些事件的理解。

words.enDefinition: A scene that goes back to something which happened earlier in the story's timeline.

examples.en: The flashback explained how the two neighbors had met long before the main story began.
examples.zh: 「闪回」说明，在主线故事开始很久之前，两位邻居是怎么认识的。

examples.en: I missed a short flashback while I was making tea and had to ask about it.
examples.zh: 泡茶时我错过了一小段「闪回」，只好问刚才演了什么。

collocations: tell a story through a flashback

words.enDefinition: A firm cylinder of foam used in fitness and mobility activities.

examples.en: The foam roller was on the lowest shelf behind the pile of folded exercise mats.
examples.zh: 「泡沫轴」放在最下面一层，在那摞折好的垫子后面。

examples.en: The instructor returned the foam roller to the low shelf after the demonstration ended.
examples.zh: 示范结束后，教练把「泡沫轴」放回了低处的架子。

collocations: a foam roller on the shelf

words.enDefinition: the part of an image that attracts attention first

examples.en: I wanted the red doorway to be the focal point of the painting.
examples.zh: 我希望红门成为这幅画的「视觉焦点」。

examples.en: The focal point moved when I added the figure in the foreground.
examples.zh: 我在前景加上人物后，「视觉焦点」变了。

words.enDefinition: music rooted in community traditions or a style based on those traditions

examples.en: The campus event mixed folk music from different regions with stories from the performers.
examples.zh: 校园活动把不同地区的「民间音乐」与表演者讲的故事放到了一起。

examples.en: My roommate grew up hearing folk music at family gatherings in her hometown.
examples.zh: 室友从小在家乡的家庭聚会上听「民间音乐」。

words.enDefinition: to play a card in the same suit as the first card

examples.en: The rulebook explained when players needed to follow suit during each trick.
examples.zh: 规则手册解释了每墩牌什么时候需要「跟出相同花色」。

examples.en: My roommate couldn't follow suit because she had no cards of that suit.
examples.zh: 室友手里没有那个花色的牌，所以不能「跟出相同花色」。

words.enDefinition: sports shoes with studs or similar grips for use on a football pitch

examples.en: I left my football boots near the door so I wouldn't forget them before practice.
examples.zh: 我把「足球鞋」放在门边，免得训练前忘带。

examples.en: The shop sold different football boots for artificial turf and natural grass fields.
examples.zh: 商店出售分别适用人造草和天然草场的「足球鞋」。

words.enDefinition: a shot played on the same side of the body as the racket hand

examples.en: Her forehand landed just inside the line during our last practice game that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午最后一场练习赛，她的「正手击球」落在线内一点。

examples.en: I changed direction with a forehand after my opponent moved closer to the net.
examples.zh: 对方靠近球网后，我用一次「正手击球」改变了球的方向。

words.enDefinition: to lose a game by failing to appear, refusing to continue, or breaking a rule

examples.en: Our team had to forfeit because too few players arrived by the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止时间前到场的人太少，我们队不得不「弃权认负」。

examples.en: The captain asked whether we would forfeit if the replacement bus arrived after kickoff.
examples.zh: 队长问，如果换乘的大巴在开赛后才到，我们是否会「弃权认负」。

words.enDefinition: to lose the right to keep playing after reaching the allowed number of fouls

examples.en: Our captain was worried she might foul out before the end of the fourth quarter.
examples.zh: 队长担心自己第四节结束前会「犯规次数满而离场」。

examples.en: It was the first time I had seen a player foul out in our league.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次在我们的联赛里看到有球员「犯规次数满而离场」。

words.enDefinition: to choose what will be included and where it sits in an image

examples.en: I moved a little to frame a shot without the traffic sign.
examples.zh: 我挪了挪位置，「给照片取景」时避开那个交通标牌。

examples.en: My tutor asked us to frame a shot using the doorway.
examples.zh: 老师让我们利用门框「给照片取景」。

collocations: find a way to frame a shot
frame a shot with a doorway

words.enDefinition: a list through which people without a team can find a place in a league

examples.en: I put my name on the free agent list before the volleyball registration deadline.
examples.zh: 排球报名截止前，我把名字加进了「无队伍球员名单」。

examples.en: Our captain found an extra player through the free agent list that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我们队长通过「无队伍球员名单」找了一位额外的球员。

collocations: sign up on the free agent list

words.enDefinition: a kick awarded to a football team to restart play after an offence

examples.en: We could see the players get ready for the free kick just outside the area.
examples.zh: 我们能看见队员们准备踢禁区外的「任意球」。

examples.en: The referee awarded a free kick after stopping the match near the halfway line.
examples.zh: 裁判在中线附近叫停比赛后，判了一个「任意球」。

words.enDefinition: an unopposed basketball shot taken from a marked line after certain fouls or violations

examples.en: My flatmate scored the last free throw before the opposing team called a timeout.
examples.zh: 对方叫暂停前，室友投进了最后一个「篮球罚球」。

examples.en: The new player waited behind the line before taking her first free throw that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，新队员在标线后等着，准备第一次「篮球罚球」。

words.enDefinition: the marked line behind which a player stands to take a free throw

examples.en: I could see the shooter step behind the free throw line from our seats.
examples.zh: 从座位上，我能看到投手退到「篮球罚球线」后面。

examples.en: The referee pointed to the free throw line after checking with the score table.
examples.zh: 裁判和记录台确认后，指向了「篮球罚球线」。

collocations: stand behind the free throw line
go to the free throw line
step up to the free throw line

words.enDefinition: The part of a gym set aside for weights that are not attached to machines.

examples.en: The floor plan marked the free-weight area separately from the machines near the windows.
examples.zh: 平面图把「自由重量区」和窗边的固定器械分开标出。

examples.en: My roommate asked which sign pointed to the free-weight area when we toured the gym.
examples.zh: 我们参观健身房时，室友问哪块牌子指向「自由重量区」。

collocations: a sign for the free-weight area

words.enDefinition: Moveable weights, such as dumbbells, that are independent of a fixed machine.

examples.en: The floor map used a blue symbol to show where the free weights were stored.
examples.zh: 楼层图用一个蓝色符号标出了「自由重量器材」存放的位置。

examples.en: Our guide explained why the free weights were kept separate from the stationary bikes.
examples.zh: 向导解释了为什么「自由重量器材」要和固定式健身车放在不同地方。

words.enDefinition: a match played outside a formal league or competition for practice or enjoyment

examples.en: Our club arranged a friendly match with another college after the main season ended.
examples.zh: 正式赛季结束后，我们社团和另一所学院安排了一场「友谊赛」。

examples.en: I played my first friendly match before we chose the squad for the tournament.
examples.zh: 我们选出锦标赛阵容之前，我打了第一场「友谊赛」。

words.enDefinition: theatre outside the mainstream, often small-scale, experimental, or independently produced

examples.en: We saw some fringe theatre in a tiny room above a café.
examples.zh: 我们在一家咖啡馆楼上的小房间里看了场「非主流戏剧」。

examples.en: The drama department brought in two fringe theatre directors to discuss their work.
examples.zh: 戏剧系请来两位「非主流戏剧」导演分享他们的作品。

words.enDefinition: the performer who leads a band onstage and often interacts with the audience

examples.en: The frontperson told a short story while the others changed their instruments onstage.
examples.zh: 其他人在台上换乐器时，「乐队领衔表演者」讲了个小故事。

examples.en: The new frontperson made the crowd laugh halfway through the opening song last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚唱到开场曲一半，新的「乐队领衔表演者」把观众逗笑了。

words.enDefinition: a ticket sold at the regular price without a discount

examples.en: My cousin bought a full-price ticket because she was no longer a student.
examples.zh: 表姐已经不是学生了，所以买了一张「全价门票」。

examples.en: The website showed that a full-price ticket included the same seats.
examples.zh: 网站显示，「全价门票」对应的座位也是一样的。

words.enDefinition: the referee's whistle signalling the end of a football match

examples.en: We waited for the full-time whistle before our teammates joined us near the stand.
examples.zh: 我们等到「终场哨」响，队友才来和我们在看台旁会合。

examples.en: The score remained level until the full-time whistle late on Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 周六傍晚，比分一直打平到「终场哨」响。

words.enDefinition: a device designed primarily for playing video games

examples.en: My flatmate brought the game console into the common room after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后，室友把「游戏主机」搬到了公共休息室。

examples.en: The club kept its game console in a cabinet beside the television.
examples.zh: 社团把「游戏主机」放在电视旁的柜子里。

words.enDefinition: a virtual room where players gather before starting a game

examples.en: I joined the game lobby while everyone decided which mode to play.
examples.zh: 大家还在商量玩什么模式时，我进了「游戏等候大厅」。

examples.en: We returned to the game lobby after finishing the group puzzle.
examples.zh: 完成小组谜题后，我们回到了「游戏等候大厅」。

words.enDefinition: a person who presents a shared role-playing setting and guides play

examples.en: The game master described the town square before our characters arrived.
examples.zh: 我们的角色到达前，「桌面角色扮演主持人」介绍了城镇广场。

examples.en: Our game master asked everyone what kind of story they wanted to tell.
examples.zh: 「桌面角色扮演主持人」问大家想一起讲怎样的故事。

collocations: take turns being the game master

words.enDefinition: an object moved or placed to represent a player or action

examples.en: I chose the yellow game piece so my classmate could use blue.
examples.zh: 我选了黄色的「棋子」，这样同学就能用蓝色的。

examples.en: The game piece fell off the board when we moved the table.
examples.zh: 我们搬桌子时，「棋子」从棋盘上掉了下去。

collocations: place a game piece on the board

words.enDefinition: a status showing a scheduled game will be played later

examples.en: The notice read game postponed after heavy rain left water on the outdoor court.
examples.zh: 大雨使室外球场积水后，通知显示「比赛已延期」。

examples.en: Our team chat showed game postponed before the college announced a new date.
examples.zh: 学院还没公布新日期，我们队的群聊已经显示「比赛已延期」。

words.enDefinition: A program where contestants play games, answer questions, or compete for prizes.

examples.en: We guessed the answers together while a game show played in the residence lounge.
examples.zh: 宿舍休息室播着一档「电视竞赛节目」，我们就一起猜答案。

examples.en: The game show asked contestants to recognize songs from only the first few notes.
examples.zh: 这档「电视竞赛节目」要求参赛者只听开头几个音就认出歌曲。

collocations: a contestant on a game show

words.enDefinition: a notice saying that a game has been stopped temporarily

examples.en: The board read "Game suspended" while the officials looked at the field.
examples.zh: 裁判查看球场时，显示屏上写着「比赛暂时中止」。

examples.en: We saw "Game suspended" and waited for the next announcement together.
examples.zh: 看到「比赛暂时中止」后，我们一起等下一次广播。

words.enDefinition: a small object used to mark a value or state during play

examples.en: I put a game token beside the card to mark my choice.
examples.zh: 我在牌旁边放了一个「游戏标记物」，记下自己的选择。

examples.en: The blue game token showed how many chances we had left.
examples.zh: 蓝色「游戏标记物」显示我们还剩几次机会。

words.enDefinition: a handheld unit with buttons and directional controls for games

examples.en: I was more comfortable using a gamepad than a keyboard for this game.
examples.zh: 玩这个游戏，我用「游戏手柄」比用键盘更顺手。

examples.en: The instructions showed which gamepad buttons to use for the first puzzle.
examples.zh: 说明提示第一道谜题要用哪些「游戏手柄」按键。

words.enDefinition: continuous playback without adding silence between consecutive tracks

examples.en: The recording sounded more natural with gapless playback because the applause never dropped out.
examples.zh: 用「无间隙播放」听这张录音更自然，掌声不会突然中断。

examples.en: My flatmate turned on gapless playback for the album recorded at a single concert.
examples.zh: 室友给那张整场音乐会录下的专辑开了「无间隙播放」。

words.enDefinition: someone responsible for helping or checking people at an entry gate

examples.en: The gate attendant read my ticket and pointed us toward the stairs.
examples.zh: 「入口工作人员」看了我的票，给我们指了楼梯的方向。

examples.en: A gate attendant pointed out the sign for the student entrance.
examples.zh: 一位「入口工作人员」给我指了学生专用入口的标牌。

words.enDefinition: a schedule label for the time a venue starts admitting people

examples.en: The notice said "Gates open at noon" for the afternoon match.
examples.zh: 下午那场比赛的告示写着「中午开放场馆入口」。

examples.en: I found the line marked "Gates open" in the event email.
examples.zh: 我在活动邮件里找到了标着「开放场馆入口」的一行。

words.enDefinition: an admission category without a specific assigned individual seat

examples.en: Our general admission ticket let us choose any open seat within our section.
examples.zh: 这张票「入场不指定座位」，我们可以坐本区内任意空座。

examples.en: Our tickets said general admission, so there were no seat numbers.
examples.zh: 我们的票写着「入场不指定座位」，所以没有座位号。

words.enDefinition: the stage when tickets are available to the wider public

examples.en: The general sale began after the university members had their early access.
examples.zh: 学校会员享受优先购买后，门票开始「面向公众发售」。

examples.en: I waited for the general sale because I wasn't part of the club.
examples.zh: 我不是俱乐部成员，就等到「面向公众发售」再买。

words.enDefinition: To begin exercising again after a period of doing little or none.

examples.en: I wanted to get back into exercise after a busy month of deadlines and exams.
examples.zh: 忙了整整一个月赶作业和考试后，我想「重新开始锻炼」。

examples.en: My classmate decided to get back into exercise after moving closer to the campus gym.
examples.zh: 搬到离校园健身房更近的地方后，同学决定「重新开始锻炼」。

collocations: want to get back into exercise
try to get back into exercise
decide to get back into exercise

words.enDefinition: an informal word for a live performance by a musician or band

examples.en: My flatmate played a gig at the student bar after our project ended.
examples.zh: 项目结束后，室友在学生酒吧做了「一场现场演出」。

examples.en: We caught a small gig near the main campus on our way home.
examples.zh: 回家路上，我们在主校区附近看了「一场小型现场演出」。

words.enDefinition: asks an audience to applaud or cheer for a particular person

examples.en: The announcer said "Give it up for the volunteers" just before the last match.
examples.zh: 最后一场比赛开始前，广播员说：「请为志愿者鼓掌」。

examples.en: We heard "Give it up for our dancers" over the speakers at halftime.
examples.zh: 中场休息时扩音器里传来「请为我们的舞者鼓掌」。

collocations: give it up for the performers
please give it up for the band
give it up for our volunteers

words.enDefinition: to offer feedback on what performers should change after a rehearsal

examples.en: The director waited until the end of the rehearsal to give notes.
examples.zh: 导演等到排练结束才「给演员提调整意见」。

examples.en: My choreography tutor likes to give notes after watching the whole piece.
examples.zh: 我的编舞老师喜欢看完整段表演再「给演员提调整意见」。

words.enDefinition: to proceed around a circle in the direction of clock hands

examples.en: We agreed to go clockwise around the table after choosing the first player.
examples.zh: 选出先手玩家后，我们约好沿着桌子「按顺时针轮流」。

examples.en: The rulebook said to go clockwise from the person holding the marker.
examples.zh: 规则手册写着，从拿标记物的人开始「按顺时针轮流」。

words.enDefinition: to continue a game beyond regular playing time, typically because the score is tied

examples.en: We thought the basketball game might go into overtime with thirty seconds remaining.
examples.zh: 还剩三十秒时，我们觉得篮球赛可能会「进入加时赛」。

examples.en: I checked the bus schedule in case our final had to go into overtime.
examples.zh: 我查了公交时刻表，以防决赛得「进入加时赛」。

collocations: be likely to go into overtime

words.enDefinition: the number of goals scored minus the number conceded by a team

examples.en: Our team went ahead on goal difference even though both clubs had equal points.
examples.zh: 虽然两队积分一样，我们凭「净胜球数」排名领先。

examples.en: I worked out the goal difference using both scores from the previous round.
examples.zh: 我用上一轮的进球数和失球数算出了「净胜球数」。

words.enDefinition: a restart for the defending team usually given when the whole ball crosses the goal line without a goal, having last touched an attacker

examples.en: The goalkeeper took a goal kick after the shot went wide of the post.
examples.zh: 射门偏出门柱后，守门员开出「球门球」。

examples.en: We moved farther up the field while the other team prepared for a goal kick.
examples.zh: 对方准备开「球门球」时，我们往球场前方移动。

words.enDefinition: the line along the entire end of a football pitch, on which the goal is placed

examples.en: The officials checked whether the entire ball had crossed the goal line before stopping play.
examples.zh: 叫停比赛前，裁判组确认整个球是否越过了「球门线」。

examples.en: The student keeper stood on the goal line as the other players got ready.
examples.zh: 其他队员准备时，那名学生守门员站在「球门线」上。

words.enDefinition: the player assigned to protect the goal and stop the other team from scoring

examples.en: Our goalkeeper spoke to each new player before the first match of the term.
examples.zh: 本学期第一场比赛前，我们的「守门员」和每个新队员都聊了几句。

examples.en: The goalkeeper caught the loose ball and waited for the players to move farther away.
examples.zh: 「守门员」接住了没人控制的球，等其他队员离开一些。

words.enDefinition: the period near sunrise or sunset when sunlight often looks warm and soft

examples.en: We reached the park during golden hour and photographed the tree shadows.
examples.zh: 我们在「摄影黄金时段」到了公园，拍了树影。

examples.en: My friend wanted to return during golden hour for softer light.
examples.zh: 朋友想在「摄影黄金时段」再来一趟，拍到更柔和的光线。

words.enDefinition: a friendly expression used to acknowledge a completed game

examples.en: “Good game,” my classmate said even though our team came second.
examples.zh: 我们队得了第二，但同学还是说了声「打得好」。

examples.en: I typed “Good game” after the other team matched the final tile.
examples.zh: 对方配好了最后一个方块后，我打字说「打得好」。

words.enDefinition: water-based paint that generally dries to an opaque finish

examples.en: I tried gouache for the poster so the cream letters would stand out.
examples.zh: 做海报时，我试了「水粉颜料」，想让浅米色的字更醒目。

examples.en: Gouache looked less transparent than the paint I had used that morning.
examples.zh: 「水粉颜料」看上去比我上午用的颜料更不透明。

words.enDefinition: a large tiered structure for spectators beside a sports area

examples.en: A loud cheer came from the grandstand after the close finish.
examples.zh: 比赛临近结束、胜负难分时，「大型看台」上爆发出一阵欢呼。

examples.en: My friends watched from the grandstand rather than standing by the track.
examples.zh: 朋友没站在跑道边，而是在「大型看台」上观看。

words.enDefinition: a book-length story told mainly through sequential images and text

examples.en: I finished a graphic novel while waiting for the others to arrive.
examples.zh: 等其他人来的时候，我读完了一本「图像小说」。

examples.en: The book club chose a graphic novel with almost no dialogue.
examples.zh: 读书会选了一本几乎没有对白的「图像小说」。

words.enDefinition: a drawing pencil with a core made mainly of graphite

examples.en: I used a graphite pencil to mark where the vase would sit.
examples.zh: 我用「石墨铅笔」标出画面上花瓶的位置。

examples.en: My friend handed me a graphite pencil when mine rolled under the table.
examples.zh: 我的笔滚到桌子底下后，朋友递给我一支「石墨铅笔」。

words.enDefinition: a collection of an artist's most successful or best-known recordings

examples.en: My host family played a greatest hits album on nearly every drive into town.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭几乎每次开车进城都播放一张「热门作品精选专辑」。

examples.en: The greatest hits album was the first record from the band that I bought.
examples.zh: 我买这支乐队的第一张唱片就是「热门作品精选专辑」。

collocations: tracks on a greatest hits album

words.enDefinition: a room where performers can wait or relax before going onstage

examples.en: We waited in the green room until the first performance had ended.
examples.zh: 我们在「演员休息室」等到第一场表演结束。

examples.en: My friend left a bottle of water for me in the green room.
examples.zh: 朋友在「演员休息室」给我留了一瓶水。

words.enDefinition: An organized exercise session in which an instructor leads a group.

examples.en: We tried a group fitness class after seeing it listed on the recreation center's website.
examples.zh: 我们在校园文体中心网站上看到了这门「团体健身课」，就去试了一次。

examples.en: My roommate chose a group fitness class that finished before her evening shift started.
examples.zh: 室友选了门「团体健身课」，下课后还能赶上晚班。

collocations: a group fitness class for beginners

words.enDefinition: A list of exercise classes with their times and usually their locations.

examples.en: I checked the group fitness schedule before choosing a time that worked for my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先查了「团体健身课时间表」，再选了室友方便的时间。

examples.en: The group fitness schedule showed a new room next to the Thursday evening class.
examples.zh: 「团体健身课时间表」在星期四晚课旁注明了新教室。

collocations: a change to the group fitness schedule

words.enDefinition: A room in a fitness facility where organized exercise classes are held.

examples.en: Our instructor met us outside the group fitness studio before the room was unlocked.
examples.zh: 房间开锁前，教练在「团课教室」外和我们碰头。

examples.en: The map showed the group fitness studio next to the stairs on the second floor.
examples.zh: 地图显示，「团课教室」就在二楼楼梯旁。

collocations: meet outside the group fitness studio
classes in the group fitness studio

words.enDefinition: the part of a tournament when teams first play in separate groups

examples.en: We watched two matches in the group stage before returning to campus for dinner.
examples.zh: 回学校吃晚饭前，我们看了两场「小组赛阶段」的比赛。

examples.en: The group stage ended on Friday, and the top teams played again the following week.
examples.zh: 「小组赛阶段」在周五结束，成绩靠前的球队下一周继续比赛。

words.enDefinition: a counter where event visitors can get information or help

examples.en: The volunteer sent us to the guest services desk for a venue map.
examples.zh: 志愿者让我们到「观众服务台」拿场馆地图。

examples.en: The guest services desk was near the end of the main walkway.
examples.zh: 「观众服务台」靠近主通道的尽头。

collocations: ask at the guest services desk

words.enDefinition: a singer invited to perform on a particular track or show

examples.en: The band brought out a guest vocalist for one song near the end.
examples.zh: 乐队快结束演出时，请了一位「客座歌手」唱其中一首歌。

examples.en: A guest vocalist sings the chorus on the recording we heard in class.
examples.zh: 我们课上听过的录音，副歌由一位「客座歌手」演唱。

words.enDefinition: a short pattern of notes played repeatedly on a guitar within a piece

examples.en: The opening guitar riff reminded me of a song we heard on campus radio.
examples.zh: 开头的「吉他重复短乐句」让我想起了校园电台放过一首歌。

examples.en: My classmate played the guitar riff slowly so I could work out the rhythm.
examples.zh: 同学把「吉他重复短乐句」弹慢一些，让我能弄清节奏。

words.enDefinition: The step of confirming your arrival before entering a gym.

examples.en: The gym check-in desk moved to the other side of the lobby during maintenance.
examples.zh: 维修期间，「健身房入场登记」服务台搬到了大厅另一侧。

examples.en: I finished gym check-in while my roommate looked for the schedule by the entrance.
examples.zh: 我完成「健身房入场登记」时，室友在入口附近找时间表。

words.enDefinition: A small open compartment in a gym where visitors can put belongings.

examples.en: My roommate found an empty gym cubby for her bag near the studio door.
examples.zh: 室友在团课教室门旁找到了一个空的「健身房开放储物格」放包。

examples.en: A number on each gym cubby helped everyone find their shoes after class ended.
examples.zh: 每个「健身房开放储物格」都有编号，方便大家下课后找鞋。

collocations: put a bag in a gym cubby

words.enDefinition: An introductory session explaining a gym's spaces, services, and expectations for use.

examples.en: We signed up for a gym orientation because neither of us knew the layout.
examples.zh: 我俩都不了解里面的布局，所以报名参加了「健身房入门介绍」。

examples.en: My first gym orientation included a short tour and a chance to ask questions.
examples.zh: 我第一次参加「健身房入门介绍」，有简短的参观环节，也可以提问。

collocations: sign up for a gym orientation
a gym orientation for new students

words.enDefinition: Rules established by a particular gym for the people using it.

examples.en: I read the gym rules while waiting for my roommate to finish checking in.
examples.zh: 等室友完成入场登记时，我看了看「健身房使用规定」。

examples.en: The gym rules were posted next to the floor map in the main lobby.
examples.zh: 「健身房使用规定」就贴在主大厅的楼层图旁。

words.enDefinition: a performance presented during the break halfway through a sports game

examples.en: We stayed in our seats to watch the marching band's halftime show.
examples.zh: 我们留在座位上，看行进乐队的「中场表演」。

examples.en: My coursemate performed in the halftime show at our first home game.
examples.zh: 同专业同学参加了我们第一场主场比赛的「中场表演」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of cards a player may hold

examples.en: I reached the hand limit after drawing the two extra cards.
examples.zh: 抽完额外两张牌后，我达到了「手牌上限」。

examples.en: We checked the hand limit before ending the practice round together.
examples.zh: 练习轮结束前，我们一起核对了「手牌上限」。

words.enDefinition: the cards held by a player and available for use

examples.en: I checked my hand of cards before choosing which one to play.
examples.zh: 我先看了看自己的「一手牌」，然后才选出哪张。

examples.en: My friend set her hand of cards face down during the break.
examples.zh: 休息时，朋友把自己的「一手牌」牌面朝下放着。

collocations: look at your hand of cards

words.enDefinition: joining cloth with a needle and thread without a machine

examples.en: I tried hand sewing for the first time at the repair café.
examples.zh: 我在维修咖啡馆第一次试了「手工缝纫」。

examples.en: The workshop used hand sewing to attach small decorations to cloth bags.
examples.zh: 工作坊用「手工缝纫」把小装饰缝在布包上。

words.enDefinition: a marker made by hand for keeping your place in a book

examples.en: I slipped a handmade bookmark into the book before lending it.
examples.zh: 把书借出去前，我夹了一张「手工书签」进去。

examples.en: The craft group gave each visitor a handmade bookmark to take home.
examples.zh: 手作小组给每位访客一张「手工书签」带回家。

words.enDefinition: a line of opposing players greeting each other with handshakes after a game

examples.en: Both teams joined the handshake line after the last point of the final.
examples.zh: 决赛最后一分打完后，两队开始「赛后列队握手」。

examples.en: Our coach waited for the handshake line to end before speaking to the team.
examples.zh: 教练等「赛后列队握手」结束后才跟大家讲话。

words.enDefinition: three goals or other notable successes achieved by one player in a game

examples.en: My roommate scored a hat trick in the last football match of the term.
examples.zh: 本学期最后一场足球赛，室友上演了「帽子戏法」。

examples.en: The crowd applauded after the third goal completed a hat trick for the forward.
examples.zh: 第三个进球让前锋完成了「帽子戏法」，观众随即鼓掌。

words.enDefinition: the main performer advertised for a show or event

examples.en: The headliner went on later than planned because the earlier set ran long.
examples.zh: 前一组表演延长了，「主打艺人」比计划晚出场。

examples.en: A friend from my course recommended the headliner before we went to the festival.
examples.zh: 我们去节庆演出前，同一门课的朋友推荐了那位「主打艺人」。

words.enDefinition: an audience member who interrupts a performer by calling out

examples.en: A heckler kept interrupting until one of the ushers spoke to him.
examples.zh: 一个「起哄打断演出的人」一直在插嘴，直到有位引座员找他谈了话。

examples.en: The comedian paused after a heckler shouted from the back row.
examples.zh: 一个「起哄打断演出的人」从最后一排喊了一声，喜剧演员停了下来。

words.enDefinition: a game identity known to its player but concealed from others

examples.en: Each player had a hidden role that affected which clues they could give.
examples.zh: 每个玩家都有一个「隐藏身份」，影响自己能给哪些线索。

examples.en: I forgot my hidden role and checked the card under my hand.
examples.zh: 我忘了自己的「隐藏身份」，就看了看手下那张牌。

words.enDefinition: an unlisted recording placed within or after the apparent end of a release

examples.en: We discovered a hidden track after letting the final song play past the silence.
examples.zh: 我们让最后一首歌继续放过那段静音后，发现了一首「未标出的隐藏曲目」。

examples.en: My friend told me to wait for the hidden track on the older disc.
examples.zh: 朋友让我等一等旧碟上的「未标出的隐藏曲目」。

words.enDefinition: Exercise involving more forceful contact with the ground, often when landing after a jump.

examples.en: The class description said it included high-impact exercise, so I asked what the term meant.
examples.zh: 课程介绍说里面有「高冲击运动」，我就问这个词是什么意思。

examples.en: My roommate noticed the phrase high-impact exercise while comparing two sessions on the timetable.
examples.zh: 室友在时间表上对比两门课时，留意到了「高冲击运动」这个说法。

words.enDefinition: a feature giving clues to help players solve a challenge

examples.en: We used the hint system when the last part of the puzzle confused us.
examples.zh: 谜题的最后一部分没看明白，我们就用了「提示系统」。

examples.en: The hint system gave me a small clue without revealing the answer.
examples.zh: 「提示系统」给了我一点线索，没有直接揭晓答案。

words.enDefinition: a musical style within hip-hop culture, commonly using rapped vocals and rhythmic beats

examples.en: The library hosted a discussion about hip-hop and spoken performance that Thursday evening.
examples.zh: 那周四傍晚，图书馆办了一场关于「嘻哈音乐」和口述表演的讨论。

examples.en: My flatmate made a hip-hop playlist for our long bus ride after exams.
examples.zh: 室友为我们考后坐长途公交做了一份「嘻哈音乐」歌单。

words.enDefinition: to strike one of the vertical goalposts, said especially of a shot

examples.en: It looked like the shot would hit the post before rolling out of play.
examples.zh: 那脚射门看起来会「击中门柱」，然后滚出界。

examples.en: We saw the ball hit the post just as the goalkeeper stepped forward.
examples.zh: 守门员刚向前迈步，我们就看见球「击中门柱」。

collocations: see a shot hit the post

words.enDefinition: to reach the exact position specified for you onstage

examples.en: You have to hit your mark before the lights change in this scene.
examples.zh: 在这场戏的灯光变换前，你得「走到规定站位」。

examples.en: It's easier to hit your mark if you remember where your partner stands.
examples.zh: 记住搭档站在哪儿，就更容易「走到规定站位」。

collocations: practise how to hit your mark

words.enDefinition: to keep selected seats unavailable to others for a limited time

examples.en: The booking site could hold seats while I checked the date again.
examples.zh: 我重新核对日期时，订票网站可以「暂时锁定座位」。

examples.en: The salesperson offered to hold seats until I had found my card.
examples.zh: 售票员说可以「暂时锁定座位」，等我把卡找出来。

words.enDefinition: spectators mainly supporting the team playing at its own venue

examples.en: The home crowd got louder when the players returned to the court.
examples.zh: 球员回到球场时，「主场观众」的声音更大了。

examples.en: I was surprised by how early the home crowd filled the stands.
examples.zh: 「主场观众」很早就坐满了看台，我挺意外。

words.enDefinition: a baseball hit that allows the batter to score by rounding all the bases

examples.en: The college team cheered when its newest player hit a home run on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六，学院队最新加入的队员打出一个「本垒打」，全队欢呼起来。

examples.en: We missed the home run because we were still walking to the stands.
examples.zh: 我们还在走去看台的路上，错过了那个「本垒打」。

words.enDefinition: the area set aside for supporters of the host team

examples.en: My roommate found us seats in the home supporters' section for Saturday's match.
examples.zh: 室友给我们在「主队球迷区」找到了周六比赛的座位。

examples.en: The home supporters' section started singing when the players walked onto the field.
examples.zh: 球员走上球场时，「主队球迷区」的人开始唱歌。

collocations: sit in the home supporters' section
tickets for the home supporters' section

words.enDefinition: A film intended to frighten or unsettle viewers.

examples.en: I watched the horror film with both lights on while my roommate finished her work.
examples.zh: 室友忙着把工作做完时，我开了两盏灯看这部「恐怖电影」。

examples.en: The horror film was unsettling mostly because we could hear things we couldn't see.
examples.zh: 这部「恐怖电影」让人不安，主要是因为能听见动静，却看不见是什么。

words.enDefinition: a private room at an event venue for watching and hosting guests

examples.en: The alumni group watched the match from a hospitality suite upstairs.
examples.zh: 校友小组在楼上的「场馆贵宾包厢」看了比赛。

examples.en: Our department used a hospitality suite for a small group of guests.
examples.zh: 我们系安排一小群客人在「场馆贵宾包厢」观赛。

words.enDefinition: a band that performs regularly at a particular venue or on a programme

examples.en: The house band played while everyone waited for the first student singer to arrive.
examples.zh: 大家等第一位学生歌手到场时，「场地常驻乐队」在台上演奏。

examples.en: I recognised the guitarist from the house band when I went back a week later.
examples.zh: 一周后再去时，我认出了「场地常驻乐队」的吉他手。

words.enDefinition: lights that illuminate the audience area in a theatre

examples.en: We put our programmes away as the house lights began to dim.
examples.zh: 「观众席照明」开始变暗时，我们把节目册收了起来。

examples.en: The house lights came up while the performers were still applauding the crew.
examples.zh: 表演者还在为工作人员鼓掌时，「观众席照明」亮了起来。

collocations: wait for the house lights to come on

words.enDefinition: a style of electronic dance music with a steady beat, originating in Chicago

examples.en: The DJ switched to house music after the first group finished its campus performance.
examples.zh: 第一个团队结束校园演出后，DJ 换成了「浩室舞曲」。

examples.en: My classmate lent me an album of house music to try on the train.
examples.zh: 同学借我一张「浩室舞曲」专辑，让我在火车上听听。

words.enDefinition: a rule a group uses in place of or alongside the usual rules

examples.en: Our house rule allowed anyone to explain a clue twice.
examples.zh: 我们的「自定规则」允许任何人把一条线索讲两遍。

examples.en: I asked whether the timer was part of the rules or a house rule.
examples.zh: 我问用计时器是原规则里就有，还是一条「自定规则」。

words.expression: how many sets do you have left
words.lemma: how many sets do you have left
words.enDefinition: A gym question asking how much of a person's exercise at a station remains.
acceptedEnVariants: how many sets do you have left

examples.en: I asked “How many sets do you have left?” while waiting beside the weight bench.
examples.zh: 我在训练凳旁等时问了句「你还剩几组」？

examples.en: “How many sets do you have left?” my roommate asked after the busy class finished.
examples.zh: 人很多的那节课结束后，室友问「你还剩几组」？

collocations: ask how many sets do you have left
say how many sets do you have left
ask politely how many sets do you have left

words.enDefinition: a group that performs scenes they make up on the spot

examples.en: I went to see the improv troupe perform in the student centre.
examples.zh: 我去学生中心看了「即兴表演团」的演出。

examples.en: The improv troupe used a suggestion about laundry for its first scene.
examples.zh: 「即兴表演团」用一个关于洗衣的点子演了第一场戏。

words.enDefinition: to make up a spoken line without following the script

examples.en: The theatre game asked each of us to improvise a line about the room.
examples.zh: 戏剧游戏让我们每个人针对这个房间「即兴说一句台词」。

examples.en: She wanted to improvise a line after the director cut the original joke.
examples.zh: 导演删掉原来的笑话后，她想「即兴说一句台词」。

words.enDefinition: an earpiece that lets a musician hear a selected mix while performing

examples.en: The drummer took out an in-ear monitor to speak to us before the show.
examples.zh: 演出开始前，鼓手摘下一只「入耳式返听耳机」跟我们说话。

examples.en: One in-ear monitor stopped working just before the band began its rehearsal that night.
examples.zh: 那晚乐队开始排练前，一只「入耳式返听耳机」突然没声音了。

words.enDefinition: an explanation or practice sequence presented inside the game

examples.en: I finished the in-game tutorial during the break before everyone else arrived.
examples.zh: 其他人到之前，我趁休息时间完成了「游戏内教程」。

examples.en: The in-game tutorial showed me how to choose and move a piece.
examples.zh: 「游戏内教程」给我演示了怎样选择并移动棋子。

words.enDefinition: rock music associated with independent scenes and a variety of alternative styles

examples.en: We listened to indie rock at the café recommended by our former flatmate.
examples.zh: 我们在老室友推荐的咖啡馆里听了「独立摇滚」。

examples.en: My friend started an indie rock band with classmates from the music department.
examples.zh: 朋友和音乐系的几名同学组了一支「独立摇滚」乐队。

words.enDefinition: a free kick that cannot score directly unless another player touches the ball

examples.en: The referee signalled an indirect free kick after talking to the assistant near us.
examples.zh: 裁判和我们附近的助理裁判交谈后，示意判「间接任意球」。

examples.en: Our coach explained why the goal did not count from the indirect free kick.
examples.zh: 教练解释了为什么那个「间接任意球」直接进门不算分。

words.enDefinition: An instructor-led class in which participants pedal stationary bikes indoors.

examples.en: We walked past the indoor cycling class and could hear music through the studio door.
examples.zh: 我们经过「室内骑行课」时，隔着教室门听见了音乐。

examples.en: My roommate chose an indoor cycling class that started after her last lab on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 室友选了「室内骑行课」，星期三最后一堂实验课之后开课。

words.enDefinition: A sign stating that only footwear reserved for indoor use is allowed in an area.

examples.en: A small notice saying “Indoor shoes only” was posted beside the entrance to the studio.
examples.zh: 团课教室入口旁贴着一张小告示，写着「仅限室内用鞋」。

examples.en: I saw “Indoor shoes only” on the door while waiting for our instructor to arrive.
examples.zh: 等教练来时，我看到门上写着「仅限室内用鞋」。

collocations: a sign saying indoor shoes only
a room marked indoor shoes only
a notice reading indoor shoes only

words.enDefinition: A track inside a building for people to walk or run on.

examples.en: We met beside the indoor track to see whether it was open during lunch.
examples.zh: 我们在「室内跑道」旁碰头，看看午饭时间这里开不开放。

examples.en: The campus gym's indoor track was visible from the seating area near the stairs.
examples.zh: 从楼梯旁的座位区，可以看到校园健身房的「室内跑道」。

words.enDefinition: a recording of a recent moment shown again during an event

examples.en: We saw an instant replay and finally understood why everyone had cheered.
examples.zh: 看过「即时回放」后，我们终于明白大家为什么欢呼。

examples.en: The screen showed an instant replay while the players were standing still.
examples.zh: 球员站着不动时，大屏显示了「即时回放」。

collocations: see an instant replay on the screen

words.enDefinition: An example shown by the instructor to help participants understand an activity.

examples.en: The class started with an instructor demonstration while we stood near the front of the studio.
examples.zh: 课程从「教练示范」开始，当时我们站在团课教室前面。

examples.en: I had a clear view of the instructor demonstration from the mat near the window.
examples.zh: 我坐在窗边的垫子上，能清楚看见「教练示范」。

collocations: an instructor demonstration at the front

words.enDefinition: a recorded track performed with instruments and without sung words

examples.en: I added an instrumental track to the playlist I use for writing essays.
examples.zh: 我在写论文听的歌单里加了一首「无唱词的器乐曲目」。

examples.en: The final instrumental track used the same melody as the album's first song.
examples.zh: 最后一首「无唱词的器乐曲目」用了和专辑第一首歌相同的旋律。

words.enDefinition: a contest between teams or athletes from different colleges or universities

examples.en: Our rowing team entered an intercollegiate competition hosted by a university across town.
examples.zh: 我们的赛艇队参加了城另一头一所大学主办的「校际比赛」。

examples.en: The coach picked two first-year players for the intercollegiate competition this spring.
examples.zh: 教练选了两名一年级选手参加今年春季的「校际比赛」。

words.enDefinition: a short piece of music between longer songs or sections

examples.en: The piano interlude gave everyone time to settle back into their seats.
examples.zh: 那段钢琴「间奏小段」让大家有时间重新坐好。

examples.en: There was a quiet interlude between the two loud tracks on the album.
examples.zh: 专辑里两首很响的曲子之间有一个安静的「间奏小段」。

words.enDefinition: a break between parts of a performance, often between acts

examples.en: We talked about the first act outside the theatre during intermission.
examples.zh: 「中场休息」时，我们在剧场外聊了聊第一幕。

examples.en: The pianist came back to play another piece after the intermission.
examples.zh: 「中场休息」结束后，钢琴手回来又弹了一首曲子。

words.enDefinition: a small performance space where the audience feels close to the performers

examples.en: The band chose an intimate venue where we could see the performers clearly.
examples.zh: 乐队选了一个「小型近距离演出场地」，我们能清楚看到表演者。

examples.en: I preferred the intimate venue to the large arena where they had played before.
examples.zh: 比起他们以前演出过的大型场馆，我更喜欢这个「小型近距离演出场地」。

collocations: an intimate venue for live music

words.enDefinition: organized sports in which teams within the same university or institution play each other

examples.en: I signed up for intramural sports because I wanted to play without travelling every weekend.
examples.zh: 我想参加比赛又不想每周末外出，就报名参加了「校内体育比赛」。

examples.en: The university listed intramural sports beside club teams in its recreation guide.
examples.zh: 大学的文体活动指南并列介绍了「校内体育比赛」和社团运动队。

words.enDefinition: A question asking whether a piece of equipment or a space is currently being used.

examples.en: I asked “Is anyone using this?” when I found a bottle beside the bench.
examples.zh: 我发现训练凳旁放着一个瓶子，就问「这个有人在用吗」？

examples.en: “Is anyone using this?” she asked about the mat beside the studio door today.
examples.zh: 她指着团课教室门边的垫子问「这个有人在用吗」？

collocations: check by asking is anyone using this

words.enDefinition: A conversational comment that part of a story or viewing experience felt too slow.

examples.en: I enjoyed the film overall, although it dragged a bit before the final scene.
examples.zh: 整体上我喜欢这部片，不过最后一场戏之前「有点拖沓」。

examples.en: My roommate said it dragged a bit while the two friends waited for the bus.
examples.zh: 室友说，那两个朋友等公交车的那段「有点拖沓」。

collocations: it dragged a bit in the middle
it dragged a bit near the end

words.enDefinition: an informal get-together where musicians play together, often without a fixed arrangement

examples.en: I brought my guitar to the jam session after finishing my last class.
examples.zh: 上完最后一节课后，我带吉他去了「即兴合奏活动」。

examples.en: Our jam session became quieter once we moved from the courtyard into the common room.
examples.zh: 我们从庭院移到公共休息室后，「即兴合奏活动」安静了一些。

words.enDefinition: a well-known jazz piece that many performers regularly learn or perform

examples.en: The pianist opened with a jazz standard that several students in the audience recognised.
examples.zh: 钢琴手用一首观众席上好几位学生都认识的「爵士常演经典曲」开场。

examples.en: I learned a jazz standard with two classmates before the evening jam session.
examples.zh: 晚间即兴合奏活动前，我和两位同学学了一首「爵士常演经典曲」。

words.enDefinition: to enter an online match after it has already started

examples.en: I asked whether I could join in progress after my study group finished.
examples.zh: 学习小组活动结束后，我问能不能「中途加入对局」。

examples.en: The settings allowed friends to join in progress without restarting the round.
examples.zh: 设置允许朋友「中途加入对局」，不用把这一轮重开。

collocations: allow players to join in progress

words.enDefinition: the opening part of a joke that prepares listeners for its ending

examples.en: My partner shortened the joke setup so we reached the ending sooner.
examples.zh: 搭档缩短了「笑话铺垫」，这样我们更快就能讲到结尾。

examples.en: The joke setup mentioned a lost umbrella before the story took a turn.
examples.zh: 「笑话铺垫」提到一把丢了的伞，之后故事来了个转折。

words.enDefinition: a way of starting or resuming basketball play in which an official tosses the ball between opposing players

examples.en: The referee called for a jump ball while the two players waited near centre court.
examples.zh: 裁判示意「跳球争球」时，两名球员在球场中央附近等着。

examples.en: Our team gained possession after the jump ball at the start of the game.
examples.zh: 比赛开始「跳球争球」后，我们队拿到了球权。

collocations: take part in a jump ball

words.enDefinition: A piece of fitness equipment consisting of a rope with a handle at each end.

examples.en: I found a jump rope in the basket labeled for equipment used in class.
examples.zh: 我在标着上课用具的筐里找到了一根「跳绳」。

examples.en: My classmate recognized her jump rope because one handle was a different color from the other.
examples.zh: 同学认出了自己的「跳绳」，因为两个手柄颜色不一样。

words.enDefinition: a shot in which the basketball player releases the ball while in the air

examples.en: The club replayed the jump shot at the end of its highlight video.
examples.zh: 俱乐部在集锦视频结尾回放了那个「跳投」。

examples.en: He made a jump shot from just inside the line during practice on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二练习时，他在线内不远处命中一次「跳投」。

words.enDefinition: popular music from South Korea, often associated with its recorded and live pop industry

examples.en: The dance society practised a routine to K-pop in the common room after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，舞蹈社在公共休息室配合「韩国流行音乐」练舞。

examples.en: My roommates shared their favourite K-pop tracks while we cooked dinner for the group.
examples.zh: 我们给大家做晚饭时，室友们分享了最喜欢的「韩国流行音乐」曲目。

words.enDefinition: a recording prepared for someone to sing along to without the original lead vocal

examples.en: We tried the karaoke track once before asking everyone else to join us.
examples.zh: 我们先试唱了一遍「卡拉 OK 伴奏曲」，才请其他人加入。

examples.en: I chose a karaoke track that started with a simple piano introduction that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚我选了一首以简单钢琴前奏开场的「卡拉 OK 伴奏曲」。

collocations: sing along to a karaoke track

words.enDefinition: To repeatedly pause while waiting for more content to load for playback.

examples.en: Videos keep buffering in the lounge, but the same film played in my room.
examples.zh: 公共休息室里的视频「不断缓冲」，同一部片在我房间却能播。

examples.en: Why does it keep buffering just as the music starts in the opening scene?
examples.zh: 怎么开场戏音乐刚响，就开始「不断缓冲」了？

words.enDefinition: to maintain or follow the pulse of a piece of music

examples.en: I tried to keep time by listening to the drummer instead of watching the lights.
examples.zh: 我尽量听鼓手来「合着节拍」，不去看灯光。

examples.en: The piano helped us keep time while the singers learned the new arrangement.
examples.zh: 歌手学新编排时，钢琴帮我们「合着节拍」。

words.enDefinition: A solid weight with a curved handle above its rounded body.

examples.en: A kettlebell with a bright handle stood out from the other weights on the shelf.
examples.zh: 架子上一只提手颜色鲜亮的「壶铃」在其他重量器材中格外显眼。

examples.en: My classmate recognized the kettlebell from its shape before reading the label on the nearby shelf.
examples.zh: 同学还没看旁边架子的标签，就凭外形认出了「壶铃」。

words.enDefinition: the kick that starts a period of play or restarts play after a goal

examples.en: We reached the field a few minutes before kick-off in the first campus final.
examples.zh: 第一场校园决赛「足球开球」前几分钟，我们到了球场。

examples.en: The team met beside the bench just before kick-off to hear the coach's reminder.
examples.zh: 「开球」前，队员们在替补席旁集合，听教练提醒了几句。

words.enDefinition: a soft eraser that can be shaped for precise work

examples.en: The tutor shaped a kneaded eraser before lifting a few dark marks.
examples.zh: 老师先捏了捏「可塑橡皮」，再把几处深色笔迹擦淡。

examples.en: I used a kneaded eraser to lighten one corner of my drawing.
examples.zh: 我用「可塑橡皮」把画的一角擦淡了一点。

words.enDefinition: tools with pointed ends used to form loops in knitting

examples.en: The class had spare knitting needles for students who were just starting.
examples.zh: 课上有备用「棒针」，给刚入门的同学用。

examples.en: I put my knitting needles back in their case before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 离开房间前，我把「棒针」放回了收纳盒。

words.enDefinition: directions showing how to make a knitted object

examples.en: I followed a knitting pattern for a scarf during the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假里，我照着一份「棒针编织图样」织了条围巾。

examples.en: My classmate found an easier knitting pattern for our first session.
examples.zh: 同学为我们的第一次活动找了份更容易的「棒针编织图样」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a tournament when a loss can end a team's participation

examples.en: We reached the knockout stage after a close match against the team from residence.
examples.zh: 和宿舍队打了一场比分很接近的比赛后，我们进入了「淘汰赛阶段」。

examples.en: The club moved its knockout stage games to the main sports hall for spectators.
examples.zh: 俱乐部把「淘汰赛阶段」的比赛移到主体育馆，方便观众观看。

words.enDefinition: A film showing scheduled late in the evening or around midnight.

examples.en: The late-night screening ended after the last bus, so we walked back to campus.
examples.zh: 「深夜放映」结束时，末班公交已经走了，我们就步行回学校。

examples.en: I missed the late-night screening because I had a shift at the library early next morning.
examples.zh: 我第二天一早要去图书馆上班，没能去看「深夜放映」。

words.enDefinition: a basketball shot taken close to the basket, typically following a step or jump

examples.en: Our team took the lead after a layup by the newest player that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，最新加入的队员一个「上篮」帮助我们取得领先。

examples.en: The defender moved aside just before she went up for the layup near the basket.
examples.zh: 她在篮筐附近起跳「上篮」之前，防守球员刚好让开。

words.enDefinition: to play the first card in a trick

examples.en: I waited for my roommate to lead a card before choosing mine.
examples.zh: 我等室友「领出一墩牌的首张」，再从手里选一张跟出。

examples.en: The rules showed which player could lead a card after the break.
examples.zh: 规则说明了休息后哪位玩家可以「领出一墩牌的首张」。

collocations: ask who will lead a card
be the next to lead a card
lead a card of any suit

words.enDefinition: a guitarist who plays the main melodic lines or solos in a group

examples.en: The lead guitarist played a short solo while the singer stepped off the stage.
examples.zh: 歌手走下舞台时，「主音吉他手」弹了一小段独奏。

examples.en: My sister became the lead guitarist in a band she met at university.
examples.zh: 姐姐成了她在大学认识的一支乐队的「主音吉他手」。

words.enDefinition: A central acting part in a film, show, or play.

examples.en: I recognized the actor in the lead role from a short film our class watched.
examples.zh: 我认出这位扮演「主要角色」的演员在我们班看过的短片里演过。

examples.en: She got her first lead role in a low-budget feature made near her university.
examples.zh: 她第一次担任「主要角色」，是在学校附近拍的一部长篇低成本电影里。

collocations: cast someone in the lead role

words.enDefinition: the singer who performs the main vocal part in a group

examples.en: The lead singer asked everyone to join in when the last chorus came around.
examples.zh: 最后一遍副歌唱到时，「主唱」请所有人一起唱。

examples.en: I knew the new lead singer from our campus music society last year.
examples.zh: 我去年在校园音乐社认识了这位新「主唱」。

words.enDefinition: the first song released to promote an upcoming album or other collection

examples.en: The duo performed its lead single before talking about the rest of the album.
examples.zh: 两人组合先演了「专辑主打先行单曲」，然后才聊到专辑的其他歌。

examples.en: I recognised the lead single after hearing it on our university radio station.
examples.zh: 在我们学校的电台里听过之后，我认出了「专辑主打先行单曲」。

words.enDefinition: a match between teams that counts toward their position in a league

examples.en: I missed my first league match because my seminar ran late that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午研讨课拖堂，我错过了自己的第一场「联赛比赛」。

examples.en: Our next league match was against a team made up of engineering students.
examples.zh: 下一场「联赛比赛」的对手是一支由工科学生组成的队伍。

words.enDefinition: points awarded for results that count toward a team's position in a league

examples.en: The draw earned enough league points to keep our team above the bottom spot.
examples.zh: 这场平局拿到的「联赛积分」够我们球队摆脱垫底。

examples.en: I checked the league points after both campus divisions played that weekend.
examples.zh: 两个校区组别那个周末都比完后，我查了「联赛积分」。

words.enDefinition: a table showing teams ranked by their results in a league

examples.en: The league table changed after our division played its postponed matches on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们组周五补打改期的比赛后，「联赛排名表」变了。

examples.en: I checked the league table before asking who our next opponents would be.
examples.zh: 问下一个对手是谁之前，我查了「联赛排名表」。

words.enDefinition: an event where someone shows newcomers how a game works

examples.en: The club ran a learn-to-play session before its regular games began.
examples.zh: 社团的常规游戏开始前，先办了一场「游戏入门教学活动」。

examples.en: I joined the learn-to-play session because I hadn't seen the components before.
examples.zh: 我以前没见过那些配件，所以参加了「游戏入门教学活动」。

words.enDefinition: to avoid interfering with wild animals as they feed, move or rest

examples.en: Our guide asked the group to leave wildlife undisturbed during the visit.
examples.zh: 向导请大家参观时「不要打扰野生动物」。

examples.en: The students wanted to leave wildlife undisturbed while drawing from the path.
examples.zh: 同学们想站在小路上写生，「不打扰野生动物」。

collocations: observe quietly to leave wildlife undisturbed
ask visitors to leave wildlife undisturbed

words.enDefinition: A label warning that a title will soon stop being available on the service.

examples.en: The film had a “Leaving soon” label, so we watched it that evening after class.
examples.zh: 这部片标着「即将下架」，我们当晚下课后就把它看了。

examples.en: I looked in the leaving soon section to see whether the documentary was still available.
examples.zh: 我去「即将下架」栏目查了查那部纪录片还能不能看。

words.enDefinition: an action permitted by the rules of a game

examples.en: I asked whether placing the tile sideways would be a legal move.
examples.zh: 我问把方块横着放算不算「规则允许的走法」。

examples.en: The rulebook gave an example of a legal move using two pieces.
examples.zh: 规则手册用两枚棋子举了个「规则允许的走法」的例子。

collocations: check whether it's a legal move

words.enDefinition: Presenting a wide picture on a narrower screen with bars above and below the image.

examples.en: The film used letterboxing to keep its wide picture visible on our older television.
examples.zh: 这部片用「宽画面上下留黑边」的方式，让老电视也能显示整个宽画面。

examples.en: Our tutor explained letterboxing when we noticed black bars above and below the film.
examples.zh: 我们发现电影画面上下的黑边时，导师讲了「宽画面上下留黑边」这种做法。

words.enDefinition: to score so that both sides have the same number of points or goals

examples.en: We had a chance to level the score before the last minute of play.
examples.zh: 比赛还剩最后一分钟前，我们有机会「扳平比分」。

examples.en: The other team managed to level the score soon after the break that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午休息过后不久，对方成功「扳平比分」。

words.enDefinition: a defensive specialist who replaces back-row players in volleyball

examples.en: I recognised the libero by the different colour of her shirt during the game.
examples.zh: 比赛中，我凭她不同颜色的球衣认出了「排球自由人」。

examples.en: Our libero helped keep the rally going after the ball came over unexpectedly.
examples.zh: 球出乎意料地飞过来后，我们的「排球自由人」帮球队把回合继续了下去。

words.enDefinition: the written text of an opera, including sung and spoken words

examples.en: I read the libretto before the opera so I knew the story.
examples.zh: 看歌剧前，我读了「歌剧唱词剧本」，好先了解剧情。

examples.en: The tutor gave us a translation of the libretto in class.
examples.zh: 老师在课上发给我们一份「歌剧唱词剧本」译本。

words.enDefinition: a control desk used to operate the lights for a production

examples.en: Our technician sat at the lighting board and waited for the signal.
examples.zh: 我们的技术人员坐在「灯光控制台」前，等待信号。

examples.en: I watched the rehearsal from a chair beside the lighting board.
examples.zh: 我坐在「灯光控制台」旁边的椅子上观看排练。

words.enDefinition: a signal for a planned change in stage lighting

examples.en: A lighting cue brought the lights down as the last actor left.
examples.zh: 最后一名演员退场时，灯光按照「灯光提示」暗了下来。

examples.en: We repeated the ending to practise the final lighting cue once more.
examples.zh: 我们重排了结尾，再练一次最后的「灯光提示」。

words.enDefinition: indicates that only a small number of tickets remain available

examples.en: The page said "Limited availability", so we looked at a different date.
examples.zh: 页面上说「余票有限」，我们就去看了另一个日期。

examples.en: An email marked the afternoon match as having limited availability this week.
examples.zh: 邮件注明，本周下午那场比赛「余票有限」。

words.enDefinition: A release in which a film is shown in a restricted number of theaters or locations.

examples.en: The film opened in limited release, and only one theater near campus was showing it.
examples.zh: 这部片「小范围上映」，校园附近只有一家影院在放。

examples.en: My roommate checked the limited release dates after hearing about the documentary in a podcast.
examples.zh: 室友在播客听说这部纪录片后，查了它「小范围上映」的日期。
