words.enDefinition: A series planned as a finite set of episodes that tells a complete story.

examples.en: We picked a limited series because the main story would be finished after six episodes.
examples.zh: 我们选了部「限定剧」，因为主线情节六集就会讲完。

examples.en: The review said the limited series gave the characters more time than a film would.
examples.zh: 影评说，这部「限定剧」比电影有更多篇幅来塑造人物。

collocations: a limited series based on a novel

words.enDefinition: an image made mainly with lines instead of filled areas

examples.en: I made a line drawing of the bicycle outside my building.
examples.zh: 我给楼外的自行车画了张「线条画」。

examples.en: The line drawing looked much clearer after I erased the pencil guidelines.
examples.zh: 擦掉铅笔辅助线后，那幅「线条画」看起来清楚多了。

words.enDefinition: an official responsible for certain calls about lines on a sports court or field

examples.en: The line judge indicated that the serve had landed just outside the court.
examples.zh: 「司线员」示意发球落在场地边线外一点。

examples.en: Our club asked me to be a line judge for the first doubles match.
examples.zh: 我们社团请我担任第一场双打比赛的「司线员」。

words.enDefinition: the imaginary line through the ball's starting position before a play from scrimmage

examples.en: The players gathered near the line of scrimmage just before the next play began.
examples.zh: 下一档开始前，队员们在「美式橄榄球开球线」附近集合。

examples.en: I could see the line of scrimmage from my seat near the campus band's section.
examples.zh: 我坐在校园乐队分区旁，能看到「美式橄榄球开球线」。

collocations: line up at the line of scrimmage

words.enDefinition: the way an actor says a particular line of a script

examples.en: The director liked my second line reading because it sounded less formal.
examples.zh: 导演更喜欢我第二次的「台词说法」，因为听起来没那么正式。

examples.en: We tried a slower line reading for that short question in the play.
examples.zh: 剧中那个简短问题，我们试了试更慢的「台词说法」。

words.enDefinition: written information included with a record or album about the works and contributors

examples.en: I read the liner notes to find out who had played the piano.
examples.zh: 我读了「唱片内页说明」，想知道钢琴是谁弹的。

examples.en: The liner notes included a short story about how the band found its drummer.
examples.zh: 「唱片内页说明」里有个小故事，讲乐队是怎么找到鼓手的。

words.enDefinition: a public statement identifying who will take part in the game

examples.en: We were still buying water when the lineup announcement began inside.
examples.zh: 我们还在买水，里面就开始了「参赛阵容播报」。

examples.en: The crowd listened closely to the lineup announcement just before the match.
examples.zh: 比赛快开始时，观众认真听着「参赛阵容播报」。

words.enDefinition: a gathering in person or online to hear a recording together

examples.en: We had a listening party for our friend's new album in the common room.
examples.zh: 我们在公共休息室为朋友的新专辑办了一场「集体听歌会」。

examples.en: The record store held a listening party before the new album went on sale.
examples.zh: 新专辑开卖前，唱片店举行了「集体听歌会」。

words.enDefinition: an organised activity where people collect rubbish left outdoors

examples.en: Our residence joined a litter pick in the park on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六，我们宿舍参加了公园里的「捡垃圾志愿活动」。

examples.en: The litter pick finished before we met the others for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们和其他人会合吃午饭之前，「捡垃圾志愿活动」就结束了。

words.enDefinition: music performed in person alongside a singer, dancer, or actor

examples.en: The dancers worked with live accompaniment at their last two rehearsals.
examples.zh: 舞者最后两次排练有「现场伴奏」配合。

examples.en: The song felt different with live accompaniment from two student musicians.
examples.zh: 有两位学生乐手「现场伴奏」，这首歌听起来不太一样。

words.enDefinition: Made primarily by filming real performers and settings instead of animating the action.

examples.en: I liked how the live-action film made the setting feel like a real neighborhood.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这部「真人实拍的」电影把故事发生地拍得像真实的街区。

examples.en: The poster showed which characters would appear in the live-action adaptation of the book.
examples.zh: 海报展示了这本书改编成「真人实拍」电影后会出现哪些角色。

words.enDefinition: an album containing recordings made during one or more live performances

examples.en: I liked the live album because you could hear the crowd between songs.
examples.zh: 我喜欢那张「现场录音专辑」，两首歌之间能听到观众的声音。

examples.en: The new live album includes recordings from a concert we watched together last summer.
examples.zh: 新的「现场录音专辑」收录了我们去年夏天一起看的那场音乐会的录音。

words.enDefinition: A program transmitted for audiences to watch or listen to as the event happens.

examples.en: We watched a live broadcast of the film awards in the lounge after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我们在休息室看了电影颁奖典礼的「现场直播」。

examples.en: My flatmate stayed up for the live broadcast because she wanted to hear the interviews.
examples.zh: 室友想听访谈，所以熬夜等着看「现场直播」。

collocations: a live broadcast of the ceremony

words.enDefinition: music performed in front of listeners as they hear it

examples.en: The café had live music on Fridays, so we stayed after our usual coffee.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡馆周五有「现场音乐」，所以照常喝完咖啡后，我们又待了一会儿。

examples.en: I could hear live music from the square while walking back to my residence.
examples.zh: 我走回宿舍时，能听见广场传来「现场音乐」。

words.enDefinition: a menu option for opening an existing saved game

examples.en: I selected “Load game” and found the puzzle we started last weekend.
examples.zh: 我选择「读取存档」，找到了上周末开始解的谜题。

examples.en: My roommate pressed “Load game” to continue from our previous session.
examples.zh: 室友点了「读取存档」，接着上一次的进度玩。

words.enDefinition: a code used to enter a particular game waiting room

examples.en: My roommate read out the lobby code before the next round started.
examples.zh: 下一轮开始前，室友念出了「房间邀请码」。

examples.en: I checked the lobby code after accidentally choosing the wrong room.
examples.zh: 不小心选错房间后，我核对了「房间邀请码」。

words.enDefinition: a game mode for people playing together on one device or a local network

examples.en: We chose local multiplayer because everyone could sit around the same television.
examples.zh: 大家都能围坐在同一台电视前，我们就选了「本地多人模式」。

examples.en: My friend checked whether local multiplayer supported three people on one device.
examples.zh: 朋友查了「本地多人模式」能不能让三个人共用一台设备。

words.enDefinition: a long sequence of hits between opposing players before the point ends

examples.en: The two pairs played a long rally before the ball finally went past the line.
examples.zh: 球终于出界前，两对选手打了一个「长回合对打」。

examples.en: I lost track of the score during a long rally in our afternoon game.
examples.zh: 下午那场比赛的一次「长回合对打」里，我忘了比分。

words.enDefinition: a recreational path that brings walkers back to where they began

examples.en: We chose the loop trail because it ended at the same gate.
examples.zh: 我们选了「环形步道」，因为终点是同一个门。

examples.en: The loop trail took us past a row of flowering trees.
examples.zh: 沿着「环形步道」走，我们经过了一排开花的树。

words.enDefinition: A day when a person feels less energetic than usual.

examples.en: I marked a low-energy day in my notes after spending the afternoon on coursework.
examples.zh: 下午一直在做课业后，我在笔记里记了「没什么精神的一天」。

examples.en: My roommate said it was a low-energy day when I asked about her gym session.
examples.zh: 我问室友那次锻炼怎么样，她说那是「没什么精神的一天」。

collocations: a workout on a low-energy day

words.enDefinition: Exercise that usually involves less forceful contact with the floor or another supporting surface.

examples.en: The timetable described water aerobics as low-impact exercise in the note beneath the class name.
examples.zh: 时间表在课名下面的备注中把水中有氧操列为「低冲击运动」。

examples.en: My roommate asked what low-impact exercise meant in the description of the afternoon class.
examples.zh: 室友问下午课的介绍里，「低冲击运动」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the lower group of seating tiers around an arena or stadium

examples.en: Our tickets were for the lower bowl near the team benches.
examples.zh: 我们的票在「下层环形看台」，靠近球队替补席。

examples.en: The students filled the lower bowl before the afternoon event began.
examples.zh: 下午的赛事开始前，学生们坐满了「下层环形看台」。

words.enDefinition: a long-playing vinyl record, usually containing a full-length album

examples.en: The record shop played an LP from its used section on a small turntable.
examples.zh: 唱片店用一台小唱机播放二手区的一张「密纹唱片」。

examples.en: I found the LP in a plain sleeve next to two older jazz recordings.
examples.zh: 我在两张较老的爵士录音旁找到了那张装在素色封套里的「密纹唱片」。

words.enDefinition: a music video that displays the words of the song as it plays

examples.en: I watched the lyric video to check one line I had always misheard.
examples.zh: 我看了「歌词视频」，确认一句自己一直听错的歌词。

examples.en: The band released a simple lyric video featuring drawings made by local students.
examples.zh: 乐队发布了一个简单的「歌词视频」，配上当地学生画的图。

words.enDefinition: someone whose role is to write the words for songs

examples.en: The lyricist changed the last line after hearing the singers rehearse together that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午听歌手们合排后，「歌词作者」改了最后一句词。

examples.en: Our programme introduced the lyricist separately from the composer of the music that evening.
examples.zh: 当晚节目单把「歌词作者」与作曲者分别介绍。

words.enDefinition: the main public walkway linking areas inside a large venue

examples.en: I met my roommate on the main concourse near the stairs.
examples.zh: 我在楼梯附近的「场馆主通道」上见到了室友。

examples.en: The main concourse linked our seating area to the opposite entrance.
examples.zh: 「场馆主通道」把我们的座位区和对面的入口连了起来。

words.enDefinition: the starting selection screen with the game's main options

examples.en: I went back to the main menu to choose a different puzzle.
examples.zh: 我回到「主菜单」，换了一道谜题。

examples.en: The main menu offered a short practice session and an online option.
examples.zh: 「主菜单」上既有短时间的练习模式，也有联网选项。

collocations: an option on the main menu

words.enDefinition: an encouragement for the audience to cheer loudly

examples.en: The announcer shouted "Make some noise!" and the student section immediately joined in.
examples.zh: 广播员喊了声「大家欢呼起来」，学生看台立刻响应。

examples.en: A banner said "Make some noise" as the visiting performers reached the field.
examples.zh: 客场表演队走上赛场时，一幅横幅写着「大家欢呼起来」。

collocations: ask fans to make some noise
make some noise for the team

words.enDefinition: to practise dance movements lightly without performing them at full intensity

examples.en: We decided to mark the choreography while waiting for the pianist to arrive.
examples.zh: 我们决定边等钢琴手过来，边「简化走一遍舞蹈动作」。

examples.en: The instructor asked us to mark the choreography so she could check our timing.
examples.zh: 老师请我们「简化走一遍舞蹈动作」，她好检查节奏是否对得上。

collocations: ask dancers to mark the choreography

words.enDefinition: a track made by combining recognisable parts of two or more recordings

examples.en: Our music tutor played a mashup that used vocals and drums from different songs.
examples.zh: 音乐导师播放了一首「混搭歌曲」，其中人声和鼓来自不同的歌。

examples.en: I recognised the older tune immediately when it appeared in the student DJ's mashup.
examples.zh: 学生 DJ 的「混搭歌曲」一放出那段老旋律，我立刻就认出来了。

words.enDefinition: a status showing play was stopped and the match did not finish

examples.en: The board displayed match abandoned after the floodlights went out during the second half.
examples.zh: 下半场泛光灯熄灭后，显示屏上出现了「比赛中途终止」。

examples.en: The website posted match abandoned without yet saying whether the score would count.
examples.zh: 网站发布了「比赛中途终止」，还没说原比分算不算。

words.enDefinition: a message saying an online game has been found for the player

examples.en: I heard a sound when “Match found” appeared on the laptop.
examples.zh: 笔记本屏幕上出现「已匹配到对局」时，我听到了提示音。

examples.en: The “Match found” message appeared just as I put down my cup.
examples.zh: 我刚放下杯子，屏幕就弹出「已匹配到对局」。

words.enDefinition: a point on which the player or team ahead can win the whole match

examples.en: The scores were close until our team finally reached match point in the third set.
examples.zh: 比分一直很接近，直到我们队在第三盘拿到「赛点」。

examples.en: I missed the match point because a friend walked in front of my seat.
examples.zh: 朋友从我座位前经过，我错过了「赛点」。

words.enDefinition: a booklet with information about a particular match and its participants

examples.en: The matchday programme listed all the players and described the half-time entertainment.
examples.zh: 「比赛日导览册」列出了所有球员，还介绍了中场的娱乐节目。

examples.en: I kept the matchday programme from my first match at that stadium.
examples.zh: 我留着第一次去那个体育场看比赛时的「比赛日导览册」。

words.enDefinition: automatic grouping of players for an online game

examples.en: The game used matchmaking to find a few more people for our group.
examples.zh: 游戏通过「对局匹配」给我们这组找了几个玩家。

examples.en: We turned off matchmaking and invited only people from our residence.
examples.zh: 我们关了「对局匹配」，只邀请宿舍楼里认识的人。

words.enDefinition: A showing or performance held during the day, usually in the afternoon.

examples.en: We decided on a matinee so our flatmate could come before her evening shift.
examples.zh: 我们选了「日场放映」，这样室友上晚班前能来看。

examples.en: The theater added a matinee when a group of students asked for an earlier screening.
examples.zh: 一群学生问能不能早点放，影院就加了一场「日场放映」。

words.enDefinition: A notice saying that the facility supplies mats for the session.

examples.en: The class description said “Mats provided” below the location and name of the instructor.
examples.zh: 课程介绍在地点和教练姓名下方写着「提供运动垫」。

examples.en: I saw “Mats provided” on the sign before we went into the group studio.
examples.zh: 走进团课教室之前，我看到告示写着「提供运动垫」。

collocations: look for mats provided on the timetable

words.enDefinition: A weighted ball designed for exercise.

examples.en: The medicine ball had a weight label that was large enough to read from the doorway.
examples.zh: 「健身实心球」的重量标签够大，从门口就能看清。

examples.en: A classmate asked why the medicine ball was displayed separately from the larger inflatable balls.
examples.zh: 一位同学问，为什么「健身实心球」要和那些较大的充气球分开展示。

collocations: a medicine ball with a weight label

words.enDefinition: a musical performance connecting parts of several songs in one continuous sequence

examples.en: The choir ended the show with a medley of songs from old musicals.
examples.zh: 合唱团用几部老音乐剧里的歌曲组成「串烧曲目」，结束了演出。

examples.en: We rehearsed the medley slowly to make each change between songs feel natural.
examples.zh: 我们慢慢排练「串烧曲目」，让每次换歌都显得自然。

words.enDefinition: a memorable piece of melody that catches the listener's attention

examples.en: I could hum the melodic hook by the time the second chorus came around.
examples.zh: 唱到第二遍副歌时，我已经能哼出那段「抓耳旋律片段」了。

examples.en: We changed the backing arrangement but kept the melodic hook from the first draft.
examples.zh: 我们调整了伴奏编排，保留了第一稿的「抓耳旋律片段」。

words.enDefinition: a nonfiction account focusing on parts of the writer's life

examples.en: I picked a memoir about moving often for our book club.
examples.zh: 我给读书会选了一本讲频繁搬家的「回忆录」。

examples.en: Her memoir described the cafés where she used to read between jobs.
examples.zh: 她的「回忆录」写了她工作间隙读书时常去的咖啡馆。

words.enDefinition: a volleyball player whose front-row role includes blocking and attacking near the centre

examples.en: Our middle blocker waited near the centre of the net during the long rally.
examples.zh: 长回合对打时，我们的「排球副攻手」等在球网中央附近。

examples.en: The team introduced its youngest middle blocker before the first match that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午首场比赛前，球队介绍了最年轻的「排球副攻手」。

words.enDefinition: to fail to respond at the right moment to a signal

examples.en: It's easy to miss a cue when several people are talking at once.
examples.zh: 好几个人同时说话时，很容易「错过表演提示」。

examples.en: I didn't want to miss a cue in our first scene together.
examples.zh: 第一次合作演这场戏，我可不想「错过表演提示」。

collocations: try not to miss a cue

words.enDefinition: to lose the chance to act once because of a game rule

examples.en: The blue card said you would miss a turn if you drew it.
examples.zh: 蓝牌上写着，抽到后就会「按规则跳过一回合」。

examples.en: I asked whether a player would miss a turn after landing there.
examples.zh: 我问玩家落到那里之后会不会「按规则跳过一回合」。

collocations: make a player miss a turn
miss a turn in the next round

words.enDefinition: to combine pigments to produce a particular shade

examples.en: I tried to mix a colour that matched the wall behind us.
examples.zh: 我试着「调出一种颜色」，和我们身后的墙面一样。

examples.en: The tutor showed me how to mix a colour for the leaves.
examples.zh: 老师给我演示了怎样为叶片「调出一种颜色」。

collocations: mix a colour on the palette

words.enDefinition: a doubles event in which each pair typically consists of one woman and one man

examples.en: The club added a mixed doubles event to the weekend tennis schedule last month.
examples.zh: 上个月，社团在周末网球赛程里加了一项「混合双打」。

examples.en: I entered mixed doubles with a classmate who had never played in the tournament.
examples.zh: 我和一位没参加过该锦标赛的同学一起报名了「混合双打」。

words.enDefinition: a control console used to combine and adjust separate audio signals

examples.en: The engineer stayed at the mixing desk throughout the student performers' first rehearsal together.
examples.zh: 学生表演者第一次合排时，音响师一直守在「调音台」旁。

examples.en: I watched a volunteer lower the singer's volume at the mixing desk before the show.
examples.zh: 演出前，我看到一个志愿者在「调音台」上调低了歌手的音量。

words.enDefinition: A fitness class focused on comfortable, controlled movement through a range of positions.

examples.en: The recreation center listed a mobility class under the activities offered on Tuesday afternoons.
examples.zh: 校园文体中心在星期二下午的活动中列出了「关节活动度训练课」。

examples.en: I asked about the mobility class because I had never seen it on the schedule before.
examples.zh: 我之前没在时间表上见过「关节活动度训练课」，就去问了一下。

words.enDefinition: A fictional film or show made to look like a documentary, often for comedy.

examples.en: The mockumentary followed a fictional library team trying to run its first book fair.
examples.zh: 这部「伪纪录片」跟拍了一个虚构的图书馆团队，讲他们如何办第一次书展。

examples.en: I realized it was a mockumentary when the supposed experts started contradicting each other.
examples.zh: 所谓的专家们开始互相拆台，我才意识到这是部「伪纪录片」。

words.enDefinition: A level of physical effort that feels between light and hard.

examples.en: I wrote moderate effort in my log beside the time we spent walking indoors.
examples.zh: 我在日志里的室内步行用时旁写了「中等用力感」。

examples.en: My roommate said moderate effort was the best description of how the class felt to her.
examples.zh: 室友说，用「中等用力感」来描述那门课的感受最合适。

collocations: describe the session as moderate effort
rate an activity as moderate effort
note moderate effort in a log

words.enDefinition: A short promotional video giving audiences a preview of an upcoming film.

examples.en: The movie trailer made the film look much faster than it actually was.
examples.zh: 「电影预告片」把这部片剪得看起来比实际节奏快得多。

examples.en: My roommate sent me a movie trailer because the cinematography reminded her of our city.
examples.zh: 室友给我发了一部「电影预告片」，因为里面的镜头让她想起我们的城市。

collocations: a movie trailer for the new film

words.enDefinition: The time someone spends moving during an activity, excluding times when they are stopped.

examples.en: My moving time was lower than the total because we stopped to chat twice.
examples.zh: 因为我们停下来聊了两次天，我的「实际移动用时」比总用时短。

examples.en: The app listed moving time and the total time on separate lines for our walk.
examples.zh: 应用在这次步行记录里把「实际移动用时」和总用时分两行列出。

collocations: moving time in the activity summary

words.enDefinition: the person in charge of the music in a production

examples.en: The music director listened to the singers before setting the rehearsal schedule.
examples.zh: 「音乐总监」先听过歌手的演唱，再定排练日程。

examples.en: Our music director helped the cast match its singing to the piano.
examples.zh: 我们的「音乐总监」帮演员们把歌声和钢琴配合起来。

words.zhGloss: 采入新作品的一段录音
words.enDefinition: a short section of an existing recording used within a new piece of music
acceptedZhAnswers: 采入新作品的一段录音

examples.en: The producer used a music sample from a drum recording made by her classmate.
examples.zh: 制作人使用了一段同学录制的鼓乐作为「采入新作品的录音」。

examples.en: I recognised the music sample from a record we had listened to in class.
examples.zh: 我认出了这段「采入新作品的录音」，它来自我们在课上听过的唱片。

words.enDefinition: a place where musicians perform in front of an audience

examples.en: I had never been to the music venue hidden behind the campus bookshop.
examples.zh: 我以前没去过藏在校园书店后面的那个「音乐演出场地」。

examples.en: A friend showed me the nearest music venue while we were exploring downtown.
examples.zh: 我们逛市中心时，朋友给我指了最近的「音乐演出场地」。

words.enDefinition: a complete song or dance section within a stage musical

examples.en: Our favourite musical number used chairs to create different shapes onstage.
examples.zh: 我们最喜欢的「音乐剧歌舞段落」用椅子在舞台上摆出了不同的形状。

examples.en: The class rehearsed one musical number before working on the dialogue again.
examples.zh: 全班排练完一个「音乐剧歌舞段落」，再接着磨台词。

words.enDefinition: a form of stage performance that combines acting, songs, and movement

examples.en: I joined a musical theatre workshop to practise singing while moving onstage.
examples.zh: 我参加了一个「音乐剧表演」工作坊，练习在台上边走动边唱歌。

examples.en: The university's musical theatre society held an informal performance in the library courtyard.
examples.zh: 学校的「音乐剧表演」社在图书馆的庭院办了一场非正式演出。

words.enDefinition: A series centered on discovering the answer to a puzzling event or question.

examples.en: We started a mystery series about a box of letters found under a floorboard.
examples.zh: 我们开始看一部「悬疑推理剧集」，故事从地板下发现一盒信件讲起。

examples.en: The mystery series made our flatmates argue about which small details would matter later.
examples.zh: 这部「悬疑推理剧集」让我们室友争论哪些小细节之后会派上用场。

words.enDefinition: a notebook for recording what someone notices outdoors

examples.en: I added a quick bird sketch to my nature journal after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我在「自然观察手账」上添了张鸟的速写。

examples.en: My friend used a nature journal to compare the trees across seasons.
examples.zh: 朋友用「自然观察手账」对比不同季节里这些树的变化。

words.enDefinition: an area managed to protect wildlife and its surroundings

examples.en: I took my camera to the nature reserve with two classmates.
examples.zh: 我带着相机和两个同学去了「自然保护区」。

examples.en: The nature reserve was quieter than we expected on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日早上的「自然保护区」比我们想象的安静。

words.enDefinition: a marked path for enjoying or learning about natural surroundings

examples.en: The nature trail passed a small pond behind the university garden.
examples.zh: 「自然观察步道」经过大学花园后面的一个小池塘。

examples.en: My classmate took a sketchbook when we visited the nature trail.
examples.zh: 我们去「自然观察步道」时，同学带了本速写本。

words.enDefinition: a walk taken to enjoy or observe the natural surroundings

examples.en: We went on a nature walk after finishing our afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 下午的研讨课结束后，我们去「散步观察自然」。

examples.en: The nature walk gave us time to notice the smallest plants.
examples.zh: 这次「自然观察漫步」让我们有空留意那些很小的植物。

words.enDefinition: the space around and between the main objects in an image

examples.en: The tutor asked us to notice the negative space between the branches.
examples.zh: 老师请我们留意树枝之间的「留白」。

examples.en: I drew the negative space first to work out the vase's outline.
examples.zh: 我先把「主体周围的留白」画出来，再找出花瓶的轮廓。

collocations: the negative space around a subject

words.zhGloss: 不偏向任何一队的观众
words.enDefinition: someone watching a game without supporting either particular team
acceptedZhAnswers: 不偏向任何一队的观众

examples.en: I went as a neutral spectator because neither team was from my school.
examples.zh: 两队都不是我们学校的，所以我作为「不偏向任何一队的观众」去看了比赛。

examples.en: As a neutral spectator, I enjoyed listening to fans from both sides.
examples.zh: 作为「不偏向任何一队的观众」，我喜欢听两边球迷助威。

collocations: enjoy a match as a neutral spectator

words.enDefinition: a notice asking people not to take photos during a show

examples.en: The programme said "No photography during the performance," so I kept my phone in my bag.
examples.zh: 节目册写着「演出进行时请勿拍照」，所以我没把手机从包里拿出来。

examples.en: An announcement repeated "No photography during the performance," just before the house lights went down.
examples.zh: 观众席照明暗下来前，广播又提醒了一遍「演出进行时请勿拍照」。

collocations: notice saying no photography during the performance
sign reading no photography during the performance
reminder of no photography during the performance

words.enDefinition: a notice saying people cannot enter again after leaving

examples.en: The sign said "No re-entry," so we stayed inside during the break.
examples.zh: 标牌写着「离场后不得再入场」，所以休息时我们留在里面。

examples.en: The printed ticket showed "No re-entry" just below the event name.
examples.zh: 纸质门票在活动名称下面写着「离场后不得再入场」。

collocations: venue with a no re-entry rule

words.enDefinition: A request to avoid revealing important events, often because someone has not watched yet.

examples.en: “No spoilers,” I said when my roommates started talking about the episode over breakfast.
examples.zh: 室友们吃早餐时聊起那一集，我就说「别剧透」。

examples.en: I wrote “No spoilers” in the chat because half the group had missed the screening.
examples.zh: 有一半组员没赶上放映，我就在群里写了「别剧透」。

collocations: say no spoilers before a discussion

words.enDefinition: Shoes with soles designed to avoid leaving marks on a floor.

examples.en: The notice for the new studio asked for non-marking shoes on the wooden floor.
examples.zh: 新教室的告示要求，在木地板上穿「不留鞋痕的鞋」。

examples.en: I asked the attendant what counted as non-marking shoes before joining the dance class.
examples.zh: 去上舞蹈课之前，我问值班员什么样的鞋算「不留鞋痕的鞋」。

words.enDefinition: a ticket that may only be used by the original holder

examples.en: My student pass showed that it was a non-transferable ticket for that match.
examples.zh: 我的学生通票显示，这一场对应的是「不可转交门票」。

examples.en: The portal marked one option as a non-transferable ticket before checkout.
examples.zh: 结账前，网站把一个选项注明为「不可转交门票」。

collocations: check whether it is a non-transferable ticket

words.enDefinition: A story told outside the chronological order in which the events happen.

examples.en: The nonlinear narrative moved between three points in the same family's history without warning.
examples.zh: 这部片用「非线性叙事」，在同一个家庭的三个历史阶段之间切换，没有事先提示。

examples.en: I enjoyed the nonlinear narrative more once I stopped trying to arrange every scene by date.
examples.zh: 我不再试着按日期排每场戏之后，反而更喜欢这种「非线性叙事」了。

collocations: make sense of a nonlinear narrative
a film with a nonlinear narrative

words.enDefinition: informal term for seats very high and far from the action

examples.en: We bought nosebleed seats because we were on a student budget.
examples.zh: 学生手头紧，我们就买了「高处远座」。

examples.en: Even from the nosebleed seats, the court was easy to see.
examples.zh: 就算坐在「高处远座」，也能看清球场。

words.enDefinition: a seat from which some of the show is blocked

examples.en: I decided against an obstructed-view seat because of a pillar nearby.
examples.zh: 附近有根柱子，我最后没买「视线受阻座位」。

examples.en: The ticket office marked one corner seat as an obstructed-view seat.
examples.zh: 售票处把角落的一个座位标成「视线受阻座位」。

words.enDefinition: able to perform from memory without reading the script

examples.en: I was finally off book by the time we moved into the theatre.
examples.zh: 我们搬进剧场排练时，我终于能「脱稿」了。

examples.en: The actors were off book, but there were still a few missed lines.
examples.zh: 演员已经能「脱稿」了，不过还有几处漏词。

words.enDefinition: not matching the right pitch or key when singing or playing

examples.en: I was slightly off-key until the guitarist played the right starting note again.
examples.zh: 吉他手再次弹出正确的起音前，我唱得有点「音高不准」。

examples.en: The tutor stopped us when the last note sounded off-key during rehearsal on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二排练时，最后一个音听起来「音高不准」，导师叫停了我们。

words.enDefinition: listening to downloaded recordings when an internet connection is unavailable or unused

examples.en: I downloaded the album for offline listening before getting on the long-distance coach.
examples.zh: 上长途大巴前，我下载了专辑，以便「离线收听」。

examples.en: The settings page showed which playlists were available for offline listening that weekend.
examples.zh: 设置页列出了那个周末可「离线收听」的歌单。

words.enDefinition: a football offence committed when a player is in an offside position as a teammate plays or touches the ball and then becomes involved in active play

examples.en: We cheered too early because the referee called offside before the ball went in.
examples.zh: 我们欢呼太早了，因为球进门前裁判就吹了「越位」。

examples.en: The assistant referee raised a flag for offside while everyone waited near the touchline.
examples.zh: 大家在边线附近等着时，助理裁判举旗示意「越位」。

words.enDefinition: Describes media that people can start watching whenever they choose.

examples.en: We watched the interview on demand because most of us were working when it aired.
examples.zh: 访谈播出时我们大多数人都在上班，后来是「点播」看的。

examples.en: The documentary was available on demand after our class finished its discussion that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午课堂讨论结束后，这部纪录片就可以「点播」了。

words.enDefinition: played very frequently on a station or person's regular listening list

examples.en: The group's first song was on heavy rotation on campus radio all through spring.
examples.zh: 整个春季，这支乐队的第一首歌在校园电台「被高频反复播放」。

examples.en: The album was on heavy rotation in our flat while we prepared for exams.
examples.zh: 准备考试期间，这张专辑在我们的公寓里「被高频反复播放」。

collocations: keep a song on heavy rotation
put a track on heavy rotation

words.expression: on the edge of your seat
words.lemma: on the edge of your seat
words.enDefinition: feeling intensely excited and eager to know what will happen
acceptedEnVariants: on the edge of your seat

examples.en: A close match can keep you on the edge of your seat until the last second.
examples.zh: 比分接近的比赛能让你一直「紧张得坐不住」，直到最后一秒。

examples.en: The last race had you on the edge of your seat even if you supported neither runner.
examples.zh: 最后一场赛跑就算两边你都不支持，也会让你「紧张得坐不住」。

collocations: keep you on the edge of your seat
leave you on the edge of your seat
have you on the edge of your seat

words.enDefinition: travelling to perform in several different places

examples.en: Our classmate was on tour with the local orchestra for most of the summer.
examples.zh: 暑假大部分时间，我们的同学都和本地管弦乐团一起「在巡演中」。

examples.en: The singer wrote two new songs while on tour with her old friends from school.
examples.zh: 歌手和以前上学认识的朋友「在巡演中」写了两首新歌。

words.enDefinition: a play that consists of just one main dramatic section

examples.en: My classmate wrote a one-act play set in the university's laundry room.
examples.zh: 同学写了部「独幕剧」，故事发生在学校的洗衣房。

examples.en: We stayed for a one-act play after the longer production had finished.
examples.zh: 那部长剧结束后，我们留下又看了部「独幕剧」。

words.enDefinition: a joke short enough to be told in a single sentence

examples.en: The comedian opened with a one-liner about the campus coffee queue.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员拿校园咖啡店的队伍讲了个「一句话笑话」开场。

examples.en: I missed the one-liner because the audience was still laughing loudly.
examples.zh: 观众还在大声笑，我没听见那个「一句话笑话」。

words.enDefinition: play through a network with people using separate devices

examples.en: We switched to online multiplayer when two friends went home for the break.
examples.zh: 两个朋友放假回家后，我们换成了「在线多人模式」。

examples.en: The menu lists online multiplayer beside the single-player option on the screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕菜单上，「在线多人模式」列在单人模式旁边。

words.enDefinition: captions for speech and relevant sounds that stay on screen and cannot be switched off

examples.en: The film society arranged a screening with open captions in the arts building that evening.
examples.zh: 电影社那晚在艺术楼安排了一场带「常显无障碍字幕」的放映。

examples.en: The open captions identified the offscreen speaker and described the music before the scene changed.
examples.zh: 场景切换前，「常显无障碍字幕」标明了画外说话者，还描述了音乐。

collocations: show a film with open captions

words.enDefinition: An ending that leaves some outcomes or meanings for viewers to interpret.

examples.en: The open ending made us wonder whether the neighbors would ever see each other again.
examples.zh: 这个「开放式结局」让我们琢磨，那两位邻居日后还会不会再见。

examples.en: I liked the open ending because the film gave us enough clues to make up our minds.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这个「开放式结局」，因为电影给了足够的线索让我们自己判断。

words.enDefinition: Scheduled times when people can use the gym for independent recreation.

examples.en: I checked open gym hours because the room was sometimes reserved for classes and events.
examples.zh: 这个房间有时会被留给课程和活动，所以我查了「健身房自由活动时段」。

examples.en: Our friends met during open gym hours after the last instructed session had finished.
examples.zh: 最后一场教练带领的课程结束后，朋友们在「健身房自由活动时段」碰了面。

collocations: a sign listing open gym hours

words.enDefinition: a performer or group that appears before the main performer

examples.en: We arrived early enough to hear the opening act at the student music night.
examples.zh: 我们很早就到了，赶上听了学生音乐之夜的「开场表演者」。

examples.en: The opening act thanked the sound engineer before starting its last song.
examples.zh: 「开场表演者」唱最后一首歌之前感谢了音响师。

words.enDefinition: the first official evening performance of a stage production

examples.en: My flatmate brought flowers for the cast on opening night last month.
examples.zh: 上个月的「首演之夜」，室友给演出人员带了花。

examples.en: I couldn't sleep the night before opening night because I was nervous.
examples.zh: 「首演之夜」前一晚，我紧张得睡不着。

words.enDefinition: The first scene in a film or an episode.

examples.en: The opening scene showed an empty lecture hall before any of the characters appeared.
examples.zh: 角色出场前，「开场戏」先拍了一间空的阶梯教室。

examples.en: I had to explain the opening scene when my roommate got home from work.
examples.zh: 室友下班回家时，我得跟她讲一下「开场戏」演了什么。

collocations: set the opening scene in a library

words.enDefinition: the first recorded piece in the sequence on an album or other release

examples.en: The opening track began quietly enough that I turned up my headphones that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，「开篇曲目」开头很轻，我就把耳机音量调大了。

examples.en: I remembered the opening track from a playlist my classmates made during our trip.
examples.zh: 我记得「开篇曲目」曾出现在同学们出游时做的歌单里。

words.enDefinition: the first verse of a song

examples.en: She sang the opening verse alone before the other students joined the chorus.
examples.zh: 她先自己唱了「第一段主歌」，其他同学到副歌才加进来。

examples.en: I knew the opening verse even though I couldn't remember the rest of the words.
examples.zh: 虽然记不得其他歌词，我还是会唱「第一段主歌」。

words.enDefinition: an area below or in front of the stage where musicians play

examples.en: We could hear musicians tuning their instruments in the orchestra pit before the show.
examples.zh: 开演前，我们听到乐手在「乐池」里给乐器调音。

examples.en: The orchestra pit was small, so only four musicians played that evening.
examples.zh: 当晚的「乐池」不大，只有四位乐手演奏。

words.enDefinition: the craft of making shapes by folding paper

examples.en: I tried origami during a study break and made a little paper box.
examples.zh: 学习间隙，我试着「折纸」，折了个小纸盒。

examples.en: The library hosted an origami evening where beginners could try simple shapes.
examples.zh: 图书馆晚上办了一次「折纸」活动，新手可以试折简单的形状。

words.enDefinition: The sound track containing the production’s original recorded dialogue and audio.

examples.en: We chose the original audio so we could hear how the actors delivered their lines.
examples.zh: 我们选了「原声音轨」，想听演员原本怎么说台词。

examples.en: The original audio was available in the menu beside two other language tracks for the film.
examples.zh: 菜单里有这部电影的「原声音轨」，旁边还有两条其他语言的音轨。

collocations: play a film with the original audio

words.enDefinition: not appearing sharp because the camera has focused at another distance

examples.en: The flowers were out of focus even though the background looked sharp.
examples.zh: 背景看起来很清楚，但花朵「没对上焦」。

examples.en: I kept one out of focus photo because I liked its colours.
examples.zh: 我留了一张「没对上焦」的照片，因为喜欢它的颜色。

words.enDefinition: An organized exercise class that is held outside.

examples.en: We saw an outdoor fitness class listed beside a map of the campus lawn.
examples.zh: 我们在校园草坪地图旁看到一节「户外健身课」的介绍。

examples.en: The outdoor fitness class met on the covered terrace when the lawn was still wet.
examples.zh: 草坪还没干，「户外健身课」在有顶棚的露台上集合。

collocations: an outdoor fitness class on the lawn

words.enDefinition: A film showing held outside, often with a temporary screen.

examples.en: We brought blankets to the outdoor screening because the grass was still damp after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后草地还是湿的，所以我们带着毯子去看「露天放映」。

examples.en: The outdoor screening moved to the covered terrace when rain began just before sunset.
examples.zh: 日落前开始下雨，「露天放映」就移到了有顶棚的露台。

collocations: an outdoor screening in the courtyard

words.enDefinition: a volleyball attacker who usually hits from the left side of the front row

examples.en: The outside hitter scored the point that ended the longest rally of the set.
examples.zh: 「排球主攻手」拿下了一分，结束了该局最长的对打。

examples.en: A friend from my statistics class played outside hitter for the visiting college team.
examples.zh: 我统计课上的一个朋友担任来访学院队的「排球主攻手」。

words.enDefinition: a goal scored when a player puts the ball into their own team's net

examples.en: The match changed after an own goal put the visiting team ahead just before halftime.
examples.zh: 中场前，一个「乌龙球」让客队领先，比赛局势随之改变。

examples.en: The commentator checked the replay before recording it as an own goal that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，解说员查看回放后，才把它记为「乌龙球」。

collocations: go ahead through an own goal

words.enDefinition: the person who gives spoken updates over the venue's loudspeakers

examples.en: The PA announcer welcomed the visiting team before the players warmed up.
examples.zh: 球员热身前，「现场广播员」向客队表示欢迎。

examples.en: My classmate worked as the PA announcer for a campus volleyball match.
examples.zh: 同学在一场校园排球比赛上担任「现场广播员」。

words.enDefinition: a book engaging enough to make you want to keep reading

examples.en: The book became a page-turner once the two friends found the letter.
examples.zh: 那两个朋友找到信后，这就成了「让人想读下去的书」。

examples.en: I wanted a page-turner for my long train trip home.
examples.zh: 我想找一本「让人想读下去的书」，回家坐长途火车时看。

collocations: turn out to be a page-turner

words.enDefinition: to build a painting by applying successive coats of paint

examples.en: I like to paint in layers when I work on a landscape.
examples.zh: 画风景时，我喜欢「分层上色」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to paint in layers during the afternoon session.
examples.zh: 下午的活动里，老师让我们「分层上色」。

words.enDefinition: a surface for holding and mixing paints while working

examples.en: I put the paint palette beside my cup of water on the table.
examples.zh: 我把「调色盘」放在桌上的水杯旁。

examples.en: The tutor showed us two colour mixes on the paint palette.
examples.zh: 老师在「调色盘」上给我们展示了两种混合出来的颜色。

collocations: mix colour on a paint palette

words.enDefinition: a stand that holds a canvas or sheet while painting

examples.en: I moved the painting easel closer to the window before beginning my sketch.
examples.zh: 开始打草图前，我把「绘画用画架」往窗边挪了挪。

examples.en: We shared a painting easel during the first hour of the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊开始的第一个小时，我们共用一个「绘画用画架」。

words.enDefinition: an image made by attaching pieces of paper to a surface

examples.en: I made a paper collage using old leaflets from our common room.
examples.zh: 我用公共休息室的旧传单做了一幅「纸拼贴画」。

examples.en: The paper collage looked different once I moved the larger shapes around.
examples.zh: 我重新摆了摆较大的图形，「纸拼贴画」的效果就变了。

words.enDefinition: a book with a soft, flexible paper cover

examples.en: I carried a paperback because it fit inside my little bag.
examples.zh: 我带了本「平装书」，因为它放得进我的小包。

examples.en: My roommate lent me a paperback for the afternoon in the park.
examples.zh: 室友借了本「平装书」给我，让我下午在公园看。

words.enDefinition: a game made for a group at a social gathering

examples.en: We picked a short party game for the break between revision sessions.
examples.zh: 复习间隙，我们选了一个玩起来很快的「聚会游戏」。

examples.en: The party game only took a minute to explain to everyone.
examples.zh: 这个「聚会游戏」只花了一分钟就给大家讲明白了。

collocations: a party game for a large group

words.enDefinition: a message asking someone to join a group of players

examples.en: I sent a party invite after my classmate finished her evening seminar.
examples.zh: 同学上完晚上的研讨课后，我发了条「游戏组队邀请」。

examples.en: A party invite appeared while I was practising the first puzzle alone.
examples.zh: 我一个人练第一道谜题时，跳出了一条「游戏组队邀请」。

words.enDefinition: the player who manages an online group and starts group activities

examples.en: The party leader asked whether we were all ready before choosing a mode.
examples.zh: 「游戏队伍队长」先问大家准备好没有，再选模式。

examples.en: My friend became party leader when we switched to her saved game.
examples.zh: 切换到朋友的存档后，由她当「游戏队伍队长」。

collocations: ask the party leader to start

words.enDefinition: a voice channel shared by a group playing together

examples.en: We used party voice chat to compare clues as we played.
examples.zh: 我们一边玩，一边通过「队伍语音聊天」对照线索。

examples.en: The music was louder than my friend's voice in party voice chat.
examples.zh: 音乐比「队伍语音聊天」里朋友的声音还响。

words.enDefinition: a dance for two performers in a ballet

examples.en: The pas de deux was the only piece performed by exactly two dancers.
examples.zh: 「芭蕾双人舞」是唯一只由两位舞者表演的节目。

examples.en: We watched a pas de deux during the second part of the ballet recital.
examples.zh: 芭蕾汇报演出的后半场，我们看了一段「芭蕾双人舞」。

words.enDefinition: a mode where players take turns using the same device

examples.en: We chose pass-and-play because there was only one tablet on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上只有一台平板，我们就用了「轮流共用设备的玩法」。

examples.en: Pass-and-play worked well for our group during the train ride home.
examples.zh: 回家坐火车时，我们几个用「轮流共用设备的玩法」玩得挺顺。

words.enDefinition: to choose not to act on your current turn

examples.en: The rulebook said you could pass your turn without losing any points.
examples.zh: 规则手册说，可以「自己选择跳过回合」，不扣分。

examples.en: My friend asked whether you could pass your turn in the first round.
examples.zh: 朋友问第一轮能不能「自己选择跳过回合」。

collocations: be allowed to pass your turn

words.enDefinition: paper printed with repeating shapes or designs

examples.en: We chose patterned paper for the covers of our little notebooks.
examples.zh: 我们选了「花纹纸」来做小本子的封面。

examples.en: I saved a piece of patterned paper for the next collage.
examples.zh: 我留了一张「花纹纸」给下一幅拼贴画用。

words.enDefinition: a screen of options shown while the game is paused

examples.en: I opened the pause menu when someone knocked at the door.
examples.zh: 有人敲门时，我打开了「暂停菜单」。

examples.en: The pause menu showed us how much of the level was left.
examples.zh: 「暂停菜单」让我们看到这关还剩多少要玩。

words.enDefinition: The times when a gym tends to have the most visitors.

examples.en: The student guide listed peak gym hours based on when the campus center was busiest.
examples.zh: 学生指南根据校园中心最繁忙的时间列出了「健身房高峰时段」。

examples.en: We met for coffee first because we had arrived during peak gym hours that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚到的时候正值「健身房高峰时段」，我们就先碰面喝了杯咖啡。

collocations: a notice about peak gym hours

words.enDefinition: the rectangular area in front of a football goal where certain rules apply

examples.en: The player waited outside the penalty area while the goalkeeper collected the ball.
examples.zh: 守门员拿球时，那名队员在「足球禁区」外等着。

examples.en: I watched the ball roll slowly across the penalty area without anyone touching it.
examples.zh: 我看见球慢慢滚过「足球禁区」，没有人碰到。

words.enDefinition: a kick from the penalty mark awarded for certain football offences

examples.en: I watched the penalty kick from behind the bench at the other end.
examples.zh: 我在另一端的替补席后面看了那个「点球」。

examples.en: Our captain scored a penalty kick to put the team ahead before the break.
examples.zh: 中场前，队长罚进「点球」，让我们队取得领先。

words.enDefinition: a series of alternating penalty kicks used to decide a tied football match

examples.en: The final went to a penalty shoot-out after both teams had scored in extra time.
examples.zh: 加时赛两队都有进球，决赛进入了「点球大战」。

examples.en: I stayed for the penalty shoot-out even though the campus bus was almost due.
examples.zh: 虽然校园公交快到了，我还是留下看了「点球大战」。

words.enDefinition: the mark on a football pitch from which a penalty kick is taken

examples.en: The referee pointed to the penalty spot and the crowd around us grew louder.
examples.zh: 裁判指向「点球点」，我们周围的观众声更大了。

examples.en: The player placed the ball on the penalty spot before waiting for the whistle.
examples.zh: 队员把球放在「点球点」上，然后等待哨响。

words.enDefinition: How hard physical activity feels to the person doing it.

examples.en: The fitness journal had a column for perceived exertion next to the duration of each session.
examples.zh: 健身日志在每次运动时长旁设了一栏记录「主观用力感」。

examples.en: My classmate asked what perceived exertion meant on the sample form shown in the studio.
examples.zh: 同学问团课教室展示的示例表上，「主观用力感」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A drama set in a past historical period and portraying life from that time.

examples.en: We chose a period drama because my classmate wanted to see the clothes and interiors.
examples.zh: 我们选了一部「年代剧」，因为同学想看里面的服装和室内陈设。

examples.en: The period drama was set in a village at a time before cars were common.
examples.zh: 这部「年代剧」的故事发生在一个村子里，那时汽车还不普及。

collocations: a costume from a period drama
a period drama set in the seventies

words.enDefinition: The best result a person has recorded in a particular activity.

examples.en: My roommate recorded a personal best for the walk she usually does on the indoor track.
examples.zh: 室友走完她常走的那段室内跑道，记下了「个人最好成绩」。

examples.en: I kept the screenshot because it showed the personal best from my earlier session.
examples.zh: 我留了截图，因为上面是之前那次运动的「个人最好成绩」。

words.enDefinition: a basketball rule violation involving illegal contact by a player

examples.en: The scoreboard showed a personal foul next to the defender's number soon after halftime.
examples.zh: 中场后不久，记分牌在那名防守队员号码旁显示一次「个人犯规」。

examples.en: The referee explained the personal foul briefly before the players returned to their positions.
examples.zh: 队员回各自位置前，裁判简短解释了那次「个人犯规」。

words.enDefinition: A fitness professional who works with individual clients on exercise sessions.

examples.en: My roommate asked whether a personal trainer worked in the recreation center on Fridays.
examples.zh: 室友问，星期五文体活动中心有没有「私人健身教练」。

examples.en: The information desk explained the difference between a personal trainer and a group fitness instructor.
examples.zh: 咨询台解释了「私人健身教练」和团课教练的区别。

collocations: book a session with a personal trainer

words.enDefinition: a series of photographs that tell a story or explore a subject

examples.en: I made a photo essay about the shops along our bus route.
examples.zh: 我拍了一组公交线路沿线的店铺，做成「图片故事」。

examples.en: Her photo essay followed one bench through a full week of weather.
examples.zh: 她的「图片故事」记录了同一张长椅在整整一周不同天气中的样子。

words.enDefinition: a photograph printed on paper for display or keeping

examples.en: I put a photo print from our first walk above my desk.
examples.zh: 我把第一次散步时拍的「纸质照片」贴在了书桌上方。

examples.en: My classmate brought a small photo print for the craft session.
examples.zh: 同学带了一张小「纸质照片」来参加手作活动。

words.enDefinition: a walk taken mainly to look for things to photograph

examples.en: Our club organised a photo walk around the neighbourhood on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六，我们社团在社区里办了一次「边走边拍的活动」。

examples.en: I joined a photo walk and came home with pictures of doorways.
examples.zh: 我参加了一次「边走边拍的活动」，带回来不少门口的照片。

words.enDefinition: theatre that tells a story chiefly through movement and physical expression

examples.en: The physical theatre piece told its story almost entirely through movement.
examples.zh: 这部「肢体剧场」作品几乎完全用动作讲故事。

examples.en: Our tutor invited a physical theatre company to perform in the studio.
examples.zh: 老师邀请了一家「肢体剧场」剧团到工作室演出。

words.enDefinition: an informal game formed on the spot without a fixed roster

examples.en: We joined a pick-up game after seeing that the outdoor basketball court was free.
examples.zh: 发现户外篮球场空着后，我们参加了一场「现场临时组队的比赛」。

examples.en: I met two classmates during a pick-up game near the library last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天，我在图书馆附近的一场「现场临时组队的比赛」中认识了两名同学。

words.enDefinition: a covered structure where people can sit and eat outdoors

examples.en: Our group moved into the picnic shelter when the rain began.
examples.zh: 开始下雨时，我们一行人挪进了「野餐凉棚」。

examples.en: The picnic shelter had enough space for both of the study groups.
examples.zh: 「野餐凉棚」的空间足够两个学习小组使用。

words.enDefinition: A class based on an exercise method emphasizing controlled movement and body awareness.

examples.en: The timetable showed a Pilates class starting just after our morning lecture finished today.
examples.zh: 时间表显示，今天上午的讲座刚结束就有一节「普拉提课」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the Pilates class used mats or equipment in the upstairs studio.
examples.zh: 室友问楼上的「普拉提课」用的是垫子还是器械。

words.enDefinition: An initial episode made to introduce or test the idea for a potential series.

examples.en: The pilot episode introduced three students sharing a kitchen in a new residence hall.
examples.zh: 「试播集」介绍了三个在新宿舍共用厨房的学生。

examples.en: We compared the pilot episode with the later show to see what the writers changed.
examples.zh: 我们把「试播集」和后来的正式剧集作了比较，看看编剧改了哪些地方。

collocations: cast members in the pilot episode

words.enDefinition: a small clay pot shaped mainly by pressing with fingers

examples.en: We made a pinch pot during the first part of the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊第一部分，我们做了个「捏制陶罐」。

examples.en: My friend decorated her pinch pot with tiny marks around the outside.
examples.zh: 朋友在自己的「捏制陶罐」外侧装饰了一圈小印记。

words.enDefinition: a game built around moving and jumping between platforms or surfaces

examples.en: The platformer started with a short level about jumping between floating steps.
examples.zh: 这个「平台跳跃游戏」开头是个很短的关卡，要在悬浮台阶间跳跃。

examples.en: I showed my roommate the platformer I played during the study break.
examples.zh: 我给室友看了学习间隙玩的那个「平台跳跃游戏」。

words.enDefinition: to put a card into play so others cannot see its face

examples.en: I chose to play a card face down and reveal it later.
examples.zh: 我选择「背面朝上出一张牌」，之后再揭开。

examples.en: The rulebook said to play a card face down in the first round.
examples.zh: 规则手册写着，第一轮要「背面朝上出一张牌」。

collocations: choose to play a card face down
allow someone to play a card face down
play a card face down on the board

words.enDefinition: to reproduce music by listening rather than reading written notes

examples.en: My roommate can play by ear after listening to a melody a few times.
examples.zh: 室友听几遍旋律后，就能「凭听觉演奏」。

examples.en: I tried to play by ear when we couldn't find the sheet music online.
examples.zh: 网上找不到乐谱时，我试着「凭听觉演奏」。

collocations: be able to play by ear

words.enDefinition: To start a selected film or episode at its opening again.

examples.en: I chose “Play from the beginning” because my flatmate had missed the opening scene.
examples.zh: 室友没看到开场戏，所以我选了「从头播放」。

examples.en: The player let us play from the beginning without having to reload the whole film.
examples.zh: 播放器让我们不用重新载入整部电影，就可以「从头播放」。

collocations: a play from the beginning option

words.enDefinition: the list of songs or other items scheduled to play next

examples.en: I reordered the playback queue before the rest of the housemates came home.
examples.zh: 其他室友回家之前，我重新排了「待播放队列」。

examples.en: The playback queue showed the tracks we had added during lunch in that same order.
examples.zh: 「待播放队列」按同样的顺序显示了我们午饭时添加的曲目。

words.enDefinition: the number of people a game or session can accommodate

examples.en: I checked the player count on the box before inviting another classmate.
examples.zh: 邀请另一位同学前，我查了盒子上标的「玩家人数」。

examples.en: The board changed shape depending on the player count for that round.
examples.zh: 棋盘会根据那轮的「玩家人数」改变形状。

words.enDefinition: an individual surface where a player organises their cards or pieces

examples.en: I put my extra pieces in the top corner of the player mat.
examples.zh: 我把多余的棋子放在「个人游戏垫」的上角。

examples.en: The player mat showed where to keep cards we had already used.
examples.zh: 「个人游戏垫」标出了用过的牌该放哪儿。

collocations: place a card on the player mat

words.enDefinition: a single card from a deck used in card games

examples.en: I found a playing card in the corner of the game box.
examples.zh: 我在游戏盒角落找到了一张「扑克牌」。

examples.en: Each person chose a playing card to decide who would go first.
examples.zh: 每个人挑了「一张扑克牌」，来决定谁先出。

words.enDefinition: a person who selects and arranges tracks for a playlist

examples.en: Our campus radio playlist curator picked songs by several musicians from the university.
examples.zh: 我们校园电台的「歌单策划人」选了几位校内音乐人的歌。

examples.en: A playlist curator asked our band to suggest a song for the evening programme.
examples.zh: 一位「歌单策划人」请我们乐队为晚间节目推荐一首歌。

words.enDefinition: someone who writes plays for the stage or performance

examples.en: A local playwright answered our questions after the staged reading in class.
examples.zh: 课上做完剧本朗读，一位本地「剧作家」回答了我们的问题。

examples.en: The playwright changed the ending after hearing students read it aloud.
examples.zh: 听学生把剧本读出声后，「剧作家」改了结尾。

words.enDefinition: Feeling a level of tiredness that is satisfying or enjoyable.

examples.en: I felt pleasantly tired after the class while we waited outside for our friends.
examples.zh: 下课后我们在外面等朋友时，我觉得「累得挺舒服」。

examples.en: My roommate wrote pleasantly tired in her journal when she got home from the gym.
examples.zh: 室友从健身房回家后，在日志里写了「累得挺舒服」。

words.enDefinition: A gap or inconsistency in the story that makes part of it difficult to believe.

examples.en: My roommate noticed a plot hole when the train arrived before the station had opened.
examples.zh: 火车在车站开门前就到了，室友看出了一个「情节漏洞」。

examples.en: We spent more time discussing the plot hole than we did talking about the ending.
examples.zh: 我们讨论这个「情节漏洞」的时间比聊结局还长。

words.enDefinition: An unexpected development that changes the direction or meaning of the story.

examples.en: I guessed the plot twist when the same postcard appeared in two different rooms.
examples.zh: 同一张明信片出现在两个房间里时，我猜到了「剧情反转」。

examples.en: The plot twist made us rethink a scene we had laughed at near the beginning.
examples.zh: 这个「剧情反转」让我们重新理解开头那场曾逗我们笑的戏。

words.enDefinition: a small camera designed to take photos with little or no manual adjustment

examples.en: I took a point-and-shoot camera for an afternoon in the park.
examples.zh: 下午去公园时，我带了台「自动便携相机」。

examples.en: My roommate kept a point-and-shoot camera in her bag for quick photos.
examples.zh: 室友包里放了台「自动便携相机」，方便抓拍。

words.enDefinition: the basketball player who usually directs the offence and handles the ball

examples.en: Our point guard spoke to the coach before the rest of the team arrived.
examples.zh: 其他队员到之前，我们的「控球后卫」和教练谈了谈。

examples.en: The point guard dribbled slowly toward the middle as the final minute began.
examples.zh: 最后一分钟开始时，「控球后卫」慢慢向中间运球。

words.enDefinition: stiff ballet shoes designed to support dancing on the toes

examples.en: She left her pointe shoes beside the other dancers' bags backstage.
examples.zh: 她把「芭蕾足尖鞋」放在后台其他舞者的包旁边。

examples.en: The costume display included an old pair of pointe shoes from the school.
examples.zh: 服装展里有一双学校收藏的旧「芭蕾足尖鞋」。

words.enDefinition: a garden planted to attract and support animals that carry pollen

examples.en: The campus pollinator garden had a board describing the flowers volunteers had chosen.
examples.zh: 学校的「传粉动物友好花园」有块板子，介绍志愿者选的花。

examples.en: We drew small sections of the pollinator garden during the weekend workshop.
examples.zh: 周末工作坊里，我们画了「传粉动物友好花园」的几个小角落。

words.enDefinition: the plants and animals that live in or around a pond

examples.en: We spent ten minutes looking at pond life from the wooden platform.
examples.zh: 我们在木平台上花了十分钟观察「池塘里的生物」。

examples.en: The volunteer had drawings of pond life for visitors to compare.
examples.zh: 志愿者准备了「池塘里的生物」图画，供参观者对照。

words.enDefinition: the marked line in front of the wicket that helps define a batter's ground

examples.en: Our coach showed us the popping crease before the first cricket game of term.
examples.zh: 本学期第一场板球赛开始前，教练给我们指了「板球击球线」。

examples.en: I could see the white popping crease clearly from the shade by the pavilion.
examples.zh: 我坐在看台旁的阴凉处，能清楚看见白色的「板球击球线」。

words.enDefinition: a camera setting designed to keep the subject clear against a softer background

examples.en: I switched to portrait mode when my roommate sat near the window.
examples.zh: 室友坐到窗边时，我切换到了「人像模式」。

examples.en: Portrait mode softened the busy background behind the flowers on the table.
examples.zh: 「人像模式」让桌上花朵后面杂乱的背景变模糊了。

collocations: take a picture in portrait mode

words.enDefinition: a quick drawing that represents a particular person

examples.en: My friend made a portrait sketch while I read at the table.
examples.zh: 我在桌边看书时，朋友画了张「人物肖像速写」。

examples.en: I tried a portrait sketch in the last few minutes of the session.
examples.zh: 活动最后几分钟，我试着画了一张「人物肖像速写」。

words.enDefinition: An extra scene shown after the main credits at the end of a production.

examples.en: We waited for the post-credits scene after everyone else had left the screening room.
examples.zh: 其他人都离开放映厅后，我们还在等「片尾字幕后附加场景」。

examples.en: The post-credits scene showed the two friends finally returning the books they had borrowed.
examples.zh: 「片尾字幕后附加场景」里，两位朋友终于把借的书还了回去。

words.enDefinition: A question and answer session held after a film showing.

examples.en: We stayed for the post-screening Q&A because the director had filmed parts of the movie nearby.
examples.zh: 导演在附近拍了电影的一些片段，我们就留下参加了「映后问答」。

examples.en: My classmate asked about the soundtrack during the post-screening Q&A in the auditorium.
examples.zh: 同学在礼堂的「映后问答」中问到了原声音乐。

collocations: ask a question at the post-screening Q&A
a post-screening Q&A with the director

words.enDefinition: a discussion where audiences and performers talk after a show

examples.en: We stayed for the post-show talkback to ask about the painted scenery.
examples.zh: 我们留下参加「演后交流」，询问彩绘布景的事。

examples.en: The playwright joined our post-show talkback from another city by video.
examples.zh: 剧作家从另一个城市通过视频参加了我们的「演后交流」。

words.enDefinition: a coating that gives pottery a finished surface after firing

examples.en: I chose a pale pottery glaze for the little cup I made.
examples.zh: 我给自己做的小杯挑了一种浅色「陶器釉料」。

examples.en: The studio displayed examples of each pottery glaze on small sample tiles.
examples.zh: 工作室用小样砖展示了每种「陶器釉料」的效果。

words.enDefinition: a rotating platform used to shape clay into pottery

examples.en: I tried the pottery wheel during my first visit to the studio.
examples.zh: 第一次去陶艺工作室时，我试了「陶艺拉坯转盘」。

examples.en: My classmate waited for the pottery wheel to become available that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，同学等着「陶艺拉坯转盘」空出来。

words.enDefinition: a prepared growing material used to fill plant containers

examples.en: I brought potting mix to the workshop in a small bag.
examples.zh: 我用一个小袋子带了些「盆栽培养土」去工作坊。

examples.en: My roommate used fresh potting mix for the pots on our balcony.
examples.zh: 室友给我们阳台的花盆用了新的「盆栽培养土」。

collocations: fill a pot with potting mix

words.enDefinition: a slow emotional pop or rock song that builds to a strong, dramatic sound

examples.en: The band saved its power ballad for the moment when the lights came up.
examples.zh: 乐队把那首「强劲抒情歌曲」留到灯光亮起时演奏。

examples.en: My roommate sang the power ballad so loudly that we heard it downstairs.
examples.zh: 室友唱那首「强劲抒情歌曲」很大声，我们在楼下都听到了。

words.enDefinition: a light vest worn to identify which team a player is on during practice

examples.en: I picked up a blue practice bib before joining the group near the goal.
examples.zh: 加入球门旁的队伍前，我拿了件蓝色的「训练分组背心」。

examples.en: The coach asked us to hand back each practice bib after the session ended.
examples.zh: 训练结束后，教练请我们交回每一件「训练分组背心」。

words.enDefinition: an option for trying a game's controls or challenges without a normal result

examples.en: I spent a few minutes in practice mode before the others joined.
examples.zh: 其他人加入前，我在「练习模式」里玩了几分钟。

examples.en: The practice mode let us repeat the same pattern until we remembered it.
examples.zh: 「练习模式」能反复练同一套动作，直到我们记住。

words.enDefinition: to repeat the words you need to say in a performance

examples.en: You can practise your lines in the green room while the crew sets up.
examples.zh: 工作人员布置时，你可以在演员休息室「练习台词」。

examples.en: It's easier to practise your lines with someone who knows the scene already.
examples.zh: 和已经熟悉这场戏的人一起「练习台词」会比较容易。

collocations: practise your lines with a friend

words.enDefinition: entertainment presented to spectators before the start of a sports game

examples.en: We arrived early enough to see the whole pre-game show from our seats.
examples.zh: 我们到得早，坐在座位上看完了整场「赛前表演」。

examples.en: My friend volunteered to help with the pre-game show on Saturday.
examples.zh: 朋友报名在周六的「赛前表演」帮忙。

words.enDefinition: the role or area of play that a player would most like to take

examples.en: The form asked for my preferred position before I joined the practice squad.
examples.zh: 我加入训练队以前，表格问我的「首选上场位置」。

examples.en: My teammate's preferred position changed after she played both roles during the weekend.
examples.zh: 我队友周末两个位置都打过之后，「首选上场位置」变了。

words.enDefinition: an early ticket sale for a defined group before public sales

examples.en: The arts club announced a presale for its student members on Monday.
examples.zh: 艺术社周一宣布面向学生会员「预售」门票。

examples.en: I bought my seat during the presale before the general sale began.
examples.zh: 我在公开发售前的「预售」阶段买了座位。

words.enDefinition: a code permitting entry to a ticket sale before public access

examples.en: The email included a presale code for the campus arts series.
examples.zh: 邮件里有校园系列艺术活动的「预售资格码」。

examples.en: The presale code let me see which seats were in the early sale.
examples.zh: 用「预售资格码」后，我能看到预售范围内的座位。

words.enDefinition: a credential that grants journalists access to designated event areas

examples.en: The student newspaper sent a reporter with a press pass that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，学生报派了一名持「媒体通行证」的记者。

examples.en: The volunteer explained where the press pass could be used at the venue.
examples.zh: 志愿者解释了「媒体通行证」能在场馆的哪些地方使用。

words.enDefinition: flowers dried flat and used as keepsakes or decoration

examples.en: I used pressed flowers from the trip to decorate my journal.
examples.zh: 我用出游时做的「压平的干花」装饰手账。

examples.en: My friend arranged pressed flowers along the edge of the card.
examples.zh: 朋友沿着卡片边缘摆了些「压平的干花」。

words.enDefinition: a public show presented before a production officially opens

examples.en: I saw the preview performance before the cast changed part of the ending.
examples.zh: 结尾有一段改动之前，我看了「正式首演前的试演场」。

examples.en: The theatre invited students to the preview performance on a weekday afternoon.
examples.zh: 剧场邀请同学们在一个工作日的下午观看「正式首演前的试演场」。

words.enDefinition: a game waiting room limited to invited or permitted players

examples.en: We made a private lobby so just our flatmates could play together.
examples.zh: 我们开了个「私人房间」，只有合住的几个室友一起玩。

examples.en: My friend left the private lobby open while I went to get tea.
examples.zh: 我去拿茶时，朋友让「私人房间」继续开着。

collocations: invite friends to a private lobby

words.enDefinition: a list of things that may not enter a venue

examples.en: The arena displayed a prohibited items list near the line for tickets.
examples.zh: 体育馆在排队买票的地方附近展示了「禁止携带物品清单」。

examples.en: I looked up the prohibited items list before leaving for the festival.
examples.zh: 出发去参加节庆活动前，我查了「禁止携带物品清单」。

words.enDefinition: to speak clearly and strongly enough to be heard far away

examples.en: You need to project your voice so the back row can hear your name.
examples.zh: 你得「让声音传到观众席」，这样最后一排才能听清你的名字。

examples.en: It takes practice to project your voice without sounding like you are shouting.
examples.zh: 要做到「让声音传到观众席」，又不让人觉得在喊，需要练习。

collocations: practise how to project your voice
project your voice to the back row

words.enDefinition: evidence that a person qualifies for a particular ticket or benefit

examples.en: The ticket office asked for proof of eligibility before issuing the student pass.
examples.zh: 售票处先要看「资格证明」，再发学生通票。

examples.en: A student card was listed as acceptable proof of eligibility for that event.
examples.zh: 那场活动明确列出，学生证可以作为「资格证明」。

words.enDefinition: the person responsible for sourcing and managing props for a production

examples.en: Our prop master found an old phone for the opening scene.
examples.zh: 我们的「道具主管」为开场戏找来了一部旧电话。

examples.en: The prop master checked that the suitcase was back before the second act.
examples.zh: 「道具主管」在第二幕开始前确认行李箱已经归位。

words.enDefinition: a table near the stage where props are laid out

examples.en: I left the fake letter on the prop table behind the curtain.
examples.zh: 我把那封假信留在了幕布后面的「道具摆放台」上。

examples.en: The prop table had a labelled spot for each object we needed.
examples.zh: 「道具摆放台」上每件要用的东西都有标好的位置。

collocations: return something to the prop table

words.enDefinition: the arch or frame separating a conventional stage from its audience

examples.en: My seat gave me a clear view of the painted proscenium arch.
examples.zh: 从我的座位能清楚看到彩绘的「镜框式台口」。

examples.en: The proscenium arch made the stage look like a giant picture frame.
examples.zh: 「镜框式台口」让舞台看起来像一个巨大的画框。

words.enDefinition: A thriller that builds suspense through characters' fears, perceptions, or mental conflict.

examples.en: The psychological thriller left me wondering which of the main character's memories I could trust.
examples.zh: 这部「心理惊悚片」让我一直想，主角的哪些回忆才可信。

examples.en: We picked a psychological thriller because the description suggested a story built around uncertainty.
examples.zh: 故事简介说情节围绕不确定性展开，我们就选了这部「心理惊悚片」。

collocations: the ending of a psychological thriller

words.enDefinition: a spoken announcement broadcast over a venue's loudspeakers

examples.en: A public address announcement reminded us where to find the student exit.
examples.zh: 一则「场馆广播通知」提醒我们去哪里找学生出口。

examples.en: We stopped talking when the public address announcement asked people to listen.
examples.zh: 「场馆广播通知」请大家注意听时，我们就不说话了。

collocations: listen for a public address announcement

words.enDefinition: A horizontal exercise bar suspended high enough for a person to hang from.

examples.en: The pull-up bar was mounted high on the frame at the back of the room.
examples.zh: 房间后面的架子上装着一根位置较高的「引体向上杆」。

examples.en: Our guide showed us the label for the pull-up bar on the new floor map.
examples.zh: 向导给我们指了新楼层图上「引体向上杆」的标注。

words.enDefinition: the final line or part of a joke that provokes laughter

examples.en: The performer waited a beat before delivering the punchline of the joke.
examples.zh: 表演者停了一拍，才抖出这段笑话的「包袱」。

examples.en: I guessed the punchline before my friend finished telling the joke.
examples.zh: 朋友还没讲完笑话，我就猜到了「包袱」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the art of using puppets to tell stories onstage

examples.en: Our drama group explored puppetry using figures made from folded paper.
examples.zh: 戏剧小组用纸折的人偶探索「木偶表演艺术」。

examples.en: I was surprised by how expressive puppetry could be without dialogue.
examples.zh: 没想到即使没有台词，「木偶表演艺术」也能这么有表现力。

words.enDefinition: to choose to play a song or list over and over

examples.en: There was one track I wanted to put on repeat while working on the poster.
examples.zh: 做海报时，有一首我想「设置循环播放」。

examples.en: I asked which song we should put on repeat for the walk home that evening.
examples.zh: 我问那晚走回家时，该把哪首歌「设置循环播放」。

collocations: choose a song to put on repeat
decide what to put on repeat

words.enDefinition: a game mainly about solving problems or finding patterns

examples.en: I lent my friend a puzzle game that involved arranging coloured shapes.
examples.zh: 我借给朋友一个要排列彩色形状的「解谜游戏」。

examples.en: Our puzzle game lasted longer than expected because everyone suggested different solutions.
examples.zh: 大家各有解法，我们这一局「解谜游戏」比预想的要久。

words.enDefinition: a match or round that produces participants for the semifinals

examples.en: Our student team reached the quarter-final after winning its group on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 学生队周六上午拿下小组第一后，进入了「四分之一决赛」。

examples.en: The quarter-final ended just in time for us to catch the last bus.
examples.zh: 「四分之一决赛」刚好结束，我们还赶得上末班车。

words.enDefinition: to wait together for the same online game to be found

examples.en: I wanted to queue with friends instead of joining the session alone.
examples.zh: 我想「和朋友一起排队匹配」，不想自己进对局。

examples.en: The game let me queue with friends even while they were setting up.
examples.zh: 朋友们还在做准备时，游戏就让我能「和他们一起排队匹配」。

collocations: queue with friends for a match

words.enDefinition: a costume change that a performer makes very rapidly during a show

examples.en: I had less than a minute for a quick change between scenes.
examples.zh: 两场戏之间，我要在不到一分钟内「快速换装」。

examples.en: One wardrobe volunteer helped me with a quick change in the wings.
examples.zh: 一位服装组志愿者在侧幕后帮我「快速换装」。

words.enDefinition: an option to join a standard game with little setup

examples.en: I chose a quick match while waiting for the rest of my group.
examples.zh: 等小组其他人时，我选了「快速匹配」。

examples.en: The game offered quick match for players who didn't want custom rules.
examples.zh: 游戏给不想自己设规则的玩家提供了「快速匹配」。

words.enDefinition: a version of a song shortened or otherwise adapted for radio play

examples.en: The radio edit left out the long introduction that I remembered from the album.
examples.zh: 「广播剪辑版」省掉了我记得专辑里有的那段长前奏。

examples.en: The station played a radio edit before the programme moved on to local news.
examples.zh: 电台放了一个「广播剪辑版」，之后节目转入本地新闻。

words.enDefinition: a temporary interruption or postponement at an event because of rain

examples.en: We bought something warm to drink during the rain delay that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午比赛「因雨推迟」期间，我们买了点热饮。

examples.en: The announcer explained the rain delay before giving another start time.
examples.zh: 广播员先解释了「因雨推迟」，随后公布了另一个开始时间。

words.enDefinition: a growing area with soil held above the surrounding ground

examples.en: The volunteers built a raised garden bed near the residence entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者在宿舍入口附近搭了个「高架种植床」。

examples.en: We planted flowers together in the raised garden bed on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六，我们一起在「高架种植床」里种了花。

collocations: plant in a raised garden bed

words.enDefinition: a play option where results count toward an official game ranking

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the match would count in ranked mode that evening.
examples.zh: 室友问那晚的对局在「排位模式」里算不算成绩。

examples.en: I tried ranked mode after learning how the points were displayed.
examples.zh: 弄清积分怎么显示后，我试了「排位模式」。

words.enDefinition: an ink mark showing that a visitor may enter again

examples.en: The volunteer offered a re-entry stamp when we stepped outside briefly.
examples.zh: 我们短暂出去时，志愿者提出给我们盖个「再次入场用的印章」。

examples.en: My re-entry stamp was still visible when I returned to the venue.
examples.zh: 我回到场馆时，「再次入场用的印章」还清晰可见。

words.enDefinition: To return loose weights to their proper rack after they have been used.

examples.en: The fitness attendant held up a card asking students to re-rack weights after use.
examples.zh: 健身区值班员举起一张卡片，请同学们用完后「把重量器材放回架上」。

examples.en: Our gym had signs to re-rack weights at both ends of the long mirror.
examples.zh: 我们健身房那面长镜子的两头都贴着「把重量器材放回架上」的告示。

words.enDefinition: A later release of a previously released film, often bringing it back to theaters.

examples.en: The cinema promoted a re-release of an older comedy as part of its anniversary program.
examples.zh: 影院把一部老喜剧的「重新上映」作为周年活动来宣传。

examples.en: We missed the original screenings, so we were pleased about the re-release later that term.
examples.zh: 我们没赶上最初的场次，得知学期后面会「重新上映」很高兴。

words.enDefinition: a gathering where people listen to a text read aloud

examples.en: I attended a read-aloud session about local stories at the arts centre.
examples.zh: 我去艺术中心参加了一次关于本地故事的「朗读活动」。

examples.en: The read-aloud session gave several students a chance to share a passage.
examples.zh: 这次「朗读活动」给了几名同学分享一个片段的机会。

words.enDefinition: a session where performers read a play aloud from start to finish

examples.en: We had our first read-through around a long table in the library.
examples.zh: 我们围坐在图书馆的一张长桌旁，进行了第一次「剧本通读」。

examples.en: The writer attended the read-through and listened without interrupting the actors.
examples.zh: 作者参加了「剧本通读」，演员朗读时一直听着，没有打断。

words.enDefinition: a notebook or record for summarising and reflecting on reading

examples.en: I wrote down my favourite scene in my reading journal after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我把最喜欢的片段记在了「阅读手账」里。

examples.en: My reading journal helped me remember which books I had finished.
examples.zh: 「阅读手账」帮我记住了自己读完哪些书。

words.enDefinition: a period when it feels difficult to get interested in reading

examples.en: I was in a reading slump until I tried a short graphic novel.
examples.zh: 试读一本短篇图像小说前，我一直处于「阅读低潮」。

examples.en: My friend switched genres when she hit a reading slump after exams.
examples.zh: 朋友考完试遇到「阅读低潮」，就换了个类型读。

collocations: get out of a reading slump

words.enDefinition: to indicate in a lobby that you are ready to start

examples.en: We decided to ready up after checking that both controllers were working.
examples.zh: 确认两个手柄都能用后，我们决定「点准备」。

examples.en: The host asked everyone to ready up when they had chosen a character.
examples.zh: 房主请大家选好角色后「点准备」。

collocations: wait for everyone to ready up
be the last to ready up

words.enDefinition: A program following real participants in filmed situations, challenges, or daily activities.

examples.en: The reality show followed students trying to redesign a shared space in their building.
examples.zh: 这档「真人秀节目」跟拍了一群尝试改造楼里共用空间的学生。

examples.en: My roommate likes a reality show where teams design things under a time limit.
examples.zh: 室友爱看一种「真人秀节目」，各队要在规定时间内完成设计。

collocations: take part in a reality show

words.enDefinition: a ball recovered after a missed basketball shot

examples.en: I watched the centre jump for the rebound after the shot bounced off the rim.
examples.zh: 投篮弹框后，我看着中锋跳起来抢「篮板球」。

examples.en: The guard collected the last rebound and held the ball until the buzzer sounded.
examples.zh: 后卫拿到最后一个「篮板球」，一直控制球到终场哨响。

words.enDefinition: A label grouping titles that have been added to a service in the recent past.

examples.en: I found an old documentary under “Recently added” while looking for something short to watch.
examples.zh: 我想找部短点的片子时，在「近期加入片库」一栏发现了一部老纪录片。

examples.en: The recently added section included a film that my class had watched a year earlier.
examples.zh: 「近期加入片库」栏目里有一部我们班一年前看过的电影。

words.enDefinition: a person who guides the making and creative sound of a recording

examples.en: The record producer suggested recording the piano separately in the smaller room.
examples.zh: 「唱片制作人」建议把钢琴声部放到较小的房间单独录制。

examples.en: My tutor had worked as a record producer before joining the music department.
examples.zh: 导师进入音乐系工作前做过「唱片制作人」。

words.enDefinition: a store selling recordings, especially vinyl records or CDs

examples.en: I stopped at the record shop before catching the train home after class.
examples.zh: 下课坐火车回家前，我去了趟「唱片店」。

examples.en: The small record shop hosted a listening party for a local artist that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，这家小「唱片店」为一位本地艺人办了集体听歌会。

words.enDefinition: a protective paper or cardboard cover that holds a vinyl record

examples.en: The record sleeve was worn at the corners, but the disc still looked clean.
examples.zh: 「唱片封套」的角磨损了，不过唱片看着还很干净。

examples.en: I put the disc back in its record sleeve before passing it to my flatmate.
examples.zh: 递给室友之前，我把碟放回了「唱片封套」里。

collocations: put a disc in its record sleeve

words.enDefinition: a sports league primarily organized for enjoyment and regular participation

examples.en: We chose the recreational league because we wanted a relaxed game after classes.
examples.zh: 我们选了「休闲体育联赛」，想课后轻松打一场。

examples.en: The recreational league offered weekend matches at a sports centre near our flat.
examples.zh: 「休闲体育联赛」在公寓附近的一家体育中心安排周末比赛。

words.enDefinition: A stationary exercise bike with a backrest and a seat set in a reclined position.

examples.en: The recreation center put a recumbent bike next to the upright bikes by the mirror.
examples.zh: 文体活动中心把一台「卧式健身车」摆在镜子旁的直立式健身车旁边。

examples.en: A student asked the attendant to identify the recumbent bike shown on the map.
examples.zh: 一名同学请值班员指出地图上哪台是「卧式健身车」。

collocations: a recumbent bike with a backrest
a row with a recumbent bike

words.enDefinition: a card shown by a referee to send a player off

examples.en: The crowd went quiet when the referee held up a red card near the touchline.
examples.zh: 裁判在边线附近举起「红牌」时，观众安静了下来。

examples.en: The team finished with fewer players after one defender received a red card.
examples.zh: 一名后卫被「红牌罚下」后，球队以更少的人数打完比赛。

words.enDefinition: to limit animations or camera movement in a game's display

examples.en: The accessibility menu let me reduce motion while keeping the other settings.
examples.zh: 无障碍菜单让我可以「减少画面动效」，同时保留其他设置。

examples.en: I chose to reduce motion before continuing with the puzzle on the screen.
examples.zh: 我选择先「减少画面动效」，再接着解屏幕上的谜题。

words.enDefinition: a small card summarising rules or actions for easy checking

examples.en: I kept the reference card beside me throughout the first round.
examples.zh: 第一轮我一直把「规则速查卡」放在手边。

examples.en: The reference card showed four actions we could choose from each turn.
examples.zh: 「规则速查卡」列出了每回合可选的四种行动。

collocations: a reference card for each player

words.enDefinition: a photograph consulted for details while making an artwork

examples.en: I took a reference photo before moving the flowers away from the window.
examples.zh: 把花从窗边移开之前，我拍了一张「绘画参考照片」。

examples.en: My classmate used a reference photo for the folds of the jacket.
examples.zh: 同学用「绘画参考照片」来画夹克的褶皱。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying who is needed at a rehearsal and when

examples.en: The rehearsal call asked only the dancers to come in on Monday.
examples.zh: 「排练到场通知」只要求舞者周一过来。

examples.en: I checked the rehearsal call to see when our scene would be rehearsed.
examples.zh: 我看了看「排练到场通知」，确认我们那场戏什么时候排。

words.enDefinition: a room set aside for practising a performance

examples.en: We put tape on the rehearsal room floor to mark our positions.
examples.zh: 我们用胶带在「排练室」地上标出站位。

examples.en: My classmates waited outside the rehearsal room until the dancers had finished.
examples.zh: 同学们在「排练室」外等到舞者练完。

words.enDefinition: a release of music that had already been made available at an earlier time

examples.en: The new reissue included photos from the original recording sessions in the university studio.
examples.zh: 新的「再版发行」收录了当年在大学录音室录制时的照片。

examples.en: I bought the reissue because the older copy was difficult to find locally.
examples.zh: 旧版在当地难找，我就买了「再版」。

words.enDefinition: to return to a match you previously left

examples.en: I tried to rejoin the match after I closed the game by mistake.
examples.zh: 不小心关掉游戏后，我试着「重新加入原对局」。

examples.en: The menu gave me a chance to rejoin the match after I reconnected.
examples.zh: 重新连上后，菜单给了我一次「重新加入原对局」的机会。

collocations: offer an option to rejoin the match

words.enDefinition: a show adapted to welcome people with different sensory needs

examples.en: At our relaxed performance, the house lights stayed partly on throughout the show.
examples.zh: 我们去的「感官友好场次」，观众席灯光在整场演出中没有完全熄灭。

examples.en: The programme explained how the relaxed performance would differ from the evening show.
examples.zh: 节目册介绍了「感官友好场次」与晚场会有哪些不同。

words.enDefinition: seats that are still available for a particular event

examples.en: I checked the remaining seats before asking whether my roommate could come.
examples.zh: 我查完「剩余座位」，才问室友能不能来。

examples.en: Most of the remaining seats were behind the team benches that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，多数「剩余座位」在球队替补席后面。

words.enDefinition: to change which inputs perform particular actions in a game

examples.en: I wanted to remap the controls because that button was difficult to reach.
examples.zh: 那个键够起来不方便，我想「重新设置按键功能」。

examples.en: The menu let us remap the controls before starting the next round.
examples.zh: 下一轮开始前，我们可以在菜单里「重新设置按键功能」。

collocations: let a player remap the controls

words.enDefinition: to prepare a new master recording from existing material to improve or change its sound

examples.en: The label decided to remaster the live recording before putting it online last year.
examples.zh: 唱片公司去年把现场录音放到网上之前，决定「重新处理母带」。

examples.en: A graduate from our course helped remaster the tracks from the band's early sessions.
examples.zh: 我们专业的一位毕业生帮忙为乐队早期录制的曲目「重新处理母带」。

words.enDefinition: another game between players who have just played each other

examples.en: My flatmate suggested a rematch while we still had the room.
examples.zh: 我们还能用一会儿那间屋子，室友提议「再赛一局」。

examples.en: We agreed to a rematch with the same teams after a break.
examples.zh: 我们商量好休息一下，队伍不变，「再赛一局」。

words.enDefinition: a different version of recorded music made by changing or recombining its sounds

examples.en: I liked the remix because it brought the quiet backing vocals forward a little.
examples.zh: 我喜欢「重新混音版」，这一版把原本很轻的伴唱调得稍突出些。

examples.en: The DJ played a remix with a quicker beat near the end of the set.
examples.zh: DJ 的表演快结束时，放了一个节奏更快的「重新混音版」。

words.enDefinition: One complete performance of an exercise movement, counted as a unit.

examples.en: I asked what a rep meant after seeing the word in the fitness log.
