examples.zh: 其他队员正沿球场向前移动，我们队快速「掷出界外球」。

words.enDefinition: a stage extending into the audience with seating on three sides

examples.en: The actors sometimes faced away from us on the thrust stage.
examples.zh: 在「伸入观众席的舞台」上表演时，演员有时会背向我们。

examples.en: We learned how to perform on a thrust stage during the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊上，我们学习了如何在「伸入观众席的舞台」上表演。

words.enDefinition: a very small drawing for trying a composition quickly

examples.en: I made a thumbnail sketch to test where the horizon should go.
examples.zh: 我画了一张「构图小稿」，试试地平线放在哪儿。

examples.en: My tutor drew a thumbnail sketch before discussing the larger painting.
examples.zh: 老师先画了一张「构图小稿」，然后才讨论那幅更大的画。

words.enDefinition: a small movable control on a gamepad operated by the thumb

examples.en: The tutorial asked me to move the left thumbstick toward the marked space.
examples.zh: 教程提示把左侧「手柄摇杆」拨向标出的位置。

examples.en: My friend showed me how the thumbstick moved the cursor on the map.
examples.zh: 朋友给我演示了「手柄摇杆」怎么移动地图上的光标。

collocations: use a thumbstick to move the cursor

words.enDefinition: a message that a ticket has previously been scanned for admission

examples.en: The reader showed "Ticket already scanned," and the attendant took another look.
examples.zh: 扫码器显示「门票已扫验」，工作人员又看了一遍。

examples.en: I asked the ticket desk about the "Ticket already scanned" message on my screen.
examples.zh: 我向票务服务台询问手机屏幕上的「门票已扫验」提示。

words.enDefinition: a code on a ticket that can be scanned for entry

examples.en: The attendant asked me to display the ticket barcode on my phone.
examples.zh: 入场工作人员请我在手机上显示「门票条码」。

examples.en: I could see the seat details above the ticket barcode in the app.
examples.zh: 我能在应用里的「门票条码」上方看到座位详情。

words.enDefinition: a set of tickets sold together as one purchase

examples.en: The ticket bundle covered three home games in the same month.
examples.zh: 这套「组合门票」涵盖同一个月的三场主场比赛。

examples.en: My roommate bought a ticket bundle that also included the final.
examples.zh: 室友买了一套「组合门票」，还包括决赛。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of tickets one buyer can obtain

examples.en: The ticket limit for that event was shown before we selected seats.
examples.zh: 选座之前，页面显示了那场活动的「门票限购数量」。

examples.en: We checked the ticket limit before deciding how to book our seats.
examples.zh: 决定怎么订座前，我们查看了「门票限购数量」。

words.enDefinition: a system that randomly chooses who can receive or purchase tickets

examples.en: I entered the ticket lottery for a seat at the university final.
examples.zh: 我参加了大学决赛的「门票抽签」，想抽到一个座位。

examples.en: They held a ticket lottery because there were more interested students than seats.
examples.zh: 因为学生比座位多，所以采用了「门票抽签」。

collocations: hear back from a ticket lottery

words.enDefinition: a message confirming arrangements to collect tickets from a venue

examples.en: I saved the ticket pickup confirmation to check which counter we should visit.
examples.zh: 我保存了「领票确认信息」，想确认该去哪个柜台。

examples.en: The ticket pickup confirmation arrived in the same email as the match details.
examples.zh: 「领票确认信息」和比赛详情在同一封邮件里发来。

words.enDefinition: exchanging a voucher or other entitlement for an actual event ticket

examples.en: The instructions for ticket redemption were printed below the student voucher.
examples.zh: 学生兑换券的下方印着「门票兑换」说明。

examples.en: I asked where ticket redemption took place before joining the wrong line.
examples.zh: 怕排错队，我先问了「门票兑换」在哪儿办理。

words.enDefinition: the point when some or all event tickets become available

examples.en: My friend put the ticket release date in our shared calendar.
examples.zh: 朋友把「门票放出」日期加进了我们的共享日历。

examples.en: The club announced another ticket release after adding an extra seating section.
examples.zh: 增开一个座位区后，俱乐部宣布再「放出一批门票」。

words.enDefinition: the period when people can purchase tickets for an event

examples.en: The ticket sale window closed before I finished my seminar that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午我上完研讨课前，「门票销售时段」就结束了。

examples.en: The athletics department published the ticket sale window in its weekly newsletter.
examples.zh: 体育部在每周简报里公布了「门票销售时段」。

words.enDefinition: a device that reads and checks event tickets at entry

examples.en: The volunteer raised a ticket scanner when we reached the front.
examples.zh: 我们排到前面时，志愿者举起了「门票扫描设备」。

examples.en: A ticket scanner beeped every time a ticket was read correctly.
examples.zh: 每次正确读取一张票，「门票扫描设备」都会发出一声提示音。

words.enDefinition: the part of a printed ticket kept after it is checked

examples.en: I saved the ticket stub from my first game at university.
examples.zh: 我留了第一次在大学看球赛的「票根」。

examples.en: My dad found a ticket stub in an old photo album.
examples.zh: 爸爸在一本旧相册里找到一张「票根」。

words.enDefinition: the authorised process of sending an electronic ticket to another person

examples.en: The box office confirmed that a ticket transfer was available for this event.
examples.zh: 售票处确认这场活动允许「门票转交」。

examples.en: I received a ticket transfer from my roommate before the game.
examples.zh: 比赛前，我收到了室友发来的「门票转交」请求。

words.enDefinition: a voucher that can be exchanged for an event ticket

examples.en: My tutor handed me a ticket voucher for a campus wrestling match.
examples.zh: 老师给了我一张校园摔跤赛的「门票兑换券」。

examples.en: I checked whether the ticket voucher covered more than one event.
examples.zh: 我查了一下那张「门票兑换券」能不能用在不止一场活动里。

words.enDefinition: a list of people who want tickets if any become available

examples.en: I joined the ticket waitlist after seeing that the first batch was gone.
examples.zh: 看到第一批票已经售完，我加入了「门票候补名单」。

examples.en: My place on the ticket waitlist changed the morning of the game.
examples.zh: 比赛当天上午，我在「门票候补名单」上的顺序变了。

words.enDefinition: says that a reader is not successfully reading a ticket

examples.en: The attendant said, "Your ticket won't scan," and asked me to wait.
examples.zh: 工作人员说：「你的门票扫不出来」，请我等一下。

examples.en: I told the gate attendant, "My ticket won't scan on this screen."
examples.zh: 我告诉入口工作人员：「我的门票扫不出来」，用的是这个界面。

collocations: tell staff your ticket won't scan
ask why the ticket won't scan
alert saying the ticket won't scan

words.enDefinition: an online line that gives buyers turns to shop for tickets

examples.en: The ticketing queue opened when the school released more seats that week.
examples.zh: 学校那一周放出更多座位时，「购票等待队列」开始了。

examples.en: I left the ticketing queue once my classmate told me all seats were gone.
examples.zh: 同学说座位都没了，我就退出了「购票等待队列」。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that tickets for an event are not available to access or buy at the moment

examples.en: The app displayed "Tickets not yet available," although the booking had already been confirmed.
examples.zh: 虽然订票已确认，但应用显示「门票暂不可查看」。

examples.en: We saw "Tickets not yet available" when we opened the booking page after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后打开订票页面时，我们看到了「门票暂不可查看」。

collocations: notice reading tickets not yet available

words.enDefinition: a rule for deciding the result when players have equal scores

examples.en: We checked the tie-break rule when two players finished on the same score.
examples.zh: 两名玩家最后分数一样，我们查了「平局判定规则」。

examples.en: The tie-break rule was printed under the example on the final page.
examples.zh: 「平局判定规则」印在末页例子的下面。

words.enDefinition: a rule or extra contest used to decide between otherwise equal results

examples.en: The league used head-to-head results as a tie-breaker after the regular season ended.
examples.zh: 常规赛结束后，联赛用直接交手结果作为「平手判定办法」。

examples.en: I checked which tie-breaker applied before working out our team's position in the group.
examples.zh: 计算我们队的小组名次前，我查了适用的「平手判定办法」。

words.enDefinition: a special scoring game used to decide a tied set or, under some competition rules, a tied match in tennis

examples.en: We played a tiebreak after the teams reached six games each in the final set.
examples.zh: 决胜盘打成六比六后，我们打了「平分决胜局」。

examples.en: The final tiebreak took longer than I expected because the points were so close.
examples.zh: 最后的「平分决胜局」比分咬得很紧，比我预期的打得久。

words.enDefinition: a game where players add tiles to a shared or personal arrangement

examples.en: We chose a tile-laying game because people could learn by watching one turn.
examples.zh: 我们选了一款「板块放置游戏」，因为看一轮就能学会。

examples.en: The tile-laying game took up most of our small kitchen table.
examples.zh: 这个「板块放置游戏」占了我们厨房小桌的大半。

words.enDefinition: the start of a basketball game, traditionally with a jump ball

examples.en: I got to the gym a few minutes before tip-off after my evening seminar.
examples.zh: 晚间研讨课后，我在「篮球赛开场」前几分钟到达体育馆。

examples.en: Both teams had finished warming up well before tip-off in the afternoon game.
examples.zh: 下午那场比赛「篮球赛开场」前，两队早早就热完了身。

words.enDefinition: a track with the same name as its album, film, or other work

examples.en: The title track sounded very different when the band played it without drums.
examples.zh: 乐队不加鼓演奏时，「与专辑同名的曲目」听起来很不一样。

examples.en: We started with the title track before playing the rest of the album.
examples.zh: 我们从「与专辑同名的曲目」开始听，之后才放剩下的歌。

words.enDefinition: a personal list of books someone wants to read in the future

examples.en: I added the novel to my to-be-read list after hearing about it.
examples.zh: 听人提到那本小说后，我把它加进了「待读书单」。

examples.en: My to-be-read list grew longer during the book club's summer meeting.
examples.zh: 读书会那次夏日聚会后，我的「待读书单」又变长了。

collocations: add a book to your to-be-read list

words.enDefinition: a chance for audience members to explore props or scenery by touch

examples.en: A volunteer introduced the props during a touch tour before the performance.
examples.zh: 一名志愿者在「演前触摸导览」上介绍了道具。

examples.en: The touch tour included some fabric samples from the show's costumes.
examples.zh: 「演前触摸导览」包含了演出服装的几块面料样品。

words.enDefinition: a score in American football made by legally carrying the ball across the opponents' goal line or gaining legal possession in their end zone

examples.en: The college crowd cheered when our team scored a touchdown before the break.
examples.zh: 我们队在中场前完成了「美式橄榄球达阵」，学院的观众欢呼起来。

examples.en: I nearly missed the touchdown because my classmates arrived just as the play began.
examples.zh: 这次进攻刚开始时同学才到，我差点错过「美式橄榄球达阵」。

words.enDefinition: one of the two long boundary lines on a football pitch

examples.en: My friend stood near the touchline to watch the last part of the match.
examples.zh: 比赛最后一段，朋友站在「足球场边线」附近看。

examples.en: The ball crossed the touchline just before the winger reached it that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午边锋就快追到球时，球越过了「足球场边线」。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled appearance during a tour of performances

examples.en: The band's nearest tour date was the evening before my final university exam.
examples.zh: 乐队离我最近的「巡演日期场次」在我大学最后一门考试的前一天晚上。

examples.en: They added a tour date in our city after their first show sold out.
examples.zh: 第一场票卖完后，他们在我们城市加了一场「巡演场次」。

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing matchups and progression through the rounds of a tournament

examples.en: I found my team on the tournament bracket next to the gym entrance.
examples.zh: 我在体育馆入口旁的「淘汰赛对阵表」上找到了自己的队伍。

examples.en: The tournament bracket showed that the winners would meet again on Sunday afternoon.
examples.zh: 「淘汰赛对阵表」显示，获胜者周日下午会接着比赛。

words.enDefinition: A service through which a facility supplies towels for visitors to use.

examples.en: We asked about towel service after noticing the stack of clean towels near reception.
examples.zh: 看到前台附近叠着一摞干净毛巾后，我们问了问「毛巾供应服务」。

examples.en: A notice about towel service was posted beside the entrance to the changing area.
examples.zh: 更衣区入口旁贴着一则「毛巾供应服务」告示。

words.enDefinition: the ordered list of pieces in a particular recording or release

examples.en: I checked the tracklist to find which song played after the piano piece.
examples.zh: 我查看「专辑曲目清单」，想找钢琴曲后面放的是哪首歌。

examples.en: The band changed the tracklist slightly before making the album available to listeners.
examples.zh: 专辑向听众上线前，乐队稍微调整了「专辑曲目清单」。

words.enDefinition: the place where a recreational walking trail begins

examples.en: We agreed to meet at the trailhead with our notebooks and water.
examples.zh: 我们约好带着笔记本和水，在「步道起点」集合。

examples.en: The trailhead had a board showing photographs of the nearby woodland.
examples.zh: 「步道起点」有块展示附近林地照片的板子。

words.enDefinition: indicates that a ticket transfer has not yet been completed

examples.en: The app showed "Transfer pending" while my friend checked her email.
examples.zh: 朋友查看邮件时，应用显示「门票转交待确认」。

examples.en: I saw "Transfer pending" underneath the ticket I had sent that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上我发出门票后，看见票下方写着「门票转交待确认」。

words.enDefinition: fans who travel to support their team at an away event

examples.en: The travelling supporters started a chant near the far end of the stadium.
examples.zh: 体育场远端附近，「随队出行的球迷」带头喊起了口号。

examples.en: We met two travelling supporters on the train after the match.
examples.zh: 赛后我们在火车上认识了两位「随队出行的球迷」。

words.enDefinition: An exercise machine with a moving belt that a person can walk or run on.

examples.en: The first treadmill by the window had a sign saying it was being checked.
examples.zh: 窗边第一台「跑步机」上贴了牌子，写着正在检查。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the treadmill beside the stairs was included on the tour.
examples.zh: 室友问参观会不会介绍楼梯旁的「跑步机」。

words.enDefinition: A session someone attends to try an activity before deciding whether to continue.

examples.en: My flatmate took a trial class with me before we chose an evening session together.
examples.zh: 在一起选晚上那节课之前，室友陪我上了一次「体验课」。

examples.en: The trial class fit between our lectures, so several people from my course attended.
examples.zh: 「体验课」刚好安排在我们两节课之间，所以同一专业的几个人都去了。

words.enDefinition: a group that performs in the style of a particular artist or band

examples.en: My friend went to see a tribute band with her father during the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期里，朋友和爸爸一起去看了一支「致敬乐队」。

examples.en: A tribute band performed songs from one group's early recordings all evening last Friday.
examples.zh: 上周五整晚，一支「致敬乐队」都在演出某个乐队早期录制的歌曲。

words.enDefinition: a game where one player wins each group of cards played in turn

examples.en: We learned a trick-taking game from a friend in the common room.
examples.zh: 我们跟公共休息室的一位朋友学了一个「吃墩类纸牌游戏」。

examples.en: The club chose a short trick-taking game for the first half hour.
examples.zh: 社团选了个耗时短的「吃墩类纸牌游戏」，留给前半小时玩。

words.enDefinition: a three-legged stand that holds a camera steady

examples.en: I set up a tripod beside the window before taking the photograph.
examples.zh: 我拍照前在窗边架好了「三脚架」。

examples.en: My classmate packed her tripod after we finished photographing the jars.
examples.zh: 拍完那些玻璃罐后，同学收起了自己的「三脚架」。

collocations: mount a camera on a tripod

words.enDefinition: a game where players answer questions about facts

examples.en: Our team chose a trivia game for the last twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 我们队选了个「知识问答游戏」，留到最后二十分钟玩。

examples.en: The trivia game had questions about food, music and local landmarks.
examples.zh: 这个「知识问答游戏」有关于食物、音乐和当地地标的问题。

words.enDefinition: a public ceremony in which a winner receives a trophy

examples.en: Most of the students stayed for the trophy presentation after the game.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后，大部分同学留下来看了「奖杯颁发仪式」。

examples.en: I took a photo of our team at the trophy presentation.
examples.zh: 在「奖杯颁发仪式」上，我给我们队拍了张照片。

collocations: take part in the trophy presentation

words.enDefinition: a card suit that outranks others under the rules of a game

examples.en: I wrote down the trump suit before we started the next hand.
examples.zh: 下一手牌开始前，我记下了「主花色」。

examples.en: The trump suit changed in the version we played after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我们玩的版本里，「主花色」是会变的。

collocations: the trump suit for this hand

words.enDefinition: to turn a card so its printed front is visible

examples.en: I had to turn a card face up before choosing my piece.
examples.zh: 我得先「把一张牌翻到正面」，再选自己的棋子。

examples.en: The host asked me to turn a card face up for everyone.
examples.zh: 主持人请我「把一张牌翻到正面」，给大家看。

collocations: ask someone to turn a card face up
turn a card face up on the table
choose to turn a card face up

words.enDefinition: a game that gives each player a separate turn to act

examples.en: We chose a turn-based game so nobody had to rush a decision.
examples.zh: 我们选了「回合制游戏」，这样没人需要匆忙做决定。

examples.en: Our turn-based game left us time to discuss each move before making it.
examples.zh: 这个「回合制游戏」让我们每一步之前都有时间商量。

words.enDefinition: the sequence in which players may act during a game

examples.en: I checked the turn order when my friend came back to the table.
examples.zh: 朋友回到桌边时，我核对了「回合顺序」。

examples.en: The card showed the turn order on its bottom edge in small print.
examples.zh: 牌的下边用小字写着「回合顺序」。

words.enDefinition: A notice saying a title is not offered for viewing in the viewer's location.

examples.en: The site showed “Unavailable in your region” when I looked up the documentary after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我查那部纪录片时，网站显示「所在地区无法观看」。

examples.en: I saw “Unavailable in your region” beside a title my cousin had recommended from abroad.
examples.zh: 我在国外表亲推荐的那部作品旁看到了「所在地区无法观看」。

collocations: a message saying unavailable in your region
a title marked unavailable in your region

words.enDefinition: a performer who learns a role to cover when needed

examples.en: The understudy went on after one of the actors lost their voice.
examples.zh: 有位演员嗓子哑了，「替补演员」上场演了这个角色。

examples.en: I worked as an understudy and practised the same lines every week.
examples.zh: 我当「替补演员」，每周都练同样的台词。

words.enDefinition: to make a stage available by meeting a game's condition

examples.en: We found out how to unlock a level by finishing the earlier one.
examples.zh: 打完前一关后，我们弄明白了怎样「解锁下一关」。

examples.en: I needed one more puzzle piece to unlock a level that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我还差一块拼图才能「解锁一个关卡」。

collocations: unlock a level by collecting pieces

words.enDefinition: A narrator whose account may be inaccurate, selective, or misleading.

examples.en: The unreliable narrator kept leaving out details that turned out to matter later on.
examples.zh: 这个「不可靠叙述者」总漏掉一些细节，后来才知道都很关键。

examples.en: Our class discussed whether the unreliable narrator had misunderstood events or was hiding something.
examples.zh: 我们班讨论那个「不可靠叙述者」是误解了发生的事，还是有所隐瞒。

collocations: a story with an unreliable narrator

words.enDefinition: the higher group of seating tiers around an arena or stadium

examples.en: From the upper bowl, we could see both ends of the field.
examples.zh: 从「上层环形看台」能看到球场两端。

examples.en: The upper bowl slowly emptied while we waited for the stairs to clear.
examples.zh: 我们等着楼梯上的人走散时，「上层环形看台」渐渐空了。

collocations: head up to the upper bowl

words.enDefinition: a public walkway serving the higher levels of a venue

examples.en: We waited for our classmates on the upper concourse near the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们在楼梯附近的「场馆上层通道」等同学。

examples.en: The sign at the top of the ramp said "Upper concourse."
examples.zh: 坡道顶端的标牌写着「场馆上层通道」。

words.enDefinition: at or towards the back of the stage, away from the audience

examples.en: The actor moved upstage so everyone could see the other two performers.
examples.zh: 演员往「舞台后部」移动，让观众能看到另外两位表演者。

examples.en: I had to stand upstage when my partner made her entrance.
examples.zh: 搭档登场的时候，我得站在「舞台后部」。

words.enDefinition: drawing everyday places and people on location in a town or city

examples.en: We tried urban sketching from a bench beside the market entrance.
examples.zh: 我们坐在市场入口旁的长椅上，试着画「城市速写」。

examples.en: The urban sketching group drew the station from the pavement across the street.
examples.zh: 「城市速写」小组在马路对面的人行道上画了那座车站。

words.enDefinition: A container where visitors leave towels they have finished using.

examples.en: I walked past the used towel bin on the way out of the cycling studio.
examples.zh: 我离开骑行教室时经过了「用过的毛巾回收桶」。

examples.en: A staff member moved the used towel bin closer to the changing room entrance.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「用过的毛巾回收桶」挪得离更衣室入口更近了。

collocations: put towels in the used towel bin
a sign for the used towel bin

words.enDefinition: a staff member who helps people find their seats

examples.en: An usher showed us the steps to our seating section.
examples.zh: 一位「引座员」指给我们通往座位分区的楼梯。

examples.en: My coursemate volunteered as an usher at the evening match.
examples.zh: 同专业同学在晚上那场比赛做志愿「引座员」。

words.enDefinition: controller movement that signals an event or action in a game

examples.en: The controller used vibration feedback when I lined up the two pieces.
examples.zh: 我把两块拼图对齐时，手柄给了「振动反馈」。

examples.en: I turned off vibration feedback so the controller would feel steadier in my hands.
examples.zh: 我关掉「振动反馈」，这样拿着手柄时感觉更稳。

words.enDefinition: points counted to determine the winner of a game

examples.en: We earned victory points by connecting the paths on our own boards.
examples.zh: 我们把各自棋盘上的路线连起来，拿到了「胜利点数」。

examples.en: The rules explained when to count victory points from saved cards.
examples.zh: 规则说明了什么时间计算保留下来的牌给的「胜利点数」。

words.enDefinition: a large screen used to show video inside a venue

examples.en: I missed the play but saw it on the video board.
examples.zh: 那个回合我没看见，不过在「场馆视频大屏」上补看了。

examples.en: The video board showed the performers before they came onto the field.
examples.zh: 表演者走上赛场前，「场馆视频大屏」先显示了他们的画面。

words.enDefinition: the scene visible from one particular seat at a venue

examples.en: The website showed the view from your seat before you confirmed the booking.
examples.zh: 你确认订票之前，网站会显示「从座位看到的视野」。

examples.en: I wanted to see the view from your seat before deciding on that row.
examples.zh: 我想先看看「从座位看到的视野」，再决定选不选那一排。

collocations: check the view from your seat
preview the view from your seat
picture of the view from your seat

words.enDefinition: an account button that opens the tickets linked to the booking

examples.en: I selected "View my tickets" to find the row listed in my booking.
examples.zh: 我点了「查看我的门票」，查看订票记录里的排号。

examples.en: The confirmation email linked to "View my tickets" underneath the event description.
examples.zh: 确认邮件在活动介绍下方放了「查看我的门票」的链接。

words.enDefinition: a batch or edition of records manufactured on vinyl

examples.en: The shop showed me a vinyl pressing with a different sleeve from the original.
examples.zh: 店家给我看了一个「压制发行的黑胶版本」，封套和最初版不一样。

examples.en: I bought the vinyl pressing after hearing how different it sounded from the streaming version.
examples.zh: 我听出它和流媒体版的声音差别之后，买了「压制发行的黑胶版本」。

words.enDefinition: an online area holding buyers before they enter a sale queue

examples.en: I opened the virtual waiting room before the match tickets went on sale.
examples.zh: 球赛门票开卖前，我打开了「线上等候室」。

examples.en: The virtual waiting room showed the start time for the next ticket sale.
examples.zh: 「线上等候室」显示了下一次门票销售的开始时间。

collocations: wait in a virtual waiting room

words.enDefinition: Speech heard over a scene without the speaker visibly saying it on screen.

examples.en: The voice-over read part of a letter while the camera showed the empty house.
examples.zh: 镜头里是空房子，「画外音」念了一段信里的内容。

examples.en: I recognized the voice-over because the same actor had appeared in a show last term.
examples.zh: 上学期看过同一个演员演的剧，我就认出了这段「画外音」是谁配的。

collocations: use a voice-over in the opening scene

words.enDefinition: a defensive contact that keeps an opponent's attack in play

examples.en: A difficult volleyball dig gave our team another chance in the final rally.
examples.zh: 艰难地完成一次「排球防守救球」后，我们队在最后一个回合又有了机会。

examples.en: The crowd clapped when the volleyball dig kept the ball in play that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，一次「排球防守救球」让比赛得以继续，观众鼓起掌来。

words.enDefinition: A place available to someone who arrives without a reservation.

examples.en: I asked whether a walk-in spot was still open when I got to the desk.
examples.zh: 到了服务台，我问还有没有「现场报名名额」。

examples.en: The staff member found a walk-in spot for my classmate just before the session started.
examples.zh: 开课前不久，工作人员给同学找到了一个「现场报名名额」。

collocations: a walk-in spot in the afternoon class

words.zhGloss: 入队时未获体育奖学金的选手
words.enDefinition: in US college sports, an athlete who joins a team without an athletic scholarship
acceptedZhAnswers: 入队时未获体育奖学金的选手

examples.en: One of our starting players joined as a walk-on during her first year.
examples.zh: 我们一名首发球员在大一入队时是「未获体育奖学金的选手」。

examples.en: He earned a place as a walk-on after attending the team's open trial.
examples.zh: 参加球队的公开试训后，他以「入队时未获体育奖学金的选手」身份获得了一个名额。

words.enDefinition: a win awarded when the scheduled opponent cannot or does not compete

examples.en: We got a walkover when the opposing team couldn't field enough players on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五对方队员人数不够，我们「不战而胜」。

examples.en: The bracket marked our quarter-final as a walkover after the other pair withdrew.
examples.zh: 对方两人退赛后，对阵表将我们的四分之一决赛标为「不战而胜」。

words.enDefinition: thin decorative paper tape often sold in colours or patterns

examples.en: I used striped washi tape around the edge of my notebook.
examples.zh: 我在笔记本边缘贴了一圈条纹「和纸胶带」。

examples.en: My friend brought a roll of washi tape to our craft night.
examples.zh: 朋友带了一卷「和纸胶带」来参加晚间手作活动。

words.enDefinition: A saved list of films or shows someone intends to watch.

examples.en: I added the short film to my watchlist because I had to leave for class.
examples.zh: 我得出门上课了，就把那部短片加进了「待看片单」。

examples.en: My roommate looked through her watchlist for something we could finish before the last bus.
examples.zh: 室友翻了翻她的「待看片单」，想找部赶末班公交前能看完的片子。

collocations: add a film to your watchlist
remove a title from the watchlist

words.enDefinition: Aerobic exercise performed in a pool, often as an organized class.

examples.en: I saw a sign for water aerobics while walking past the campus pool after class.
examples.zh: 下课经过校园泳池时，我看到一块「水中有氧操」告示。

examples.en: My roommate found water aerobics listed next to the other classes at the recreation center.
examples.zh: 室友在校园文体中心的课程列表里看到了「水中有氧操」，旁边还列着其他课程。

collocations: a pool used for water aerobics

words.enDefinition: A brief pause in an activity during which people can have a drink of water.

examples.en: I asked about the afternoon schedule when our group stopped for a water break.
examples.zh: 小组停下来「喝水休息」时，我问了下午的安排。

examples.en: The instructor paused for a water break before answering the questions people had written down.
examples.zh: 教练留了时间让大家「喝水休息」，然后回答了大家写下的问题。

words.enDefinition: thick paper made to handle wet paint and washes

examples.en: The workshop provided watercolour paper for everyone at the front table.
examples.zh: 工作坊在前面的桌子上给大家备了「水彩纸」。

examples.en: I took two sheets of watercolour paper to the garden on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六我带了两张「水彩纸」去花园。

words.enDefinition: a broad, thin layer of diluted watercolour paint

examples.en: A light watercolour wash gave the sky a gentle green tint.
examples.zh: 淡淡地「水彩薄涂」一层后，天空就带了点柔和的绿色。

examples.en: I waited for the watercolour wash to dry before adding the distant trees.
examples.zh: 我等「水彩薄涂」的一层干了，再画远处的树。

words.zhGloss: 穿上应援球队的代表色
words.enDefinition: to dress in colours associated with the team you support
acceptedZhAnswers: 穿上应援球队的代表色

examples.en: You could wear your team colours without buying anything from the stadium shop.
examples.zh: 不用在体育场商店买东西，也能「穿上应援球队的代表色」。

examples.en: The club poster said to wear your team colours for the final home match.
examples.zh: 俱乐部海报请大家在最后一场主场比赛时「穿上应援球队的代表色」。

collocations: decide to wear your team colours
remember to wear your team colours
invite fans to wear your team colours

words.enDefinition: A release schedule in which new episodes become available once a week.

examples.en: The weekly release gave our friends time to talk about each episode before the next one.
examples.zh: 「按周更新」让朋友们有时间在下一集出来前聊聊这一集。

examples.en: I prefer a weekly release when several people are trying to watch the same show together.
examples.zh: 好几个人想一起追同一部剧时，我更喜欢「按周更新」。

words.enDefinition: A sturdy padded bench used as support during gym exercises involving weights.

examples.en: There was a weight bench near the wall underneath the sign for the free weights.
examples.zh: 墙边自由重量器材标牌下方有一张「力量训练凳」。

examples.en: The campus gym ordered a replacement weight bench when the old one was taken away.
examples.zh: 旧的被搬走后，校园健身房订了一张新的「力量训练凳」。

collocations: a label beside the weight bench

words.enDefinition: A piece of gym equipment with mechanical resistance, usually created by moving weights.

examples.en: I asked the attendant to identify the weight machine with the blue seat near reception.
examples.zh: 我请值班员告诉我，前台附近那台蓝色座椅的是什么「力量训练器械」。

examples.en: A student looked at the label on the weight machine before asking a staff member.
examples.zh: 一位同学先看了「力量训练器械」上的标签，随后去问工作人员。

collocations: a weight machine on the gym floor

words.enDefinition: A flat disc designed to add weight to a bar or certain machines.

examples.en: The number on the weight plate was easier to see after the attendant moved it.
examples.zh: 值班员挪动「杠铃片」之后，上面的数字更容易看清了。

examples.en: The equipment chart showed a weight plate separately from the bar and its other parts.
examples.zh: 器械图把「杠铃片」和杠铃杆及其他部件分开画了出来。

collocations: the marking on a weight plate
a weight plate with a label

words.enDefinition: A frame or stand used to store weights or keep them organized in a gym.

examples.en: I left my towel near the weight rack and went back for it after class.
examples.zh: 我把毛巾落在了「重量器材收纳架」旁，下课后又回去拿。

examples.en: I could see the weight rack from the stairs even before the rest of the equipment.
examples.zh: 从楼梯上就能看到「重量器材收纳架」，其他器械还没进入视线。

collocations: a weight rack near the door

words.enDefinition: A gym room equipped for exercise using weights and strength machines.

examples.en: The weight room was at the end of the corridor past the changing rooms.
examples.zh: 更衣室过去，走廊尽头就是「力量训练室」。

examples.en: I found a map of the weight room beside the water station upstairs today.
examples.zh: 我今天在楼上的饮水处旁找到了「力量训练室」的地图。

words.enDefinition: The series of stacked weights that provides resistance on some exercise machines.

examples.en: I noticed the weight stack behind a cover while looking at the machine diagram.
examples.zh: 看器械图时，我留意到护罩后面就是「配重片组」。

examples.en: The diagram used a different color for the weight stack and the seat frame.
examples.zh: 示意图用不同颜色标出了「配重片组」和座椅框架。

collocations: a machine with a weight stack
a label on a weight stack

words.enDefinition: Moving at a rate that keeps viewers engaged without making events feel rushed.

examples.en: I thought the film was well-paced because every scene revealed something about the friendship.
examples.zh: 我觉得这部电影「节奏安排得当」，每场戏都让人多了解一点这段友情。

examples.en: The documentary felt well-paced even though it gave the longer interviews time to breathe.
examples.zh: 虽然纪录片给较长的访谈留足了时间，整体仍让我觉得「节奏安排得当」。

words.enDefinition: A question asking what level of experience a particular exercise class is intended for.

examples.en: “What level is this class?” I asked while looking at the timetable outside the studio.
examples.zh: 我看着团课教室外的时间表问「这门课是什么难度」？

examples.en: My roommate asked, “What level is this class?” after seeing several beginners at the door.
examples.zh: 室友看到门口有几位初学者后问「这门课是什么难度」？

collocations: ask what level is this class
say what level is this class
ask the instructor what level is this class

words.enDefinition: a raised viewing area designed for spectators using wheelchairs

examples.en: The wheelchair viewing platform gave my friend a good view above the crowd.
examples.zh: 在「轮椅观赛平台」上，朋友能越过人群看得很清楚。

examples.en: The event map showed an entrance to the wheelchair viewing platform near us.
examples.zh: 活动地图标出了我们附近的一个「轮椅观赛平台」入口。

collocations: look for a wheelchair viewing platform

words.enDefinition: a question asking which player should act now

examples.en: “Whose turn is it?” I asked after returning from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我从厨房回来后问「轮到谁了？」

examples.en: My classmate looked around the table and said, “Whose turn is it?”
examples.zh: 同学环顾整桌，问「轮到谁了？」

words.enDefinition: the cricket fielder positioned behind the batter's wicket to receive balls

examples.en: I could see the wicketkeeper from the bench beside the student sports field.
examples.zh: 从学生运动场旁的长椅，我能看见「板球守门员」。

examples.en: The wicketkeeper picked up her gloves before heading onto the field that Saturday.
examples.zh: 那个周六，「板球守门员」拿上手套走进了球场。

words.enDefinition: a lens that includes a wide area in the image

examples.en: I tried a wide-angle lens to fit the whole courtyard in the photo.
examples.zh: 为了把整个院子拍进去，我试用了「广角镜头」。

examples.en: My friend used a wide-angle lens for the row of old shopfronts.
examples.zh: 朋友用「广角镜头」拍了那一排老店面。

words.enDefinition: A release that makes a film available in many theaters or areas at once.

examples.en: We waited for the wide release so we could see it at our local cinema.
examples.zh: 我们等到它「大范围上映」才在当地影院看。

examples.en: The student newspaper reviewed the film before its wide release across the country that month.
examples.zh: 当月这部片在全国「大范围上映」前，学生报就发了影评。

words.enDefinition: a picture format with a relatively wide aspect ratio, such as 16:9 or wider

examples.en: The widescreen format fit all three characters into the same shot in the cafe.
examples.zh: 「宽银幕画幅」让咖啡馆里的三个角色都进了同一个镜头。

examples.en: The cinema kept the original widescreen format for its showing of the restored documentary.
examples.zh: 影院放映修复后的纪录片时保留了原来的「宽银幕画幅」。

collocations: show a film in widescreen format

words.enDefinition: an area of open grassland with many wildflowers

examples.en: We took photographs of the wildflower meadow from the edge of the path.
examples.zh: 我们站在小路边给「野花草甸」拍了照片。

examples.en: The wildflower meadow looked different from our last visit in early spring.
examples.zh: 「野花草甸」的样子和我们初春上次来的时候不同。

words.enDefinition: a designated place for watching animals in their surroundings

examples.en: The map marked a wildlife viewing area beside the reed beds.
examples.zh: 地图在芦苇丛旁标了一个「野生动物观察区」。

examples.en: We paused at the wildlife viewing area to look across the pond.
examples.zh: 我们在「野生动物观察区」停了一下，朝池塘对面看。

collocations: look from a wildlife viewing area

words.enDefinition: a ticket arrangement where booked tickets are collected at the venue

examples.en: I selected will call because I wanted to collect our tickets in person.
examples.zh: 我选择「现场领预订票」，因为想亲自把我们的票领到手。

examples.en: A sign pointed from the main entrance to the will call area.
examples.zh: 有块牌子从正门指向「现场领预订票」的区域。

words.enDefinition: a ticket counter where customers collect tickets already booked

examples.en: I found the will-call window next to the main ticket sales office.
examples.zh: 我在主售票处旁边找到了「预订票现场领取窗口」。

examples.en: The will-call window closed before the last event started that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚最后一场赛事开始前，「预订票现场领取窗口」就关闭了。

collocations: line up at the will-call window

words.enDefinition: to take the set of cards just played in a trick-taking game

examples.en: My friend explained how to win a trick before we started playing.
examples.zh: 开始前，朋友讲了怎么「赢下一墩牌」。

examples.en: I thought I might win a trick with the card I had saved.
examples.zh: 我觉得自己留的那张牌也许能「赢下一墩牌」。

collocations: use a card to win a trick

words.enDefinition: the state or goal that must be reached to win

examples.en: We checked the win condition before planning our final few turns.
examples.zh: 安排最后几个回合之前，我们查了「获胜条件」。

examples.en: The win condition was to connect all four corners of the board.
examples.zh: 「获胜条件」是把棋盘四个角都连起来。

words.enDefinition: areas at the sides of a stage hidden from audiences

examples.en: We waited in the wings until the stage manager nodded at us.
examples.zh: 我们在「侧幕区」等着，直到舞台监督朝我们点头。

examples.en: I watched from the wings while my classmates finished the first scene.
examples.zh: 同学演完第一场时，我在「侧幕区」观看。

words.enDefinition: the goal that gives a team the decisive lead in a match it wins

examples.en: My roommate scored the winning goal in the final match of the campus league.
examples.zh: 校园联赛最后一场，我室友打进了「制胜进球」。

examples.en: The supporters cheered for a long time after the winning goal that evening.
examples.zh: 当晚「制胜进球」打进后，球迷欢呼了很久。

words.enDefinition: a series of wins in a row

examples.en: Our winning streak ended when we played the team from the other campus.
examples.zh: 我们跟另一校区的队交手时，「连胜纪录」结束了。

examples.en: The club's winning streak stretched through the first six matches of the season.
examples.zh: 俱乐部的「连胜纪录」持续了赛季开始的六场比赛。

words.enDefinition: A reminder to clean the equipment surface when you finish using it.

examples.en: A sign beside the bikes said “Wipe the equipment after use” below a picture.
examples.zh: 健身车旁的告示在一张图片下写着「用完擦拭器械」。

examples.en: The orientation leaflet reminded students to wipe the equipment after use in the shared room.
examples.zh: 入门介绍传单提醒同学们，在公共训练室要「用完擦拭器械」。

collocations: a sign reading wipe the equipment after use
ask users to wipe the equipment after use
remember to wipe the equipment after use

words.enDefinition: the boundary between an area of trees and more open land

examples.en: We found a quiet seat near the woodland edge beside a meadow.
examples.zh: 我们在草甸旁的「林地边缘」找到了个安静的位置。

examples.en: My roommate photographed the woodland edge when the evening light reached it.
examples.zh: 傍晚的光照到「林地边缘」时，室友拍了张照片。

collocations: the light at the woodland edge

words.enDefinition: To take turns using the same exercise station during another person's breaks.

examples.en: I asked if I could work in because my classmate was already at the machine.
examples.zh: 同学已经在用那台器械，我就问能不能「和对方轮流用」。

examples.en: The notice explained what it meant to work in at the busier gym stations.
examples.zh: 告示解释了在比较繁忙的健身器械点位怎样算「与别人轮流用器械」。

words.enDefinition: A friend or companion who exercises with someone regularly or for a particular session.

examples.en: My workout buddy and I met at the entrance before we went in together.
examples.zh: 我和「健身搭子」在门口碰头，然后一起进去。

examples.en: I found a workout buddy through my residence hall's group chat earlier this term.
examples.zh: 这学期前段时间，我通过宿舍楼的群聊找到了一个「健身搭子」。

words.enDefinition: The total time a single exercise session lasts.

examples.en: I entered the workout duration after my roommate reminded me when we had arrived.
examples.zh: 室友提醒我我们几点到的之后，我输入了「锻炼时长」。

examples.en: The app listed workout duration separately from the notes I typed after the gym.
examples.zh: 我去完健身房输入的备注和「锻炼时长」在应用里是分开显示的。

words.enDefinition: A session of planned physical exercise.

examples.en: I finished my workout just before my roommate came to meet me after class.
examples.zh: 室友下课来找我之前，我刚「锻炼完」。

examples.en: We talked about the morning workout over lunch and decided to visit again together.
examples.zh: 我们午饭时聊起上午那次「锻炼」，决定下次还一起来。

words.enDefinition: How demanding a workout is in terms of the effort it requires.

examples.en: I recorded workout intensity in the notes rather than relying on the session title.
examples.zh: 我在备注里记录了「锻炼强度」，单看课程名称很难判断。

examples.en: Our instructor asked us how the workout intensity felt during the different parts of class.
examples.zh: 教练问我们，上课各个环节的「锻炼强度」感觉怎么样。

words.enDefinition: A notebook or digital record of exercise sessions and details about them.

examples.en: I wrote in my workout log while waiting for the bus back to campus.
examples.zh: 我等回学校的公交时，写了写「锻炼日志」。

examples.en: The workshop showed examples of a workout log that included notes about each session.
examples.zh: 工作坊展示了「锻炼日志」的例子，里面有每次运动的备注。

words.enDefinition: A usual pattern of exercises or exercise sessions someone follows over time.

examples.en: My roommate changed her workout routine when her semester timetable moved to the evening.
examples.zh: 这学期的课程改到晚上后，室友调整了「日常锻炼安排」。

examples.en: I wrote down my workout routine so I could remember what I had been doing lately.
examples.zh: 我记下了「日常锻炼安排」，好回想最近都做了些什么。

words.enDefinition: Good or interesting enough to justify spending the time to watch it.

examples.en: The film is worth watching just for the way the two leads play off each other.
examples.zh: 单看两位主演之间的对手戏，这部电影就「值得一看」。

examples.en: My classmate said the documentary was worth watching even if we knew the subject already.
examples.zh: 同学说，就算已经了解这个题材，这部纪录片也「值得一看」。

words.enDefinition: a card shown by a referee to formally caution a player

examples.en: The referee showed a yellow card after speaking briefly to the two team captains.
examples.zh: 裁判跟两名队长简短交谈后，出示了「黄牌警告」。

examples.en: The student player received a yellow card during the first half of the game.
examples.zh: 那名学生球员在上半场吃到「黄牌警告」。

words.enDefinition: A lightweight block that provides support during yoga practice.

examples.en: A cork yoga block sat beside each mat before our introductory session began today.
examples.zh: 今天入门课开始前，每张垫子旁都放着一块软木「瑜伽砖」。

examples.en: The instructor asked which bin the class used for the blue yoga block after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，教练问大家，蓝色「瑜伽砖」平时放哪个箱子。

words.enDefinition: A class in which participants practice yoga under an instructor's guidance.

examples.en: I met a classmate at the yoga class offered in the campus activity room.
examples.zh: 我在校园活动室办的「瑜伽课」上碰见一位同学。

examples.en: The yoga class moved to another studio because the usual room needed its floor repaired.
examples.zh: 常用的教室地板要维修，「瑜伽课」就换到了另一间教室。

words.enDefinition: a defence in which basketball players cover assigned areas of the court

examples.en: The coach used zone defense after the other team kept scoring close to the basket.
examples.zh: 对方连续在篮下得分后，教练采用了「区域联防」。

examples.en: We watched the team switch to zone defense in the middle of the final quarter.
examples.zh: 最后一节打到一半，我们看到球队改用「区域联防」。

words.enDefinition: a lens that changes focal length to vary how large objects appear

examples.en: I borrowed a zoom lens to photograph the blossoms from the path.
examples.zh: 我借了个「变焦镜头」，站在小路上拍花。

examples.en: The zoom lens let me change the framing without leaving my seat.
examples.zh: 用「变焦镜头」，我不用离开座位就能调整取景。
